text.zh: Louis 等（2008）的北部和西北部修订描述了安布希特拉鼠狐猴，作为 Montagne d'Ambre 地区的两种新鼠狐猴之一。MDD 将英语显示名写作 Montagne d'Ambre Mouse Lemur；此页沿用该名称以保留研究地点线索。
text.en: Louis et al. (2008) described this mouse lemur in a revision of northern and northwestern Madagascar, as one of two new mouse lemur species associated with the Montagne d'Ambre and Antafondro forests. MDD displays the English name Montagne d'Ambre Mouse Lemur; this page uses it to retain the study's locality cue.

text.zh: MDD 所列正模 AMB5.39 的类型地点在 Montagne d'Ambre 国家公园和特别保护区，约海拔 990 米。这个类型地点及其海拔是命名材料的定位信息，不足以画出全种现今分布。
text.en: The MDD record places holotype AMB5.39 in Montagne d'Ambre National Park and Special Reserve at about 990 m. This type locality and elevation locate the name-bearing material; they do not map the species' full current range.

text.zh: MDD 同页还列出 Arnhold's Mouse Lemur 作为英语普通名。本页选择其主显示名；COL26.8 的接受身份仍由 `6RFN3` 标识。
text.en: The MDD page also lists Arnhold's Mouse Lemur as an English common name. This page follows its primary display name; the COL26.8 accepted identity remains keyed by `6RFN3`.

text.zh: Louis 等（2008）在北部和西北部鼠狐猴修订中描述玛戈·马什鼠狐猴，材料来自 Antafondro Classified Forest。MDD 主显示名使用 Margot Marsh's Mouse Lemur，并列出 Antafondro Mouse Lemur 这一地点型名称。
text.en: Louis et al. (2008) described Margot Marsh's mouse lemur in a revision of northern and northwestern mouse lemurs, using material from Antafondro Classified Forest. MDD's primary display name is Margot Marsh's Mouse Lemur and it also lists the locality-based name Antafondro Mouse Lemur.

text.zh: MDD 记录的正模 TAFO6.1 来自 Antafondro Classified Forest，地点海拔约 134 米。该类型地点定位的是描述所依托的标本，不能单独代表全部分布或现今森林状况。
text.en: The MDD record places holotype TAFO6.1 in Antafondro Classified Forest at about 134 m. This type locality locates the specimen used in the description; it does not by itself establish the full range or current forest condition.

text.zh: 此页采用 MDD 的主英语显示名；Antafondro Mouse Lemur 保留为该数据库列出的另一个普通名。COL26.8 的种级条目为 `73FMR`。
text.en: This page uses MDD's primary English display name and retains Antafondro Mouse Lemur as another name listed by that database. The COL26.8 species entry is `73FMR`.

records.scientificName: Microcebus jonahi Schüssler, Blanco, Salmona, Poelstra, Andriambeloson, Miller, Randrianambinina et al., 2020

text.zh: Schüßler 等在 2008—2017 年间调查东北部五处低地雨林，海拔范围为 42—462 米，并在该研究中正式描述乔纳鼠狐猴。论文把形态、生态和地点资料与同一区域的分子研究合并讨论；这些结论属于东北部研究区，不是全岛采样。
text.en: Schüßler et al. sampled five northeastern lowland-rainforest sites between 2008 and 2017, spanning 42–462 m, and formally described Jonah's mouse lemur in that study. The paper discussed morphology, ecology and locality data alongside molecular work from the same region; these conclusions concern the northeastern study area, not island-wide sampling.

text.zh: 正模 TiHo B34 来自 Ambavala 村附近的社区保护林，约海拔 342 米，距 Mananara-Nord 约 20 公里。研究还在五处低地雨林取样；地点数和样点范围不能视作全种分布边界。
text.en: Holotype TiHo B34 came from community-protected forest near Ambavala, at about 342 m and roughly 20 km from Mananara-Nord. The study also sampled five lowland rainforests; these sites do not define the species' full range.

text.zh: 在论文记录的 25 只捕获个体中，捕获海拔为 42—356 米；其中 14 只来自 2—4 米高的马达加斯加豆蔻属植物（Aframomum angustifolium）群落，有时混生林缘树木。作者未在无树的次生植被中见到该种，密集豆蔻植被例外。这是局部捕获和观察，不等于全种栖地偏好检验。
text.en: The paper's 25 captured individuals were recorded between 42 and 356 m; 14 were found in 2–4 m stands of Madagascar cardamom (Aframomum angustifolium), sometimes mixed with edge trees. The authors reported no sightings in treeless secondary vegetation except dense cardamom stands. These are local captures and observations, not a species-wide habitat-preference test.

text.zh: COL26.8 接受 Hapalemur alaotrensis；MDD 当前显示名为 Lac Alaotra Bamboo Lemur，并将其分布概述为马达加斯加 Alaotra 湖周围的芦苇床。Mutschler 等人的 1999 年调查沿用当时的名称 H. griseus alaotrensis。这里把当前名录身份与历史研究用名并列，不把任一简短概述当作完整分布调查。
text.en: COL26.8 accepts Hapalemur alaotrensis. The current MDD display name is Lac Alaotra Bamboo Lemur, with reed-beds around Lake Alaotra in Madagascar given as its distribution. Mutschler and colleagues used the then-current combination H. griseus alaotrensis for their 1999 survey. This profile keeps the checklist identity separate from the older study name and does not treat either summary as a complete distribution survey.

text.zh: Mutschler 等在 1994 年和 1999 年 2–3 月以独木舟直接观察开展调查；同一团队沿用相同方法，按地点比较小群遭遇率作为相对密度指标。多数地点的遭遇率比 1994 年至少低一半。考虑到 1999 年湖水异常偏低且当年发生干旱，作者据此估计五年间总体数量约下降 30%。这是依赖遭遇率指标的历史估计，不是现在的种群数量。
text.en: Mutschler and colleagues surveyed in February–March 1994 and 1999 using direct observation from canoes. The same team used the same methods and compared group encounter rates by site as an index of relative density. Rates at most sites were at least half those recorded in 1994. After accounting for unusually low water during the 1999 drought, the authors estimated an approximately 30% decline over those five years. This was a historical estimate based on encounter rates, not a current population count.

records.scientificName: Hapalemur aureus Meier, Albignac, Peyriéras, Rumpler & Wright, 1987

text.zh: Meier 等于 1987 年描述 Hapalemur aureus。MDD 所列模式地点位于 Ranomafana 村附近、东南马达加斯加的原始雨林；这为名称和模式材料提供锚点，不界定完整物种范围。
text.en: Meier and colleagues described Hapalemur aureus in 1987. MDD lists the type locality in primary rainforest near the village of Ranomafana in southeastern Madagascar. This anchors the name and type material; it does not define the species’ full range.

text.zh: Ranomafana 的一项比较研究在 2006 和 2007 年两个雨季前期，从三种同域竹狐猴的食物、尿液和粪便中检测氰化物，共检验 102 份样品。研究在 H. aureus 的竹类食物和尿液中检出氰化物；同一研究发现，三种狐猴取食的竹种和部位不同，H. griseus 的检测水平较低但仍可检出。作者指出，动物如何避免中毒仍不清楚。
text.en: A comparative study at Ranomafana tested 102 food, urine and fecal samples from three sympatric bamboo-lemur species during two pre-dry seasons in 2006 and 2007. It detected cyanide in bamboo foods and urine from H. aureus. The study also found that the lemurs consumed different bamboo species and plant parts; H. griseus had lower but still detectable results. The authors noted that how the animals avoid poisoning remained unknown.

records.scientificName: Hapalemur meridionalis Warter, Randrianasolo, Dutrillaux & Rumpler, 1987

text.zh: MDD 将该种显示为 Southern Bamboo Lemur，模式地点为 Mandena 林业站，约在 Tolagnaro（Fort-Dauphin）以北 10 公里。Eppley 等人在 Mandena 碎片化的东南沿海林地研究其取食；这个研究地点不能代替完整分布范围。
text.en: MDD displays this taxon as the Southern Bamboo Lemur and gives its type locality as the Mandena forestry station, about 10 km north of Tolagnaro (Fort-Dauphin). Eppley and colleagues studied feeding in fragmented southeastern littoral forest at Mandena; that study site is not a complete range.

text.zh: 一项首轮取食生态研究在南半球冬季连续三个月跟踪经习惯化的动物，记录瞬时与连续焦点数据，并分析食物的营养和次生化合物。该组数据中，食物的蛋白质—纤维比例偏低，动物在资源较少的冬季把大部分取食时间用于地面禾本科植物。后续研究在 2013 年对三个社会群体进行了 103 次全天焦点跟随，以检验地面取食的影响因素；其推断仍限于沿海林地样本。
text.en: An initial feeding-ecology study followed habituated lemurs for three months during the austral winter, combining instantaneous and continuous focal data with nutritional and secondary-compound analyses of foods. In that sample, foods had a low protein-to-fiber ratio, and the lemurs spent most feeding time on terrestrial grasses during the resource-poor winter. A later study made 103 full-day focal follows of three social groups during 2013 to examine factors associated with terrestrial feeding; its inference remains tied to littoral-forest samples.

limitations.en: Both ecological studies were conducted in Mandena littoral forest and are bounded by their sampled seasons and social groups; this page does not infer a species-wide diet, complete range or current status. These pages are not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: MDD 当前英文显示名为 Northern Bamboo Lemur；1990 年代文献常用 Hapalemur griseus occidentalis 或 western gentle lemur。Curtis 等记录的 Tsiombikibo Forest 观测点相对先前报道种群分别向南、向北约 200 公里，作者据此呼吁进一步调查，并没有把这次记录当作范围普查。
text.en: MDD currently displays Northern Bamboo Lemur, while 1990s papers often used Hapalemur griseus occidentalis or “western gentle lemur.” Curtis and colleagues reported a Tsiombikibo Forest sighting roughly 200 km south and 200 km north of previously reported populations. They called for further surveys rather than treating the sighting as a range census.

text.zh: Masoala 半岛 Fampotobe 的一份 2008 年短报告记录该狐猴出现在农业地景中的六处地点。作者对 Tsarasoa 一组三只动物进行了间歇观察：11 天、总计 45.9 小时；报告中 37% 的观察时间涉及取食，在取食观察中 89% 包括一种已种植的本土竹 Cathariostachys madagascariensis 的幼嫩假叶柄。这是一个小林斑群体的观测，不是物种普遍食性的比例。
text.en: A 2008 short report documented the lemur at six locations in the agricultural landscape of Fampotobe on the Masoala Peninsula. The author intermittently followed one group of three at Tsarasoa for 11 days, totaling 45.9 hours. In that report, feeding occupied 37% of observation time; 89% of feeding observations involved young pseudo-petioles of the planted native bamboo Cathariostachys madagascariensis. These are observations of one group in small forest fragments, not species-wide dietary proportions.

limitations.en: Older records used a subspecies name, and the behavioral data come from a short study of one three-animal group. Neither locality records nor sample proportions establish the current range, abundance or species-wide diet. These pages are not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: COL26.8 将该种列在独立的 Prolemur 属。2002 年线粒体 DNA 研究和 2010 年氰化物比较研究发表时曾使用 Hapalemur simus 或 H. (Prolemur) simus；这些历史组合保留在对应研究范围内，不替代当前固定名录身份。
text.en: COL26.8 places this species in the separate genus Prolemur. The 2002 mitochondrial study and the 2010 cyanide comparison used Hapalemur simus or H. (Prolemur) simus. Those historical combinations remain attached to their respective studies and do not replace the pinned checklist identity.

text.zh: 一项以改善分布知识为目标的调查走访了马达加斯加东部六处地点，在五处发现该种的典型取食痕迹，并在其中一处直接目击动物。一个地点相对当时已知现存分布向北延伸 45 公里；另两处位于此前南北种群之间的森林廊道。痕迹和局地目击支持继续调查，不能单独证明所有地点均有常驻种群或完整连续分布。
text.en: A survey designed to improve distribution knowledge visited six sites in eastern Madagascar. It found characteristic feeding signs at five and a direct sighting at one of those sites. One site extended 45 km north of the then-known extant range; two others lay in a forest corridor between previously known northern and southern populations. Signs and local sightings support further survey work but do not alone establish resident populations at every site or a complete continuous range.

text.zh: 一项 2013 年竹类调查整理了马达加斯加大型秆竹的分布与野外识别，作为理解大竹狐猴主要食物资源的背景。文中汇总的野外研究报告其食物以竹类为主，尤其包括 Cathariostachys 与 Valiha 属的大型秆竹；该植物调查不是大竹狐猴全分布区的食性普查。
text.en: A 2013 bamboo study documented the distribution and field identification of large-culmed bamboos in Madagascar as context for a major food resource of the greater bamboo lemur. Its review of field studies describes diets dominated by bamboo, especially large-culmed Cathariostachys and Valiha; the plant survey is not a range-wide dietary census of the lemur.

text.zh: 固定的 COL26.8 清单在 Hapalemur 属下接受五种：H. alaotrensis、H. aureus、H. griseus、H. meridionalis 与 H. occidentalis；同一名录另把大竹狐猴列入 Prolemur。读本批物种页时，可先看 2002 年覆盖马达加斯加南北样点的线粒体 DNA 分类研究：作者检查了 1997–2001 年六次调查捕获的 115 只动物，但当时把若干现今种作为 H. griseus 亚种。接着阅读 Ranomafana 三种同域竹狐猴的食物与排泄物检测，再转向 Mandena 冬季取食样本。最后对照 Alaotra 的历史舟行调查与 Masoala 半岛的小林斑观察，留意调查指数和单群体数据的限制。这个次序按证据类型组织，不是亲缘排序、现今范围图或完整属级自然史；本页的分类以 COL26.8 为准。
text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts five species in Hapalemur: H. alaotrensis, H. aureus, H. griseus, H. meridionalis and H. occidentalis; it places the greater bamboo lemur separately in Prolemur. For the species pages in this batch, begin with the 2002 mitochondrial study spanning northern to southeastern Madagascar: the authors examined 115 captured animals from six surveys in 1997–2001, but treated several taxa now recognized as species within H. griseus. Next read the Ranomafana comparison of foods and excreta in three sympatric bamboo lemurs, then the winter feeding sample from Mandena. Finish by comparing the historical canoe surveys at Alaotra with small-fragment observations on the Masoala Peninsula, keeping the limits of encounter-rate indices and single-group data in view. This order follows evidence types, not evolutionary relationships, a current range map or a complete genus-level natural history; classification here follows COL26.8.

limitations.en: This introduction uses a small set of regional studies as a reading path. Their dates, taxonomic labels, sampling methods and sites differ; do not combine them into a complete range, a shared diet or a final taxonomy. These pages are not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: COL26.8 将 Prolemur simus 作为 Prolemur 属下唯一接受种。较早的分类和研究常写 Hapalemur simus 或 H. (Prolemur) simus；2002 年线粒体研究、2010 年比较氰化物研究与后来的 COL 名称应按各自时间和分类语境阅读。可先读六处东部地点的调查，分辨取食痕迹、直接目击与推定分布；再读大型秆竹的野外识别研究，了解植物资料如何支撑取食研究；最后看 Ranomafana 三种竹狐猴的样品比较。此路径不构成完整种群评估或完整属级专著。
text.en: COL26.8 accepts Prolemur simus as the sole accepted species in Prolemur. Older taxonomy and papers often used Hapalemur simus or H. (Prolemur) simus; read the 2002 mitochondrial study, the 2010 cyanide comparison and the current COL name in their respective historical contexts. Begin with the survey of six eastern sites, separating feeding signs, direct sightings and inferred distribution. Then read the field-identification study of large-culmed bamboos to see how plant data support feeding research, and finish with the Ranomafana comparison of samples from three bamboo lemurs. This route is not a complete population assessment or genus monograph.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面将该种列为 Delacour's Langur，记录的模式地点为越南 Hoi Xuan。Workman 的饮食研究则在 Van Long 湿地自然保护区进行。模式地点和一个研究点为名称与局地研究提供定位，不构成完整分布图。
text.en: The current MDD page lists Delacour's Langur and gives Hoi Xuan, Vietnam, as the type locality. Workman's diet study was conducted at Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve. A type locality and one research site anchor the name and local study; they are not a complete range map.

text.zh: Workman 在 2007 年 8 月至 2008 年 7 月记录 Van Long 的取食。取食占活动预算 29%；年度食谱近 79% 为叶片，其中近 60% 为嫩叶。研究区有 145 种可利用植物，研究对象取食其中 42 种；五种植物占食谱逾 60%，16 种逾 93%。重要食物并非石灰岩特有植物，因此这项局地饮食研究不能单独解释该种与喀斯特地貌的联系。
text.en: Workman recorded feeding at Van Long from August 2007 to July 2008. Feeding made up 29% of the activity budget; foliage accounted for nearly 79% of the annual diet, with young leaves making up nearly 60%. Of 145 available plant species, the langurs ate 42; five plants comprised more than 60% of the diet and 16 more than 93%. The important foods were not limestone-endemic plants, so this local diet study alone does not explain the species' association with karst.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面使用 White-headed Langur 这一英文名。Li 与 Rogers 的社会生态研究在中国广西 Fusui 珍稀动物保护区开展，比较当地不同人为干扰水平的生境；该研究地不代表全种分布。
text.en: The current MDD page uses the English name White-headed Langur. Li and Rogers studied socioecology in Fusui Precious Animal Reserve, Guangxi, China, comparing habitats with different levels of human disturbance. Their study site does not represent the full species range.

text.zh: 研究在 1997–1998 年进行，并按人为干扰程度评定生境质量。较高质量生境的植物多样性更高，重要食物出现得更多；家域面积为 28–48 公顷，且生境质量越高，人均家域面积越小。小型一雄多雌群体对范围的防卫较弱，大群体防卫更强，观察到参与群体防卫的只有一雄多雌群中的成年雄性。以上是 Fusui 当地的关联和行为结果，不应视为全种规律。
text.en: The study was conducted in 1997–1998 and classified habitat quality by human disturbance. Higher-quality habitat had greater plant diversity and more important food plants; home ranges covered 28–48 ha, and area per individual declined as habitat quality increased. Small one-male, multi-female groups defended ranges weakly, while larger groups defended them more intensively; only harem males were observed defending groups. These are local associations and behaviours at Fusui, not species-wide rules.

text.zh: MDD 将 Golden Langur 的分布概述为 Sankosh 河与 Manas 河之间、印不边境两侧。Srivastava 的野外调查覆盖印度西阿萨姆的 Manas 国家公园及多处保护林；这组历史调查覆盖区只对应研究设计，不替代当前分布资料。
text.en: MDD summarizes the Golden Langur's distribution as lying between the Sankosh and Manas rivers on both sides of the India–Bhutan border. Srivastava's field surveys covered Manas National Park and several reserve forests in western Assam, India. That historical survey footprint describes the study design, not a current range assessment.

text.zh: 这项多阶段研究以 1997 年调查为基线，于 2001 年 9–10 月复查原样线，并在 2002–2004 年补查先前未覆盖地区。四至七名调查者采用分层随机样线，步行调查 Manas 国家公园及 Ripu、Chirang、Manas 保护林，总面积逾 100,000 公顷。深入调查在 Manas 和 Chirang 两处设置每月复访样线，跟踪 19 个焦点群体。该设计是历史区域调查，不是当前全种数量估计。
text.en: This multi-stage study used a 1997 survey as its baseline, revisited the same transects in September–October 2001, and added areas missed earlier during 2002–2004. Four to seven observers used stratified-random transects across more than 100,000 ha in Manas National Park and the Ripu, Chirang and Manas reserve forests. Intensive work at two Manas and Chirang sites used monthly transects to follow 19 focal groups. This is a historical regional survey design, not a current species-wide population estimate.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面使用 Cat Ba Langur 这一英文名，并将该种与越南 Cat Ba 岛联系。Hendershott、Behie 与 Rawson 的栖息地研究在岛上的两个繁殖群开展，观察了喀斯特地形中的岩石、稀疏植被区、坡面和峭壁。局地样本不表示岛上所有群体或全部栖息地。
text.en: The current MDD page uses the English name Cat Ba Langur and associates the species with Cat Ba Island, Vietnam. Hendershott, Behie and Rawson studied two reproductive groups on the island, observing their use of rocks, sparsely vegetated areas, slopes and cliffs in karst terrain. The local sample does not represent every group or habitat on the island.

text.zh: 研究收集 180 天观察资料，两个繁殖群分别有 7 只与 10–13 只个体；估计家域约为 22 与 50 公顷。两群旱季家域都较小，但研究无法对季节差异进行统计检验。观察扫描多落在岩石、稀疏植被区、暴露坡面和陡峭峭壁；取食则主要发生在缓坡，旱季尤为明显。期刊全文访问受限，本页只采用公开摘要报告的结果。
text.en: The study collected 180 days of observations from two reproductive groups of 7 and 10–13 animals, with estimated home ranges of about 22 and 50 ha. Both groups had smaller ranges in the dry season, but the study could not test seasonal variation statistically. Scans were often on rocks, sparsely vegetated areas, exposed slopes and steep cliffs; foraging occurred mainly on gradual slopes, especially in the dry season. The journal full text is restricted, so this page uses only results in the public abstract.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面采用 Sunda Silvery Langur 这一英文显示名。Akbar 等人的研究地点为印度尼西亚西苏门答腊 Gunung Padang 沿海林地；研究对象是一群野生个体。一个沿海林地样点无法概括跨岛分布或其他生境。
text.en: The current MDD page uses the English display name Sunda Silvery Langur. Akbar and colleagues worked in coastal forest at Gunung Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia, observing one wild group. A single coastal-forest site cannot summarize the species' island-wide range or other habitats.

text.zh: 研究团队从 2018 年 8 月至 2019 年 7 月观察该群 482 小时，记录 37 种植物的 74 种食物项目。嫩叶占 68.3%；一些月份熟果与未熟果也占较大比例。作者认为嫩叶与熟果都可能是偏好食物及替代食物。数据反映一个群体和一个地点的季节性饮食，不能当作全种固定食谱。
text.en: The team observed the group for 482 hours from August 2018 to July 2019, recording 74 food items from 37 plant species. Young leaves made up 68.3%; ripe and unripe fruits also formed a large share in some months. The authors interpreted both young leaves and ripe fruit as possible preferred and fallback foods. These data describe seasonal diet in one group at one site, not a fixed species-wide menu.

scope.en: Supports the 2018–2019 diet observations and abstracted results for one group in Gunung Padang coastal forest; it is not a species-wide diet.

limitations.zh: 本页的饮食证据来自西苏门答腊沿海林地一群个体的 2018–2019 年研究，不外推到其他岛屿或栖息地。中文普通名为编辑译名；未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: This entry is not externally expert-reviewed. It is limited to the cited sources and local evidence boundaries.

text.zh: 本阅读路径连接不同证据类型，而非覆盖属内全部物种。先读越南 Van Long 德拉库尔叶猴的饮食、广西 Fusui 白头叶猴的栖地与家域、吉婆岛叶猴的喀斯特坡面使用、西阿萨姆金叶猴的样线调查，以及西苏门答腊一群巽他银叶猴的季节食谱。随后比较银叶猴群的线粒体研究：*T. auratus*、*T. germaini*、*T. margarita* 与 *T. mauritius* 被列为五个谱系中的成员；同一研究把马来半岛群体命名为亚种 *T. cristatus selangorensis*，而 COL26.8 在此采用接受种 *T. selangorensis*。再把 *T. barbei* 的单只动物园标本描述，与 *T. phayrei* 的馆藏线粒体分析和 *T. popa* 的模式标本描述并读，并将论文的分类提案与固定目录身份分开。最后读无量山 *T. crepusculus* 的林层使用和阿萨姆 2019–2020 年 *T. pileatus* 林斑占域调查。地点、样本、年份和方法都不同，不能拼接成属级生态通则或完整系统树。
text.en: This guide links selected evidence types rather than covering every species in the genus. Begin with diet of Delacour's langurs at Van Long, habitat and range use of white-headed langurs at Fusui, karst-slope use by Cat Ba langurs, golden-langur transects in western Assam, and seasonal diet records from one Sunda silvery langur group in West Sumatra. Then compare the mitochondrial study of the silvered-langur group: *T. auratus*, *T. germaini*, *T. margarita* and *T. mauritius* were among five sampled lineages; the same study named the Malay Peninsula form *T. cristatus selangorensis* at subspecies rank, while COL26.8 retains *T. selangorensis* as an accepted species. Read the single-zoo-specimen description of *T. barbei* alongside the museum-based mitochondrial analysis of *T. phayrei* and the type-specimen description of *T. popa*, keeping each paper's taxonomic proposals distinct from the pinned catalogue. Finish with strata use by *T. crepusculus* at Mt. Wuliang and the 2019–2020 fragment-occupancy survey of *T. pileatus* in Assam. Different sites, samples, years and methods do not combine into a genus-wide ecological rule or complete phylogeny.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面使用 Bengal Slow Loris 这一英文名，并把分布概述为从印度东北部延至中南半岛及中国西南部。Swapna 等人的取食研究只在印度东北部 Tripura 的 Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary 开展；单一保护区样本不代表整个分布。
text.en: The current MDD page uses the English name Bengal Slow Loris and summarizes a range from northeastern India through mainland Southeast Asia to southwestern China. Swapna and colleagues studied feeding only at Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary in Tripura, northeast India; one reserve does not represent the full range.

text.zh: 研究在冬季 12 月至 2 月、夏季 3–4 月开展，共记录 177 小时。取食占活动预算 22.3±2.2%，该指标没有季节差异；冬季取食时间的 94.3% 用于树液等分泌物，夏季则为 67.3%，另有 22.3% 来自一种植物的花蜜。该保护区的这些季节样本支持树液取食的重要性，不足以代表全种食谱。
text.en: The study covered winter from December to February and summer in March and April, with 177 hours of observations. Feeding made up 22.3±2.2% of the activity budget, with no seasonal difference in that measure. Exudates accounted for 94.3% of winter feeding time; in summer they accounted for 67.3%, with nectar from one plant species contributing 22.3%. These seasonal samples at one reserve show the importance of exudates there, not a species-wide diet.

text.zh: MDD 当前页面使用 Javan Slow Loris，并记录爪哇为模式地点。Arismayanti、Perwitasari 与 Winarti 在 Mount Halimun-Salak 国家公园的天然森林中观察两只成年雌性个体；样本只说明该研究点的空间使用。
text.en: The current MDD page uses Javan Slow Loris and gives Java as the type locality. Arismayanti, Perwitasari and Winarti observed two adult females in natural forest at Mount Halimun-Salak National Park; the sample describes space use at that study site only.

text.zh: 研究使用 Kernel Home Range 方法分析家域、Point Centered Quarter 方法记录生境，并以五分钟间隔的瞬时焦点动物采样记录行为。两只成年雌性的连续家域分别估算为 5.43 与 5.58 公顷。作者记录日常活动主要包括移动、进食、活动和觅食，主要发生在较低树冠层；睡眠通常在中层树冠。两只个体的结果不能代表全种家域分布。
text.en: The study estimated home ranges with a kernel method, sampled habitat with the Point Centered Quarter method, and recorded behaviour using five-minute instantaneous focal-animal sampling. Contiguous home ranges for the two adult females were estimated at 5.43 and 5.58 ha. Daily activity mainly involved travel, feeding, other active behaviour and foraging in the lower canopy; sleeping usually occurred in the middle canopy. Two animals do not represent the species-wide distribution of home-range sizes.

text.en: MDD currently displays Bangka Slow Loris, gives Klabat Bay on Bangka, Indonesia, as the type locality, and lists holotype USNM:MAMM:124907. This specimen locality anchors the name; it is not a complete map of the species' present distribution.

text.zh: Munds 等研究婆罗洲蜂猴的面部毛色变异，并依据地域聚类提出承认 N. bancanus、N. borneanus、N. kayan 与 N. menagensis 四种；作者明确指出需进一步遗传研究。Blair 等 2023 年的遗传树显示，按毛色标记命名的四类样本并未与主要谱系一一对应。此页沿用固定 COL26.8 接受名，同时保留分类证据尚需对照的状态。
text.en: Munds and colleagues examined facial-mask variation in Bornean lorises and proposed recognizing N. bancanus, N. borneanus, N. kayan and N. menagensis as four species based on regional clustering; they explicitly called for further genetic work. Blair and colleagues' 2023 genetic tree did not place samples assigned to those four pelage forms in a one-to-one match with the major lineages. This page follows the pinned COL26.8 name while preserving the need to compare the taxonomic evidence.

text.zh: MDD 当前显示名为 Bornean Slow Loris，记载的模式地点在印度尼西亚西加里曼丹 Sanggau 区 Sakaiam 河，正模为 USNM:MAMM:142234。模式地点只定位最初命名材料，不是完整现今分布。
text.en: MDD currently displays Bornean Slow Loris and lists the type locality as the Sakaiam River in Sanggau District, West Kalimantan, Indonesia; the holotype is USNM:MAMM:142234. The type locality identifies the original name-bearing material, not a complete current range.

text.zh: Munds 等在 2013 年将过去置于 N. menagensis 名下的婆罗洲材料分作若干面部毛色地域类群，并支持将 N. borneanus 列为四种之一；研究者同时要求遗传验证。2023 年分子研究中，按该毛色体系识别的四个类群没有与主要遗传谱系整齐对应。页内名称仍按 COL26.8，分类关系保留为有待进一步对照。
text.en: In 2013, Munds and colleagues separated Bornean material previously treated under N. menagensis into regional facial-mask forms and supported N. borneanus as one of four species; they also called for genetic confirmation. A 2023 molecular study did not produce a clean match between those four pelage-based forms and the main genetic lineages. The page retains the COL26.8 name while leaving the relationship open to further comparison.

text.zh: MDD 当前显示名为 Kayan Slow Loris，记录的正模 AMNH M-106012 来自印度尼西亚东加里曼丹 Peleben。Munds 等以这项分类研究描述 N. kayan；模式地点和正模锚定名称，但不确定所有其他地点的个体鉴定。
text.en: MDD currently displays Kayan Slow Loris and records holotype AMNH M-106012 from Peleben, East Kalimantan, Indonesia. Munds and colleagues described N. kayan in the associated taxonomic study. The type locality and holotype anchor the name but do not identify every animal reported elsewhere.

text.zh: Munds 等研究婆罗洲蜂猴的面部毛色，观察到标记组合与地理区域聚类，并据此支持从以往归入 N. menagensis 的婆罗洲群体中识别 N. kayan。作者指出需要遗传研究验证与细化；2023 年研究发现若干毛色命名样本并未与分子谱系一一对应，因此不把此页的分类概述写成最终争议结论。
text.en: Munds and colleagues found that facial-marking combinations clustered geographically and used this evidence to support N. kayan among Bornean animals previously grouped under N. menagensis. They called for genetic testing and refinement. A 2023 study found that several pelage-named samples did not align one-to-one with molecular lineages, so this page does not present the diagnosis as a final resolution.

limitations.en: This profile is limited to the cited sources and their locality, specimen, sample and taxonomic scope. Its Chinese common name is an editorial translation. This entry is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: MDD 当前英文名为 Philippine Slow Loris，并记录 Tawi-Tawi 为模式地点，但模式标本已遗失；同一页面的分布概述还包括婆罗洲、Bangka 与 Belitung 等地。Timm 与 Birney 1992 年整理 Tawi-Tawi 的历史采集记录；这些历史资料和 MDD 概述不能替代现代现场普查。
text.en: MDD currently uses Philippine Slow Loris and records Tawi-Tawi as the type locality, while noting that the type specimen is lost; its distribution summary also includes Borneo and Bangka and Belitung. Timm and Birney reviewed historical collecting records from Tawi-Tawi in 1992. Those historical records and the MDD summary are not a modern field census.

text.zh: Timm 与 Birney 讨论 menagensis 名称的历史及 Tawi-Tawi 材料。Munds 等 2013 年的论文则在研究婆罗洲蜂猴时以 N. menagensis 作为婆罗洲分类背景。当前 MDD 将同一 COL26.8 名称显示为菲律宾蜂猴；阅读旧文献时应区分论文当时的用名和当前名录身份。2023 年分子研究对若干婆罗洲毛色类群与遗传谱系的对应也提出了限制。
text.en: Timm and Birney examined the history of the name menagensis and its Tawi-Tawi material. Munds and colleagues used N. menagensis as part of their Bornean taxonomy in the 2013 study. Current MDD displays the same pinned COL26.8 name as Philippine Slow Loris; readers should distinguish the paper-era usage from the current checklist identity. A 2023 molecular study also reported limits in matching several Bornean pelage forms to genetic lineages.

text.zh: MDD 当前显示名为 Hiller's Slow Loris，记录模式地点为苏门答腊西部 Padang Highlands 的 Batu Sankar，正模为 ANSP 6590；页面概述分布为苏门答腊北部。MDD 还标记一张来自南部 Way Kambas 的个体照片，明确指出该个体的物种鉴定不确定，因此本页不把它算作已确认分布记录。
text.en: MDD currently displays Hiller's Slow Loris, records the type locality as Batu Sankar in the Padang Highlands of western Sumatra, and lists holotype ANSP 6590; its distribution summary is northern Sumatra. MDD also flags the species identity of a pictured animal from southern Way Kambas as uncertain, so this page does not count it as a confirmed range record.

text.zh: Stone 与 Rehn 的 1902 年论文将 hilleri 置于 N. coucang 之下；当前 MDD 收录 Nycticebus hilleri 为接受种，并保留 Sumatran Slow Loris 为另一英文名。页面提到的旧名称组合说明分类历史，不能用作野外形态或生态证据。现有证据集尚无可用于本页的物种特定野外生态研究。
text.en: Stone and Rehn's 1902 paper placed hilleri under N. coucang; current MDD lists Nycticebus hilleri as an accepted species and retains Sumatran Slow Loris as another English name. The older name combination records taxonomic history, not field morphology or ecology. The evidence set used here contains no species-specific field-ecology study for this profile.

text.zh: 本导读串联 COL26.8 中七个尚缺页面的蜂猴属接受种；它不是完整属级物种清单。先读孟加拉蜂猴在印度 Trishna 保护区的冬夏树液与花蜜观察，再读爪哇蜂猴在 Mount Halimun-Salak 两只雌性个体的家域样本。随后以 Munds 等 2013 年的婆罗洲蜂猴面部毛色分类研究为核心，结合各物种模式地点和标本，留意该文要求遗传验证；再用 Blair 等 2023 年的谱系分析检视毛色名称与遗传分群并非一一对应。最后对照菲律宾蜂猴 menagensis 的历史命名与现行页面，以及希勒蜂猴 hilleri 的模式材料和 MDD 标注的单个不确定记录。研究尺度、年份、样本和论文用名各异；按 COL26.8 保留身份，不把局地观察或毛色分类拼成完整属级范围。
text.en: This guide links seven missing COL26.8 slow-loris profiles; it is not a complete genus species list. Begin with winter and summer exudate and nectar observations of Bengal slow lorises at Trishna Sanctuary in India, then the home-range sample from two female Javan slow lorises at Mount Halimun-Salak. Next read Munds and colleagues' 2013 facial-mask taxonomy of Bornean lorises alongside the name-bearing localities and specimens; note that the authors called for genetic confirmation. Blair and colleagues' 2023 phylogeny then tests the correspondence between pelage labels and genetic groupings, which was not one-to-one in their sampled material. Finish with the historical usage of menagensis and its current page treatment, followed by the type material and one MDD-flagged uncertain image record for hilleri. Study scale, dates, samples and paper-era names differ; identities follow COL26.8, and local observations or pelage categories do not combine into a complete genus range.

text.zh: 柔佛州一处次生且受人类改造的森林中，研究者连续 41 天观察一个群体，共记录 186.3 小时。取食记录约一半为叶，近半为果；叶片以嫩叶为主，成熟叶较少。果实来自栽种植物的比例不低，显示这一个群体会利用村落林地里的作物。研究描述的是单点、单群体的食谱，不代表种群在其他森林或季节的饮食。
text.en: In a secondary, human-modified forest in Johor, researchers observed one group for 41 days and recorded 186.3 hours. Feeding records were split roughly between leaves and fruit; young leaves dominated leaf feeding. A substantial share of fruit came from cultivated plants, showing that this group used crops in a village forest landscape. This is one site and one group, not a species-wide or seasonal diet.

text.zh: 新加坡中央集水区自然保护区在 2008—2010 年的 22 个月观察中，研究者记录至少六次出生；观察到的幼体出生时为白色，背部有交叉状黑纹。作者把这些记录作为新加坡群体仍在繁殖的直接证据，同时提醒数据仍属初步观察。它们不等于对整个物种的繁殖季或幼体存活率估计。
text.en: During 22 months of observation in Singapore’s Central Catchment Nature Reserve from 2008 to 2010, researchers recorded at least six births. The observed newborns were white with a cross-shaped dark pattern on the back. The authors treated these records as direct evidence that the Singapore group was reproducing, while describing the data as preliminary. They do not establish a species-wide breeding season or infant survival rate.

limitations.en: Diet evidence comes from one group in one secondary forest in Johor; reproductive records are local observations from Singapore’s Central Catchment. Neither study provides a species-wide range or status assessment. The Chinese common name is an editorial translation; this page has not received external expert review. This entry is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: Cantung 流域的一项 2021 年调查采用漫查法，在 31 个记录点观察到 72 只白额叶猴；记录地点海拔约 5—85 米，涵盖种植地、旱作地、混合园地与采矿景观。研究据当地六项栖地指标评估适宜度，结论只适用于这片流域及其调查设计。观测点和个体数不能替代全种分布图或种群估算。
text.en: A 2021 roaming survey in the Cantung watershed recorded 72 white-fronted langurs at 31 locations, at roughly 5–85 m elevation. The locations included plantations, dryland agriculture, mixed gardens and mining landscapes. The study assessed suitability using six local habitat components; its findings apply to this watershed and survey design. Sightings and counts are not a species-wide range map or population estimate.

text.zh: 这里保留 COL26.8 接受种 Presbytis frontata 的身份。本文引用的栖地研究讨论的是 Cantung 流域样点，没有验证全岛边界，也没有把局地适宜度模型当成已占据范围。
text.en: This page retains the COL26.8 accepted identity Presbytis frontata. The cited habitat study concerns survey locations in the Cantung watershed; it does not test island-wide boundaries or treat a local suitability model as occupied range.

The Chinese common name is an editorial translation; this page has not received external expert review. This entry is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: Kayan Mentarang 国家公园的一项四个月样线研究比较四类森林。记录中的何氏叶猴多为 7—8 只的单雄群，群密度为每平方公里 0.8—2.3 群；作者也记录到与树高等植被特征的相关关系。数字描述的是这次调查覆盖的地点和时期，不是当前全种密度。
text.en: A four-month transect study in Kayan Mentarang National Park compared four forest types. Recorded groups were generally single-male units of 7–8 animals, with group densities of 0.8–2.3 groups per km²; the authors also reported associations with vegetation features such as tree height. These figures describe the surveyed sites and period, not current species-wide density.

text.zh: 同一研究记录的生物量从保护区内原生山地林的每平方公里 92 千克，降至靠近村落的老次生林 38 千克、年轻次生林 31 千克。作者把栖地扰动和狩猎作为解释因素，但其回顾指出，不同研究中的密度和生物量响应并不一致；因此这些值应作为一地比较，而非普遍规律。
text.en: In the same study, biomass ranged from 92 kg per km² in primary hill forest inside the reserve to 38 kg in old secondary forest and 31 kg in young secondary forest near villages. The author discussed disturbance and hunting as explanatory factors, but noted that studies reported inconsistent density and biomass responses. These values are a local comparison, not a universal pattern.

text.zh: 西苏门答腊 Andalas 大学 HPPB 研究林在 2012 年 6—11 月的直接普查记录了 13 只个体、三个群体；研究区 0.75 平方公里内报告密度为每平方公里 17.3 只，平均家域 0.13 平方公里。研究还记录九种取食植物。它们是小面积研究林的样本，不能当作全种常数。
text.en: A direct census at the HPPB research forest of Andalas University in West Sumatra from June to November 2012 recorded 13 animals in three groups. Within the 0.75 km² study area, the reported density was 17.3 animals per km² and mean home range 0.13 km². The researchers also recorded nine food plants. These are small-site observations, not species-wide constants.

text.zh: 一项较早的比较研究在马来半岛 Kuala Lompat 研究带叶猴，在婆罗洲 Sepilok 研究栗红叶猴，并讨论两处食物选择与植物化学的关系。该论文沿用当时分类用名；本页的物种身份仍以 COL26.8 为准，不把旧文中的群体或广义分类自动映射成今日所有近缘种。
text.en: An earlier comparative study examined banded langurs at Kuala Lompat in the Malay Peninsula and maroon leaf monkeys at Sepilok in Borneo, relating food choice to plant chemistry. The paper used its period’s taxonomy. This page follows COL26.8 identity and does not automatically map historical groups or broad taxonomic concepts onto all currently recognized relatives.

text.zh: 这里采用 COL26.8 接受的独立种名 Presbytis mitrata。2018 年 Merangin 地质公园的河岸研究则沿用旧组合 Presbytis melalophos ssp. mitrata。两种用名必须保留各自来源语境；该研究的样本可作为与此分类单元相关的局地资料，但不能单独确定现代物种边界。
text.en: This page follows the COL26.8 accepted species name Presbytis mitrata. A 2018 riparian study in the Merangin Geopark used the older combination Presbytis melalophos ssp. mitrata. The two usages remain tied to their sources; that study offers local evidence associated with this taxon but does not establish modern species boundaries by itself.

text.zh: 研究在苏门答腊西部 Merangin Geopark 三条河岸样线上进行了约三个月调查，以每日重复的条带样线记录 29 只个体，并在样区记录 31 种树木。作者报告样线覆盖约占研究区 0.48%。这些结果刻画的是有限河岸样区，不应扩写成全种数量或分布。
text.en: The study surveyed three riparian transects in the Merangin Geopark area of West Sumatra for about three months. Repeated daily strip-transect counts recorded 29 animals, and 31 tree species were documented in the site; the authors reported that transects sampled about 0.48% of the study area. These results describe a limited riparian sample, not total population size or range.

text.zh: 两组婆罗洲研究显示食谱会随地点和研究设计而变。在 Sabah Danum Valley 的 25 个月研究中，取食时间主要用于嫩叶与种子；另一项 Central Kalimantan Sabangau 的一年记录来自一群三只成年雌性，种子占记录食物的大部分。后者还发现地面活动在八个调查地点中的六处出现；受扰动林中的地面使用较常见，但作者指出仍需更多资料确认关联。
text.en: Two Bornean studies show how diet depends on site and study design. Over 25 months in Sabah’s Danum Valley, feeding time was spent mainly on young leaves and seeds. A separate year of records at Central Kalimantan’s Sabangau involved a group of three adult females, with seeds making up most recorded foods. A multi-site study also detected terrestrial behavior at six of eight sites; ground use was more common in disturbed forest, though the authors called for more data to confirm the association.

text.zh: 一项在 Danau Sentarum 国家公园 Bukit Semujan 的初步研究，于 2021 年 7—8 月记录三色叶猴取食 27 种植物；记录的食物组成以叶片为主，其次为果实和种子。活动主要出现在林冠 C 层，其次为 B 层。论文使用的名称是 P. chrysomelas ssp. cruciger，因此这些数据只说明该地该分类用名下的短期研究，不能代表整个 COL 接受种。
text.en: A preliminary study at Bukit Semujan in Danau Sentarum National Park recorded feeding on 27 plant species during July and August 2021. Leaves made up the largest share of recorded foods, followed by fruit and seeds. Most activity occurred in canopy stratum C, then stratum B. The paper used the name P. chrysomelas ssp. cruciger, so these data describe a short local study under that taxonomic usage, not the entire COL accepted species.

text.zh: “三色叶猴”是该局地论文使用的普通名；本条身份采用 COL26.8 的 Presbytis chrysomelas。其他研究把黑色型 chrysomelas 和 cruciger 分别作为亚种研究。局地观察可为成员差异提供案例，不能自动组成完整物种范围。
text.en: “Three-colored langur” is the common name used by the local study; this entry follows the COL26.8 identity Presbytis chrysomelas. Other research has studied the black morph chrysomelas and cruciger separately as subspecies. Local observations illustrate variation among forms but do not define a complete species range.

text.zh: 西爪哇 Kuningan 区的生产林研究调查了 19 片林地，合计约 52.57 平方公里；样地由村民提供线索，并非随机抽样。研究报告灰叶猴密度在每平方公里约 37—54 只之间，平均 44.71 只。该估值描述调查覆盖的生产林片区，不能直接外推至全爪哇或保护区。
text.en: A production-forest study in Kuningan District, West Java, surveyed 19 forest patches covering about 52.57 km². Local residents helped identify survey locations, so patches were not randomly sampled. The reported langur densities ranged from about 37 to 54 animals per km², with a mean of 44.71. These estimates describe the surveyed production-forest patches, not all of Java or protected areas.

text.zh: 研究比较林地中的食源树和伐木树桩密度，发现灰叶猴密度与食源树种数呈正相关、与树桩密度呈负相关；模型解释的种群差异不到一半。作者因此把生产林视为有条件的栖地案例，并要求扩大样地与改进调查设计。相关关系不等于已经证明单一因果机制。
text.en: The study compared food-tree richness and stump density across patches. Langur density was positively associated with the number of food-tree species and negatively associated with stump density; the model explained less than half of population variation. The authors treated production forests as a conditional habitat case and called for broader sampling and improved survey design. These associations do not prove a single causal mechanism.

text.zh: 本阅读路径连接十九个 COL26.8 叶猴属物种页，不是完整属级名录或系统发育。新增阅读顺序从纳土纳岛和明打威群岛的野外研究入门，再比较分种前写作的西伯鲁岛记录，再比较苏门答腊 melalophos 与 mitrata 两篇使用时期分类名不同的局地研究。随后转到婆罗洲：何氏叶猴的森林类型比较、白额叶猴的流域调查、栗红叶猴跨地点食谱与地面活动、沙捞越叶猴的短期亚种研究。接着读苏门答腊黑白叶猴与黑叶猴的人类改造景观记录，再并读东苏门答腊与马来半岛带叶猴的线粒体证据；以 Bintan pale-thighed langur、托马斯叶猴及婆罗洲米勒叶猴和沙巴灰叶猴收尾。Meyer 等人的属级线粒体研究纳入九种，末端谱系多有支持但深部关系未完全解析，作者指出仍需核基因资料。各研究地点、年份、样本和分类概念不同；阅读顺序用于比较证据，不拼成统一物种范围。
text.en: This reading path links nineteen COL26.8 Presbytis species pages; it is neither a complete genus checklist nor a phylogeny. The new reading sequence begins with field studies on Natuna and the Mentawai Islands, then compares the pre-split Siberut record, then compare local Sumatran studies of melalophos and mitrata that used different period taxonomies. Move to Borneo: forest-type comparisons for Hose’s langur, a watershed survey for the white-fronted langur, multi-site diet and ground-use studies for the maroon leaf monkey, and a short subspecies-level study for the Sarawak langur. Next read local landscape studies of the black-and-white and black Sumatran langurs, then compare mitochondrial evidence for the East Sumatran and Malay Peninsula banded langurs. Finish with the Bintan pale-thighed langur, Thomas's Langur, and the Bornean Miller's and Sabah grizzled langurs. Meyer et al.'s genus-level mitochondrial study sampled nine species; it supported many terminal clades but left deeper relationships unresolved and called for nuclear data. Sites, dates, samples and taxonomic concepts differ; the order compares evidence without combining it into one genus-wide range.

scope.en: Supports a bachelor's thesis study of forest near Martabe, Batang Toru and its local canopy and home-range overlap results; not a species-wide competition test.

scope.en: Supports mitogenome analyses of the eastern Sumatran form then called P. f. percura and comparison with existing P. f. robinsoni sequence data; sampling is limited and mitochondrial only.

sources.title: Ang et al. (2020) — Faecal DNA to the rescue: shotgun sequencing of non-invasive samples

scope.zh: 支持一个标作 P. siamensis cf. cana 的苏门答腊粪样线粒体基因组及作者列出的分类方法差异；不能代表 Bintan 的 rhionis。
scope.en: Supports one Sumatran faecal-sample mitogenome labelled P. siamensis cf. cana and differences among the authors' delimitation methods; it does not represent Bintan rhionis.

scope.en: Supports a four-day, 12-hour survey in northern Bintan in 2022 and observations compiled for 2021–2022; the focal taxon is the local form called P. s. rhionis by the authors.

scope.en: Supports a loud-call comparison between Hose's langur and P. sabana and the author's taxonomic discussion; field ecology chiefly concerned P. hosei.

limitations.en: This guide covers only the eight accepted species with pages in this batch; it is not a complete genus checklist. Study sites, dates, samples and taxonomic usages differ and cannot be combined into a current genus-wide range or ecological generalization. Chinese common names are editorial translations; the guide has not received external expert review. This entry is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.en: At the Duasidan Monkey Sanctuary in Ghana, a 2017 study rotated observations among three groups of 8–15 monkeys and recorded 312 hours. The site is a roughly 1.8-ha riverine-forest patch beside a settlement. Feeding records included 13 plant species, invertebrates and discarded human food. Fruit was recorded more often in the wet season and buds in the dry season; the authors reported anthropogenic food contributions of 34.8% and 41.3%, respectively. These results describe three groups at one small site, not species-wide diet, population trend or health effects.
text.zh: 在加纳 Duasidan 猴保护区，研究者于 2017 年轮换观察三个群体（每群 8–15 只），累计记录 312 小时。该保护区是靠近社区、约 1.8 公顷的河岸林斑块。取食记录涵盖 13 种植物、无脊椎动物和人类丢弃食物；湿季较常记录果实，旱季较常记录芽。研究报告的人为食物贡献分别为湿季 34.8%、旱季 41.3%。这些结果来自单一小型地点的三个群体，不代表全种食谱、种群趋势或健康影响。

text.en: Curtin studied feeding and ranging at Bia National Park in western Ghana in 1976–1977. The chapter reports 1,250 mapped feeding trees and more than 3,000 feeding visits, involving plant parts from over 130 tree, climber and epiphyte species. Mature fruit pulp, arthropods, oil-rich seeds and young leaves were prominent foods. The chapter was published under the combination Cercopithecus diana roloway; the pinned COL26.8 record used here is C. roloway (69KD3). The decades-old, single-site observations are not a current range survey.
text.zh: Curtin 于 1976—1977 年在加纳西部 Bia 国家公园研究取食与活动。章节报告绘制并识别了 1,250 棵取食树、记录 3,000 余次取食，涉及 130 余种乔木、攀援植物和附生植物的植物材料；成熟果肉、节肢动物、富油种子和嫩叶是主要食物。原文使用组合名 Cercopithecus diana roloway；本页固定采用 COL26.8 记录 C. roloway（69KD3）。这项数十年前的单地点观察不是当前分布调查。

text.en: The cited chapter uses the historical combination Cercopithecus diana roloway. The page follows accepted COL26.8 species record C. roloway, ID 69KD3; the name difference is recorded as source context.
text.zh: 所引章节采用历史组合名 Cercopithecus diana roloway。本页依 COL26.8 接受种记录 C. roloway，编号 69KD3；此名称差异作为出处背景记录。

text.en: At Taï Forest in Côte d’Ivoire, a 13-month study compared two habituated groups each of Campbell's monkey, lesser spot-nosed monkey and Diana monkey. Campbell's monkeys ate mostly fruit along with substantial animal matter and used ground and low forest strata (below 5 m) more than the other two study species. Diet overlap with Diana monkeys was highest overall and declined in the low-fruit season. This is a comparison of six local groups, not a species-wide ecological rule or direct measure of competition.
text.zh: 科特迪瓦 Taï 森林的一项 13 个月研究比较了坎贝尔长尾猴、白鼻长尾猴和戴安娜猴各两个习惯化群体。研究中的坎贝尔长尾猴主要取食果实，也大量取食动物性食物，并较常使用地面及低于 5 米的林层。它与戴安娜猴的食谱总体重叠最高，低果季节则有所下降。这是六个当地群体的比较，不是全种生态规律或竞争的直接测量。

text.en: During a 17-month study in northern Lopé Reserve, Gabon, one group of C. cephus lived in a 9-ha forest patch surrounded by savanna. A young male C. nictitans was in permanent association with the group. The study compared primates using the fragment with conspecific groups in nearby continuous forest; its findings concern a particular fragment community and do not estimate C. cephus abundance or range.
text.zh: 在加蓬 Lopé 保护区北部的一项 17 个月研究中，一个 C. cephus 群生活在被稀树草原包围的 9 公顷林斑内；一只年轻雄性 C. nictitans 长期与该群共同活动。研究将利用林斑的灵长类与邻近连续森林中的同种群体作比较；结果只涉及这一林斑群落，不估算 C. cephus 的种群数量或分布范围。

text.en: On Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea, reconnaissance surveys compared primate abundance and hunting intensity across three areas of the Gran Caldera Scientific Reserve. The authors described C. erythrotis and C. nictitans as relatively tolerant of heavy hunting compared with other primates in that assessment. This is a relative result from those sites and methods, not a current population estimate, range-wide response or conservation-status update.
text.zh: 在赤道几内亚比奥科岛，研究者以漫查比较 Gran Caldera 科学保护区三个区域的灵长类丰度与猎捕强度。相较于该评估中的其他灵长类，作者将 C. erythrotis 和 C. nictitans 描述为对高强度猎捕“相对耐受”。这是特定地点和方法下的相对结果，不是当前种群估计、全分布区反应或保护等级更新。

text.en: Three systematic terrestrial camera-trap surveys in Lomami National Park and its buffer zone covered Okulu (2013), Losekola (2014) and E15 (2015). Across 92 cameras and 5,960 camera-trap days, the study recorded 598 independent lesula events. The authors reported strongly terrestrial locomotion and daytime activity in the photographed sample. Camera events document detections under the survey design; they are not a direct count of animals or a population-density estimate.
text.zh: Lomami 国家公园及缓冲区的三轮系统性地面相机调查分别覆盖 Okulu（2013）、Losekola（2014）和 E15（2015）。研究使用 92 台相机、累计 5,960 相机日，记录 598 次独立莱苏拉事件。作者报告，影像样本显示其活动高度偏向地面，且主要在白天活动。相机事件记录的是调查设计下的探测，不是动物个体计数或种群密度估计。

text.en: In Kakamega Forest, Kenya, researchers used 371 all-day focal follows of 24 adult females from three groups over nine months. They recorded 445 food items and analyzed more than 700 food and fecal samples. Although foods eaten varied with availability and among individuals, nutrient intake was more similar across subjects and groups. The study describes one rainforest population and its sampling period, not the full species or every age-sex class.
text.zh: 肯尼亚 Kakamega 森林的研究以九个月内 24 只成年雌性、三个群体的 371 次全天焦点跟踪记录食谱，并记录 445 种食物项目、分析 700 余份食物和粪便样本。不同个体所吃食物会随资源可得性而变化，但各个体和群体的营养摄入较为相似。研究仅描述一个雨林种群及其取样时期，不代表全种或所有年龄性别组。

text.en: At Kibale National Park, Uganda, Struhsaker compared diet observations from six neighboring redtail groups and three hybrid monkeys at Ngogo over 12 years, with observations from one group at Kanyawara. Diet varied among months, years and neighboring groups. The hybrid monkeys differed in some comparisons, including greater invertebrate consumption. The paper used the name C. ascanius schmidti; the page follows the pinned COL26.8 species record C. ascanius (STDP) and does not generalize the local results to every population.
text.zh: 乌干达 Kibale 国家公园的研究比较了 Ngogo 六个相邻红尾猴群与三只杂交猴的 12 年饮食观察，并参考 Kanyawara 一个群体。食谱在月份、年份和相邻群体之间均有变化；部分比较中杂交个体的无脊椎动物摄入较多。论文使用亚种名 C. ascanius schmidti；本页依固定 COL26.8 种级记录 C. ascanius（STDP），不将局地结果推广到所有种群。

text.en: The cited field paper uses the subspecific combination Cercopithecus ascanius schmidti. This introduction is keyed to accepted species-level COL26.8 record C. ascanius, ID STDP, without generalizing beyond sampled populations.
text.zh: 所引野外论文使用亚种组合名 Cercopithecus ascanius schmidti。本导读对应 COL26.8 接受种级记录 C. ascanius（STDP），不将研究结果外推到取样种群之外。

scope.en: Diet observations from six neighboring Ngogo groups and three hybrid monkeys over 12 years, plus one Kanyawara group in Kibale National Park; the paper uses C. a. schmidti.

text.en: This guide links 18 selected COL26.8 species pages across Ghana, Côte d’Ivoire, Nigeria, Benin, Cameroon, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Rwanda, the Republic of the Congo, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya and Uganda. Begin with the Taï comparison of C. campbelli and C. petaurista; compare feeding notes from Bia, Okomu and three Gabon sites; then read the Nyungwe studies of C. denti and C. hamlyni. The Benin habitat model, Niger Delta occupancy survey and Kafa activity scans each answer a different local question. Finish with putty-nosed monkey alarm experiments and the limited Lomako/Lomami records for Wolf’s monkey. These are selected studies, not a complete genus account or a single comparable dataset.
text.zh: 这条阅读路径连接 18 个选定的 COL26.8 物种页，地点涵盖加纳、科特迪瓦、尼日利亚、贝宁、喀麦隆、加蓬、赤道几内亚、卢旺达、刚果共和国、刚果民主共和国、肯尼亚和乌干达。先读 Taï 对 C. campbelli 与 C. petaurista 的比较，再看 Bia、Okomu 和加蓬三地的取食记录，随后读 Nyungwe 的 C. denti 与 C. hamlyni 研究。贝宁生境模型、尼日尔河三角洲占域调查、Kafa 活动扫描分别回答不同的局地问题。最后读膨鼻长尾猴的警戒叫声实验，以及沃尔夫长尾猴有限的 Lomako/Lomami 记录。这些是选定研究，不是完整属级综述，也不是一套可直接合并的数据。

sources.title: Bempah, Lu & Yi (2021) — Anthropogenic food utilization and seasonal difference in diet of Cercopithecus lowei at a community protected forest in Ghana

scope.en: 2017 feeding study of three groups at Ghana's 1.8-ha Duasidan Monkey Sanctuary, with 312 observation hours across wet and dry seasons; not a species-wide diet or population estimate.
scope.zh: 支持加纳 Duasidan 猴保护区 2017 年三个群体、湿旱季共 312 小时的取食研究；不代表全种食谱或种群估计。

sources.title: Curtin (2004) — Diet of the Roloway Monkey, Cercopithecus diana roloway, in Bia National Park, Ghana

scope.en: Feeding and ranging observations at Bia National Park, western Ghana, in 1976–1977; the chapter uses the period name C. diana roloway and does not establish current range.
scope.zh: 支持 1976—1977 年加纳西部 Bia 国家公园的取食与活动观察；章节采用当时的名称 C. diana roloway，不说明当前分布或全种食谱。

sources.title: Buzzard (2006) — Ecological partitioning of Cercopithecus campbelli, C. petaurista, and C. diana in the Taï Forest

scope.en: 13-month Taï Forest comparison using two habituated groups for each of three guenon species; findings apply to sampled groups and dates.
scope.zh: 支持 Taï 森林 13 个月、每种两群的三种长尾猴比较；结果仅适用于研究群体和时期。

sources.title: Tutin (1999) — Fragmented living: Behavioural ecology of primates in a forest fragment in the Lopé Reserve, Gabon

scope.en: 17-month study of one resident C. cephus group in a 9-ha forest fragment in northern Lopé Reserve, Gabon; not a population survey.
scope.zh: 支持加蓬 Lopé 保护区北部 9 公顷林斑中的一个 C. cephus 常驻群及 17 个月观察；不是种群调查。

sources.title: Cronin et al. (2016) — Impact of gun-hunting on monkey species and implications for primate conservation on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea

scope.en: Reconnaissance surveys compared primate abundance and hunting intensity across three areas of Bioko's Gran Caldera Scientific Reserve; relative tolerance is study-specific, not a current species status.
scope.zh: 支持比奥科岛 Gran Caldera 科学保护区三个区域的灵长类丰度与猎捕强度漫查；相对耐受性仅指该研究比较，不代表当前状态。

sources.title: Fournier et al. (2023) — Camera Traps Uncover the Behavioral Ecology of an Endemic, Cryptic Monkey Species in the Congo Basin

scope.en: Three systematic terrestrial camera-trap surveys in Lomami National Park and buffer zone (2013–2015), totaling 92 cameras, 5,960 camera-trap days and 598 independent events; events are detections, not animal counts.
scope.zh: 支持 Lomami 国家公园及缓冲区 2013—2015 年三轮系统性地面相机调查，共 92 台相机、5,960 相机日和 598 次独立事件；事件数不是个体数量。

sources.title: Takahashi et al. (2019) — Dietary generalists and nutritional specialists: Feeding strategies of adult female blue monkeys (Cercopithecus mitis) in the Kakamega Forest, Kenya

scope.en: Nine months of dietary research in one Kakamega Forest population, using 371 all-day focal follows of 24 adult females from three groups; not all populations or age-sex classes.
scope.zh: 支持 Kakamega 森林一个种群的九个月食谱研究：24 只成年雌性、三个群体共 371 次全天焦点跟踪；不代表所有种群或年龄性别组。

scope.en: Diet observations from six neighboring Ngogo groups and three hybrid monkeys over 12 years, plus one Kanyawara group in Kibale National Park; the paper uses C. a. schmidti.

sources.title: Zoffoun et al. (2022) — Use of habitat suitability model for the red-bellied monkey in southern Benin

scope.en: 2019 occurrence survey of 22 points across four previously surveyed forests and a MaxEnt habitat-suitability projection over a 1,997 km² southern Benin landscape; predictions are not confirmed presence.
scope.zh: 支持贝宁南部四片既有调查林地的 2019 年 22 个出现点及 1,997 平方公里景观上的 MaxEnt 适宜生境投影；模型结果不等于确认出现。

sources.title: Clark & Kaplin (2023) — Preliminary study of Dent's monkey in a Rwandan forest fragment

scope.en: Three months of 2017 observations in the Cyamudongo fragment, Nyungwe National Park; reported diet and vertical use are limited to that study population.
scope.zh: 支持 Nyungwe 国家公园 Cyamudongo 林斑 2017 年三个月观察；食谱与垂直空间使用仅适用于该研究种群。

sources.title: Easton et al. (2011) — Status and conservation of the owl-faced monkey in Nyungwe, Rwanda

scope.en: Repeated transect and camera-trap surveys in Nyungwe bamboo and mixed forest in 2008–2009; group counts are minimum observations from a difficult-to-detect, predominantly terrestrial monkey.
scope.zh: 支持 Nyungwe 竹林与混合林在 2008—2009 年的重复样线和相机调查；群体计数是对难以发现、主要地栖的猴所作的最小观察值。

sources.title: Olaleru et al. (2020) — Diet and nutritional profile of the mona monkey in Okomu National Park

scope.en: Preliminary feeding observations over 37 days in 2011–2013 in Okomu National Park, with opportunistic nutritional sampling; no reliable group density or composition was obtained.
scope.zh: 支持 Okomu 国家公园 2011—2013 年累计 37 天的初步取食观察及机会式营养样本；研究未可靠测得群体密度或组成。

sources.title: Haile et al. (2026) — Activity and diet of De Brazza's monkey in Kafa Biosphere Reserve

scope.en: Scan samples from six groups across Bonga and Saja forests, June 2022–May 2023; the reported zone and feeding proportions are study-specific.
scope.zh: 支持 2022 年 6 月至 2023 年 5 月 Bonga、Saja 两片森林六群猴的扫描样本；分区比例与取食比例仅适用于该研究。

sources.title: Mehon & Stephan (2021) — Female putty-nosed monkeys vocally recruit males for predator defence

scope.en: Leopard-model experiment in 19 groups in Nouabalé-Ndoki National Park in 2019 and 2020; trial responses are not natural-attack rates.
scope.zh: 支持 2019、2020 年在 Nouabalé-Ndoki 国家公园对 19 群猴进行的豹模型实验；试验反应不是自然攻击率。

sources.title: Chapman et al. (2004) — Variation in the diets of Cercopithecus species

scope.en: Comparative synthesis of diet records from Makokou, Lopé and Makandé populations of C. pogonias; percentages summarize different sites and underlying studies.
scope.zh: 支持对 Makokou、Lopé、Makandé 三地 C. pogonias 食谱记录的比较综合；比例汇总不同地点及基础研究。

sources.title: Tutin et al. (1997) — The primate community of the Lopé Reserve, Gabon

scope.en: Ten-year qualitative and quantitative diet observations for diurnal primates at Lopé, including C. pogonias; local and seasonal evidence, not a range-wide estimate.
scope.zh: 支持 Lopé 昼行灵长类十年定性与定量食谱观察，包括 C. pogonias；属于局地及季节性证据，不是全分布区估值。

sources.title: Baker et al. (2011) — Occupancy surveys for Sclater's monkey in Nigeria

scope.en: Occupancy modelling across 58 plots and 125 surveys in the Niger Delta; observer effects and low detection counts limit population interpretation.
scope.zh: 支持尼日尔河三角洲 58 个样地、125 次调查的占域模型；观察者效应与较少检出限制种群解释。

sources.title: McGraw (1994) — Census and habitat preference of six monkeys in Lomako Forest

scope.en: Local multi-species census and association study that includes C. wolfi; group size and habitat findings are not a species-wide account.
scope.zh: 支持包含 C. wolfi 的局地多物种普查和混群研究；群体规模及生境结果不构成全种综述。

limitations.en: A reading path for 18 selected species pages, not a complete genus checklist, range summary or ecological synthesis. Sites, dates, methods and taxonomic concepts remain separate. One Wolf's monkey page is explicitly a sparse local research note; several other profiles cover a single study only; not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本阅读路径串联 18 个选定物种页，不是完整属级名录、分布总结或生态综合评估。不同地点、年代、方法和分类概念保持分开。沃尔夫长尾猴页面明确是材料有限的局地研究札记；另有数页仅介绍一项研究。尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A 2019 survey documented 22 occurrence points for the Benin subspecies, C. e. erythrogaster, across four previously prospected southern forests: Lama, Lokoli, Gnanhouizounmè and Togbota. A MaxEnt model projected suitable habitat across a 1,997 km² study landscape. Under the study's threshold, 3.62% of the landscape was classed as suitable; 57.46% of that predicted area fell within protected areas, mainly the central Lama Forest Reserve. These are model outputs, not confirmed current presence or a complete range. The authors noted that occurrence data were sparse and the model extended beyond surveyed forests.
text.zh: 2019 年的一次调查为贝宁亚种 C. e. erythrogaster 在南部四片既有调查林地记录了 22 个出现点：Lama、Lokoli、Gnanhouizounmè 和 Togbota。研究用 MaxEnt 模型投影到 1,997 平方公里的景观；按作者设定的阈值，3.62% 被划为适宜生境，其中 57.46% 位于保护区，主要集中在 Lama 森林保护区核心地带。这些是模型预测，不是已确认的当前出现记录或完整分布。作者也指出出现点较少，且模型投影超出了实地调查林地。

text.en: The first systematic field study of Dent's monkey followed one population for three months in 2017 in the Cyamudongo Forest Fragment, Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda. Leaves made up about 58% of the recorded diet and fruit about 18%. Monkeys spent most observed time 10–20 m above ground in secondary forest and open areas. This short study documents flexible feeding at one fragment; it does not establish a species-wide diet, habitat preference or response to fragmentation.
text.zh: 一项系统野外研究于 2017 年在卢旺达 Nyungwe 国家公园的 Cyamudongo 林斑跟踪该种种群三个月。记录到的食物中，叶约占 58%，果实约占 18%；观察个体多数时间位于离地 10–20 米的次生林和开阔地带。这项短期研究展示了单一林斑中的取食弹性，不能据此概括全种食谱、生境偏好或对破碎化的反应。

text.en: At Nyungwe National Park in Rwanda, a 2008–2009 survey focused on 32 km² of bamboo and bamboo–forest mosaic near Nshili, at 2,031–2,624 m. Eight 1-km transects were repeatedly walked, contributing to 185 km of survey effort. Researchers made 15 direct group observations, with a mean minimum group count of 3.6 and an encounter rate of 0.081 groups per kilometre. Dense bamboo, terrestrial habits and secretive behaviour make line-transect counts likely to miss animals or underestimate group size; these results describe the Nyungwe site, not the whole species.
text.zh: 在卢旺达 Nyungwe 国家公园，2008—2009 年调查聚焦 Nshili 附近 32 平方公里的竹林及竹林—森林镶嵌地，海拔 2,031—2,624 米。研究者反复调查八条各长 1 公里的样线，合计调查 185 公里，直接观察到 15 个群体；平均最小群体计数为 3.6 只，每公里遇见率为 0.081 群。竹林茂密、地栖活动和隐蔽性会让样线漏检或低估群体数；这些结果描述的是 Nyungwe 地点，不代表全种。

text.en: In Okomu National Park, Nigeria, feeding observations were collected over 37 days during dry and wet seasons in 2011–2013. The preliminary study recorded 31 plant species from 21 families; fruits accounted for 64% of recorded plant parts, with seeds and nuts also eaten. About 21% of the observed diet came from outside the park, and the list included introduced or cultivated plants. Monkeys fled quickly from observers, so group composition and density were not reliably measured. The page describes one Okomu sample, not a complete diet.
text.zh: 尼日利亚 Okomu 国家公园的一项初步研究在 2011—2013 年旱、雨季累计观察 37 天，记录到 21 科 31 种植物；所记录植物部位中，果实占 64%，也取食种子和坚果。约 21% 的观察食物来自公园外，清单还包括引入或栽培植物。猴群会迅速避开观察者，因此研究没有可靠测出群体组成和密度。本页描述的是 Okomu 的一个样本，不是完整食谱。

text.en: A June 2022–May 2023 study compared six groups, one in each management zone of Bonga and Saja forests in Ethiopia's Kafa Biosphere Reserve. Instantaneous scans recorded 34 food-plant species across the two sites (27 at Bonga, 24 at Saja, with 17 shared). Fruit-bearing trees accounted for 83.7% of feeding scans. Feeding and movement proportions differed among the buffer and transition zones. This is a comparison of six groups at two forests, not a range-wide test of disturbance effects.
text.zh: 2022 年 6 月至 2023 年 5 月，研究者在埃塞俄比亚 Kafa 生物圈保护区的 Bonga、Saja 两片森林中比较了六个群体，每个管理分区各一群。瞬时扫描共记录两地 34 种食物植物（Bonga 27 种、Saja 24 种，其中 17 种相同）；取食扫描中有 83.7% 发生在结果树上。缓冲区和过渡区的取食与移动比例不同。这是两片森林六群猴的比较，不是对全分布区干扰效应的检验。

text.en: A predator-model experiment tested 19 wild groups in Nouabalé-Ndoki National Park, Republic of the Congo, in 2019 and 2020. When a leopard model was shown to females, males approached the group in 13 of 17 analysed trials; when the male saw the model, females did not approach in nine trials. Once males saw the model, they switched to a call associated with leopard defence and mobbing. The experiment isolates responses to a simulated threat; it does not measure how often natural attacks occur or how groups fare in the wild.
text.zh: 2019 和 2020 年，研究者在刚果共和国 Nouabalé-Ndoki 国家公园对 19 个野生群体进行了捕食者模型实验。把豹模型展示给雌猴时，17 次纳入分析的试验中有 13 次雄猴走向群体；把模型展示给雄猴时，9 次试验中雌猴均未靠近。雄猴看到模型后会转用与豹防御和围攻相关的叫声。实验隔离的是模拟威胁下的反应，不能说明自然攻击的频率或野外群体的存活结果。

text.en: At Taï Forest in Côte d'Ivoire, a 13-month comparison followed two habituated groups of each of three guenon species. C. petaurista ate more foliage than the other two study species and used the middle canopy strata, about 5–20 m above ground. The contrast is useful for reading local niche partitioning alongside C. campbelli and C. diana; it describes six sampled groups at one forest, not all populations of the current COL species.
text.zh: 科特迪瓦 Taï 森林的一项 13 个月比较研究跟踪了三种长尾猴各两个已习惯观察的群体。与另外两种相比，C. petaurista 取食更多叶片，并主要使用离地约 5–20 米的中层树冠。该结果可与 C. campbelli、C. diana 一起阅读，理解局地生态位差异；它描述的是一片森林中的六个研究群体，不代表 COL 当前接受种的所有种群。

text.en: Published dietary comparisons distinguish three Gabon samples of crowned guenons: fruit formed about 80% of the Makokou sample and 69% at Lopé, while seeds were the largest category (50%) in the Makandé sample. These records come from separate sites and studies, not one continuous range-wide survey. A ten-year Lopé community study also recorded the species among the forest primates whose feeding shifted as fruit availability changed. Together they show why a single diet label hides local and seasonal differences.
text.zh: 已发表的食谱比较区分了加蓬三地的冠长尾猴样本：Makokou 样本中果实约占 80%，Lopé 约占 69%，而 Makandé 样本中种子是最大类别（50%）。这些记录来自不同地点和研究，并非一项连续的全分布区调查。Lopé 一项持续十年的灵长类群落研究也记录了该种随果实供应变化而调整取食。合起来看，单一的食性标签会掩盖地点和季节差异。

text.en: An occupancy-survey study in Nigeria's Niger Delta detected Sclater's monkeys in 13 of 58 plots, across 17 of 125 surveys. Detection varied strongly by observer, showing why raw encounter counts can mislead for a vigilant forest monkey. Modelled occupancy was highest in plots with 20–40% farmland and secondary dry forest, but the authors cautioned that detections were few and plot boundaries complicated density estimates. This is a study of survey methods and one forest–farm landscape, not a current population estimate for the species.
text.zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔河三角洲的一项占域调查在 58 个样地中的 13 个发现斯克拉特长尾猴；125 次调查中有 17 次记录到它。检出率随观察者经验明显变化，说明对警觉的森林猴，直接比较遇见次数可能产生误导。模型显示占域在农地占 20–40% 且有次生干林的样地较高，但作者指出发现次数不多，样地边界也使密度估计复杂。这项研究针对一个林地—农地景观和调查方法，不是该种当前种群估值。

text.en: Field evidence for Wolf's monkey is sparse in the material used here. A Lomako Forest census study included it in a six-monkey comparison of habitat use and mixed-species associations; the authors described its group sizes as similar to those reported from other sites. A later ground-camera survey in Lomami recorded one independent C. wolfi event among a broader survey of arboreal monkeys. One camera event is only a detection, not an abundance measure or behavioural profile. These studies support a local research note, while species-specific diet, demography and range limits remain poorly resolved here.
text.zh: 本页所用材料中，沃尔夫长尾猴的野外证据有限。Lomako 森林普查把它纳入六种猴的生境利用与混群比较，作者称其群体规模与其他地点已有报告相近。后来的 Lomami 地面相机调查，在更广泛的树栖猴调查中记录到一次独立的 C. wolfi 事件。一次相机事件只是检出，不是丰度估值或行为画像。这些材料支持一篇局地研究札记；本页仍缺少充分的物种专属食谱、种群动态和分布边界资料。

During the sampling period, leaves made up about 75% of the red colobus diet reported in the study. The result is a useful snapshot of feeding in those groups and dates, not a fixed species-wide diet.

limitations.en: All abundance and occupancy figures are tied to the survey’s coverage and date; they do not replace a later census. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 所有丰度与占域数字均受该次调查的覆盖范围和年代限制，不能替代后续普查。 本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A reconnaissance study compared monkey abundance and gun-hunting evidence across three areas of Bioko’s Gran Caldera Scientific Reserve. In that study’s historical usage, Procolobus pennantii referred to the endemic Bioko population, which was reported as especially vulnerable and restricted to a small southwest area of the reserve. The finding is local to the survey and its taxonomic usage.
text.zh: 一项漫查比较了比奥科岛 Gran Caldera 科学保护区三个区域的猴类丰度与枪猎迹象。该研究使用的历史名称 Procolobus pennantii 指比奥科特有种群，并报告其在研究中较易受影响、分布局限于保护区西南部一小片区域。该结论限于这次调查和论文的分类用名。

sources.title: Cronin et al. (2016) — Impact of gun-hunting on monkey species and implications for primate conservation on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea

scope.en: Reconnaissance surveys compared primate abundance and hunting intensity across three areas of Bioko’s Gran Caldera Scientific Reserve; the paper uses Procolobus pennantii for the Bioko population.
scope.zh: 支持比奥科岛 Gran Caldera 科学保护区三个区域的灵长类丰度与猎捕强度漫查；论文将比奥科种群称为 Procolobus pennantii。

limitations.en: The paper reports a 2016 Bioko survey under the name Procolobus pennantii; its local result is not a range-wide or current conservation assessment. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 论文以 Procolobus pennantii 为名报告 2016 年比奥科调查；局地结果不是全域或当前保护评估。 本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A study of Tana River forest fragments related the probability of red colobus occurrence to measured habitat features, including the relative amount of edge and canopy-tree composition. Local density variation was associated with measurements of food trees. These are site-level correlations from a historical fragment study, not proof of causation or a current range-wide estimate.
text.zh: 一项塔纳河森林碎片研究，将红疣猴出现概率与实测生境特征联系起来，包括边缘相对面积和冠层树种组成；局地密度差异则与食物树指标相关。这些是历史碎片研究中的地点级相关，不证明因果，也不是当前全域估计。

scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

scope.zh: 支持本页采用的当前英文普通名交叉表；不作为出现记录、生态或完整分布证据。

sources.title: Forest fragmentation and the distribution, abundance and conservation of the Tana River red colobus (Procolobus rufomitratus) (2004)

scope.en: Historical Tana River forest-fragment study relating occupancy and local density to measured habitat variables; associations do not establish causation or current range-wide status.
scope.zh: 支持塔纳河森林碎片的历史研究，其占域与局地密度分析关联了实测生境变量；相关性不证明因果，也不代表当前全域状态。

limitations.en: The source uses an older Procolobus combination and studies Tana River fragments; conclusions remain tied to those sites and methods. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 来源采用较早的 Procolobus 组合名，研究对象是塔纳河森林碎片；结论限于这些地点和方法。 本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A three-year study compared red colobus diet, density and activity across six areas in or near Kibale National Park, Uganda. Reported local density ranged from 0.70 to 7.41 groups per km², and feeding patterns differed sharply among sites with different tree communities. The spread illustrates local variation within the study, not the species’ overall density.
text.zh: 一项为期三年的研究比较了乌干达 Kibale 国家公园内外六处红疣猴的食谱、密度和活动。研究报告的局地密度为每平方公里 0.70 至 7.41 群；不同树种群落的地点之间，取食方式差异明显。这个跨度展示的是研究内的局地差异，不是全种密度。

sources.title: Chapman & Chapman (1999) — Implications of small scale variation in ecological conditions for the diet and density of red colobus monkeys

scope.en: Three-year comparison of red colobus diet, density and activity in six areas in or near Kibale National Park; all ranges and associations are site-specific.
scope.zh: 支持 Kibale 国家公园内外六处为期三年的红疣猴食谱、密度和活动比较；各范围和关联均限于研究地点。

limitations.en: The six sites and their ecological contrasts define the evidence boundary; the paper used the historical combination Procolobus tephrosceles. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 六处地点及其生态差异构成本页证据边界；论文使用历史组合名 Procolobus tephrosceles。 本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: This reading path now links pages for all 17 species IDs in the fixed COL26.8 Piliocolobus roster. Begin with the western lineage pages on Taï feeding, the Niger Delta survey and the historical record-based inference for Miss Waldron's red colobus; then compare the Kisangani rapid assessment, flooded-forest camera traps at Lac Télé, the sparse Semliki records and the single-group Salonga diet study. Finish with the site-bounded surveys and fragmented-forest work already linked for East African taxa. Two pages preserve taxonomic crosswalk differences; the lulindicus entry is a source-insufficient taxonomy note, while waldronae summarizes historical inference rather than verified present occurrence. Do not combine local samples into a current genus-wide range or status.
text.zh: 这条阅读路径现已连接固定 COL26.8 Piliocolobus 名录中的全部 17 个种级 ID。可先读西部类型的 Taï 取食研究、尼日尔三角洲调查，以及依据历史记录推断沃尔德伦红疣猴是否灭绝的论文；再比较基桑加尼快速评估、Lac Télé 淹水森林空地相机记录、稀疏的塞姆利基记录和 Salonga 单群食谱研究；最后阅读已链接的东非局地调查与森林碎片研究。两页保留分类交叉表差异；lulindicus 条目仅为资料不足的分类史记录，waldronae 则总结历史推断而非经确认的当前出现记录。不得把局地样本合并成当前属级分布或状态。

scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

sources.title: McGraw et al. (2016) — Feeding and oral processing behaviors of two colobine monkeys in Tai Forest, Ivory Coast

scope.en: Feeding observations of habituated Western red colobus and black-and-white colobus groups in Taï National Park; the reported leaf share is from the sampling period, not a species-wide diet.
scope.zh: 支持 Taï 国家公园已习惯化的西非红疣猴和黑白疣猴群体的取食观察；叶片比例只适用于研究取样期，不代表全种食谱。

sources.title: Ndzai, Malonga & Maisels (2019) — Rediscovery of Bouvier’s Red Colobus in the Southern Republic of Congo

scope.en: A 2016 large-mammal survey in Lefini and Lesio-Louna reserves reported one Bouvier’s red colobus group during travel through a remote river section; it was not a population estimate.
scope.zh: 支持 2016 年 Lefini 与 Lesio-Louna 保护区大型哺乳动物调查中沿偏远河段行进时记录到的一个布维耶红疣猴群；不是种群估计。

sources.title: Ikemeh (2015) — Assessing the Population Status of the Critically Endangered Niger Delta Red Colobus (Piliocolobus epieni)

scope.en: A 2013–2014 survey and forest-cover analysis in the central Niger Delta; population and forest figures are the author’s dated study estimates, not current assessments.
scope.zh: 支持尼日尔三角洲中部 2013—2014 年调查与森林覆盖分析；种群和森林数字是作者当时的研究估计，不是当前评估。

sources.title: Barelli et al. (2019) — Altitude and human disturbance are associated with helminth diversity in an endangered primate, Procolobus gordonorum

scope.en: Parasitology study of 251 fecal samples from 25 social groups in four Udzungwa forest blocks; findings describe those samples and methods.
scope.zh: 支持乌曾古瓦四个森林区 25 个社会群体的 251 份粪便寄生虫样本研究；结论限于这些样本和方法。

sources.title: Davenport et al. (2019) — Zanzibar’s endemic red colobus Piliocolobus kirkii: first systematic and total assessment of population, demography and distribution

scope.en: A systematic survey of Unguja based on 4,725 survey hours; the reported 5,862 individuals and 342 groups are estimates from that survey, not current counts.
scope.zh: 支持 Unguja 岛 4,725 小时系统调查；5,862 只与 342 群是该次调查的估计，不是当前数量。

sources.title: Cronin et al. (2016) — Impact of gun-hunting on monkey species and implications for primate conservation on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea

scope.en: Reconnaissance surveys compared primate abundance and hunting intensity across three areas of Bioko’s Gran Caldera Scientific Reserve; the paper uses Procolobus pennantii for the Bioko population.
scope.zh: 支持比奥科岛 Gran Caldera 科学保护区三个区域的灵长类丰度与猎捕强度漫查；论文将比奥科种群称为 Procolobus pennantii。

sources.title: Forest fragmentation and the distribution, abundance and conservation of the Tana River red colobus (Procolobus rufomitratus) (2004)

scope.en: Historical Tana River forest-fragment study relating occupancy and local density to measured habitat variables; associations do not establish causation or current range-wide status.

sources.title: Chapman & Chapman (1999) — Implications of small scale variation in ecological conditions for the diet and density of red colobus monkeys

scope.en: Three-year comparison of red colobus diet, density and activity in six areas in or near Kibale National Park; all ranges and associations are site-specific.
scope.zh: 支持 Kibale 国家公园内外六处为期三年的红疣猴食谱、密度和活动比较；各范围和关联均限于研究地点。

sources.title: Hart, Ting & Maisels (2020) — Piliocolobus foai, IUCN Red List assessment

scope.en: A 2020 global assessment compiling the taxonomic circumscription and cited survey evidence available to its authors; its range/status summary is not a new census.
scope.zh: 2020 年全球评估汇总作者当时可得的分类界定和所引调查资料；其中分布与状态总结不是新种群调查。

sources.title: Hart, Maisels & Ting (2020) — Piliocolobus lulindicus, IUCN Red List assessment

scope.en: A 2020 assessment documenting competing historical rank/synonym treatments and the assessors' precautionary decision to retain lulindicus as a species; it does not provide a dedicated modern ecological study.
scope.zh: 2020 年评估记录了历史分类等级与异名处理的分歧，以及评估者基于预防原则保留 lulindicus 为种的决定；它不提供专门的现代生态研究。

sources.title: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 — Piliocolobus foai

scope.en: Current crosswalk source listing lulindicus among names treated under P. foai; this documents a classification difference from the pinned COL26.8 species record.
scope.zh: 当前名称交叉表将 lulindicus 列在 P. foai 的相关名称中；此处用于记录它与固定 COL26.8 种级条目的分类差异。

sources.title: Maisels et al. (2021) — Red colobus (Piliocolobus) conservation action plan 2021–2026

scope.en: A conservation synthesis drawing on cited field reports and assessments through its publication period; species summaries are not new surveys.
scope.zh: 一份汇集发表时已引用的野外报告与评估资料的保护综述；各物种摘要不是新调查。

sources.title: Hart et al. (2020) — Rapid assessment of the Kisangani red colobus

scope.en: A 2019 rapid assessment over selected locations in the Kisangani red-colobus region; phenotype assignments and observations are limited to sampled sites and report-era taxonomy.
scope.zh: 2019 年在基桑加尼红疣猴区域若干地点开展的快速评估；表型归属和观察仅限取样地点及报告所用分类。

sources.title: Brugière et al. (2025) — Camera-trap survey of the Lac Télé Community Reserve primate community

scope.en: Camera-trap captures in nine seasonally flooded forest clearings from 2020 to 2023; capture rate and events describe those clearings, not reserve-wide abundance.
scope.zh: 2020—2023 年九处季节性淹水森林空地的相机记录；捕获率和事件数只描述这些空地，不代表整个保护区的丰度。

sources.title: Hart et al. (2020) — Piliocolobus oustaleti, IUCN Red List assessment

scope.en: A 2018 global assessment amended in 2020, compiling reports and survey records from multiple regions; observations are dated and taxonomically scoped by the assessment.
scope.zh: 一项 2018 年全球评估并于 2020 年修订，汇集多个地区报告和调查记录；观察均受评估所列年代与分类范围限制。

sources.title: Bowers-Sword et al. (2025) — Population status in the Ndokbou–Makombe forests

scope.en: Reconnaissance and passive-acoustic sampling in Makombe and Ndokbou forests in 2018–2019; no verified visual encounter was recorded, and one call was putative.
scope.zh: 2018—2019 年在 Makombe 与 Ndokbou 森林开展的漫查和被动声学取样；未记录到经确认的目击，一次叫声记录为疑似。

sources.title: Maisels & Ting (2020) — Piliocolobus semlikiensis, IUCN Red List assessment

scope.en: A 2020 global assessment that summarizes historical survey encounters and explicitly notes ambiguous records and unsettled taxonomic boundaries.
scope.zh: 2020 年全球评估汇总历史调查记录，并明确指出记录归属不清和分类边界尚未解决。

sources.title: Maisels, Gautier-Hion & Gautier (1994) — Diets of two sympatric colobines in Zaire

scope.en: A 12-month diet study of one habituated red-colobus group at Botsima, Salonga; proportions are group- and site-specific and the paper uses the name Colobus badius tholloni.
scope.zh: 在 Salonga 的 Botsima 对一个已习惯化红疣猴群开展的 12 个月食谱研究；比例只适用于该群和地点，论文使用 Colobus badius tholloni 这一名称。

sources.title: Hart (2017) — Two red colobus on two sides of the Lomami River

scope.en: First-hand field notes report patrol-team sightings in and near Lomami National Park in 2016–2017; these observations are not a standardized abundance survey.
scope.zh: 第一手野外记录转述巡护队在 2016—2017 年 Lomami 国家公园内及附近的目击；这些观察不是标准化丰度调查。

sources.title: McGraw (2006) — Inferring extinction from biological records

scope.en: Four probabilistic methods applied to a chronological record of published sightings and museum specimens for the taxon then called Piliocolobus badius waldronae; inference does not confirm a living population.
scope.zh: 以四种概率方法分析当时称作 Piliocolobus badius waldronae 的已发表目击年代记录和馆藏标本；统计推断不能确认仍有存活种群。

limitations.en: All 17 fixed COL26.8 species IDs now link to a page, but evidence depth varies. Lulindicus remains source-insufficient for a full ecology profile, and the waldronae page discusses historical inference rather than a verified recent animal. Dates, sites, methods and source taxonomy are not interchangeable. This selective reading path is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中全部 17 个种级 ID 现均有页面链接，但证据深度不同。lulindicus 仍缺乏撰写完整生态介绍的资料，waldronae 页讨论的是历史推断而非近期确认个体。不同来源的年代、地点、方法和分类名不能互换。本属级阅读路径尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A study compared collared lemurs in Sainte Luce, a more intact littoral forest, with groups in the more degraded Mandena fragment. Fruit made up about 70% of recorded feeding time at the two sites during the study periods, but group-size medians were larger at Sainte Luce than at Mandena. The comparison shows local feeding flexibility under different forest conditions; it is not a range-wide diet or population estimate.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了沿海林地较完整的 Sainte Luce 与退化程度较高的 Mandena 林斑中的红颈褐狐猴。研究期间，两地观察到的取食时间中约 70% 用于吃果实，但 Sainte Luce 的群体大小中位数高于 Mandena。这项比较展示了不同森林条件下的局地取食灵活性，不是全种食谱或种群估计。

scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

scope.en: Supports the current English common-name crosswalk used for the page; not evidence of occurrence, ecology or a complete range.
scope.zh: 支持本页采用的当前英文普通名交叉表；不作为出现记录、生态或完整分布证据。

sources.title: Donati et al. (2011) — Better few than hungry: flexible feeding ecology of collared lemurs Eulemur collaris in littoral forest fragments

scope.en: Behavioral and feeding study comparing Mandena littoral-forest fragments with Sainte Luce; reported diets and group sizes remain tied to those sites and observation periods.
scope.zh: 支持 Mandena 沿海林碎片与 Sainte Luce 的行为和取食比较；食谱与群体大小仅适用于这些地点和观察时期。

limitations.en: The sites and observation periods differ; reported diet shares and group-size contrasts remain local to the study. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 研究地点和观察时期不同；食物比例与群体大小差异均限于该研究。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Researchers used a total-count method with marked individuals and known groups in part of Ankarafa Forest from September 2007 to February 2008. They counted 228 lemurs in 29 groups; group sizes ranged from four to eleven. The result is a bounded estimate for the surveyed forest area, not a current count for the whole species.
text.zh: 研究者在 2007 年 9 月至 2008 年 2 月，使用标记个体和已知群体的总计数方法，调查 Ankarafa 森林的部分区域，共计 228 只、29 群；群体大小为 4 至 11 只。该结果是调查林区的限定估计，不是全种当前数量。

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 — Eulemur flavifrons

sources.title: Volampeno, Masters & Downs (2011) — A population estimate of blue-eyed black lemurs in Ankarafa Forest, Sahamalaza-Iles Radama National Park, Madagascar

scope.en: Marked-individual total count in part of Ankarafa Forest from September 2007 to February 2008; group and density figures describe that study area.
scope.zh: 支持 2007 年 9 月至 2008 年 2 月在 Ankarafa 森林部分区域进行的标记个体总计数；群体和密度数字仅描述该研究区。

limitations.en: Counts and density apply to one part of Ankarafa Forest and the 2007–2008 survey window. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 计数与密度只适用于 Ankarafa 森林的一个区域和 2007—2008 年调查时期。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A 15-month socioecological study at Ambato Massif followed the population then named Eulemur macaco macaco. The paper described year-round cathemeral activity and reported more nocturnal group movement and vocalizations around waxing and full moons. Because the nighttime data were inferred indirectly, the author treated them as preliminary.
text.zh: Ambato Massif 一项为期 15 个月的社会生态研究，观察了当时称为 Eulemur macaco macaco 的种群。论文描述其全年昼夜交替活动，并报告盈月和满月前后夜间群体移动与叫声较多。夜间数据来自间接推断，作者将其作为初步结果。
