sources.title: Colquhoun (1998) — Cathemeral behavior of Eulemur macaco macaco at Ambato Massif, Madagascar

scope.en: A 15-month study of the Ambato Massif subspecies; nocturnal activity was inferred indirectly from vocalizations and group movements and was described as preliminary.
scope.zh: 支持 Ambato Massif 亚种 15 个月的研究；夜间活动由叫声和群体移动间接推断，论文将其称为初步数据。

limitations.en: The source used a subspecies name and one northwestern Madagascar site; nocturnal activity was measured indirectly. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 来源使用亚种名，研究地点仅在马达加斯加西北部一处；夜间活动为间接测量。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: At Valohoaka in Ranomafana National Park, a three-month 2018 study followed two habituated groups to record fruit feeding, movement and seed dispersal. The teams logged 590 observation hours, 431 fruit-feeding events at 210 plants and 346 dispersal events. These observations and the resulting spatial models describe those groups and the study site.
text.zh: Ranomafana 国家公园 Valohoaka 的一项 2018 年三个月研究，跟踪两个已习惯化群体，记录取食果实、移动和种子传播。研究团队记录了 590 小时观察、210 株植物上的 431 次取食果实事件，以及 346 次传播事件。这些观察和空间模型描述的是该地点的研究群体。

scope.en: Three months of observations in 2018 of two habituated groups at Valohoaka, Ranomafana National Park; movement and dispersal results use those groups and models.
scope.zh: 支持 2018 年在 Ranomafana 国家公园 Valohoaka 对两个已习惯化群体进行的三个月观察；移动与传播结果基于这些群体和模型。

limitations.zh: 野外观察来自 2018 年 5—7 月的两个群体；模型结果不是全种种子传播的直接分布图。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A preliminary 2012 dry-season line census in and near Ankarana National Park compared crowned lemurs across primary, secondary and degraded forest. The authors reported local density estimates for each forest type and noted that their comparison with earlier estimates was limited because the older surveys did not always sample the same areas. These values are historical site estimates.
text.zh: Ankarana 国家公园内外一项 2012 年旱季初步样线普查，比较了冠狐猴在原生林、次生林和退化林中的情况。作者报告了不同森林类型的局地密度估计，并指出旧调查不总是覆盖相同区域，因此与早期估计的比较有限。这些数值是历史地点估计。

sources.title: Gudiel et al. (2017) — Troop sizes, population densities, and sex ratios of Eulemur coronatus and Eulemur sanfordi in the Ankarana National Park

scope.en: Preliminary 2012 dry-season line-census comparisons of three forest types in and near Ankarana; density estimates are local and the authors note limitations in comparing older estimates.
scope.zh: 支持 2012 年旱季 Ankarana 内外三类森林的初步样线普查比较；密度估计为局地结果，作者也指出与旧估计比较的限制。

limitations.en: The authors call the results preliminary; line-census estimates represent Ankarana sites and the 2012 dry season. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 作者将结果称为初步研究；样线估计仅代表 Ankarana 地点和 2012 年旱季。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: The same preliminary Ankarana line census reported troop-size and density estimates for Sanford’s brown lemurs across primary, secondary and degraded forest during the 2012 dry season. The paper describes its estimates as among the first for this species in the Ankarana region, and warns that old estimates came from different areas. They are not current regional totals.
text.zh: 同一项 Ankarana 初步样线普查报告了 2012 年旱季桑福德褐狐猴在原生林、次生林和退化林中的群体大小与密度估计。论文称这些是该种在 Ankarana 区域较早的一批估计，并提醒旧估计来自不同地点。这些数值不是当前区域总量。

text.en: At Manombo forest, a feeding study recorded 54 plant species in the diet, with ripe and unripe fruit making up more than two-thirds of reported items. The authors also described opportunistic feeding on a shelf fungus from invasive trees and on non-native Aframomum fruit in open, disturbed habitat. The observations are specific to this recovering forest and study period.
text.zh: Manombo 森林一项取食研究记录了 54 种食物植物，成熟与未成熟果实占论文报告食物的三分之二以上。作者还描述了其机会性取食生长在入侵树上的层孔菌，以及在开阔受扰生境中取食非本地 Aframomum 果实。这些观察仅适用于该处恢复中的森林和研究时期。

sources.title: Ralainasolo, Ratsimbazafy & Stevens (2008) — Behavior and diet of the Critically Endangered Eulemur cinereiceps in Manombo forest, southeast Madagascar

scope.en: Diet and feeding observations from Manombo forest; the article also uses the name Eulemur albocollaris in its taxonomic note, and its observations are site-specific.
scope.zh: 支持 Manombo 森林的食谱与取食观察；文章分类说明也使用 Eulemur albocollaris 这一名称，观察结果限于该地点。

limitations.en: The article uses the parenthetical name Eulemur albocollaris and reports one Manombo population; it does not establish range-wide diet. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 文章括注使用 Eulemur albocollaris 这一名称，报告的是 Manombo 一个种群；不能据此确定全种食谱。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A one-year study followed three wild brown lemur groups in Ankarafantsika National Park and analyzed non-invasive fecal DNA from 24 individuals. The study reported routine dichromacy in Eulemur fulvus and modeled how lemurs with different visual phenotypes could distinguish consumed fruits under daylight, twilight and moonlight. This combines field observations with visual models; it is not a direct test of every individual’s perception.
text.zh: Ankarafantsika 国家公园一项为期一年的研究跟踪三个野生褐狐猴群体，并分析 24 个个体的非侵入式粪便 DNA。研究报告 Eulemur fulvus 具有常规二色视觉，并模拟不同视觉表型在日光、暮光和月光下辨别其所食果实的能力。研究结合野外观察与视觉模型，并非对每个个体感知能力的直接测试。

sources.title: Valenta et al. (2016) — Visual ecology of true lemurs suggests a cathemeral origin for the primate cone opsin polymorphism

scope.en: One-year study of three wild Eulemur fulvus groups in Ankarafantsika, combined with non-invasive fecal DNA from 24 individuals and models of fruit visibility under different light conditions.
scope.zh: 支持 Ankarafantsika 三个野生 Eulemur fulvus 群体的一年研究，并结合 24 个个体的非侵入式粪便 DNA 与不同光照下果实可视度模型。

limitations.en: Behavioral observations came from three groups and opsin analyses from 24 individuals; fruit visibility outcomes are modeled. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 行为观察来自三个群体，视蛋白分析来自 24 个个体；果实可视度结果来自模型。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: This path links eight selected COL26.8 pages, not every Eulemur species. Start with the two-site littoral-forest comparison for E. collaris; continue to the Ankarana census comparing E. coronatus and E. sanfordi across forest types. Then read the field studies of E. macaco’s day-and-night activity, E. fulvus visual ecology and E. rubriventer seed dispersal. The Manombo account of E. cinereiceps adds feeding records from a recovering forest, while the Ankarafa count for E. flavifrons shows how local survey boundaries shape a population estimate. The studies differ in date, method and taxonomic wording, so their numbers cannot be combined into a genus-wide picture.
text.zh: 这条阅读路径连接八个 COL26.8 页面，并不覆盖 Eulemur 属全部物种。先读 E. collaris 在两处沿海林地的比较，再看 Ankarana 对照 E. coronatus 与 E. sanfordi 不同森林类型的普查。随后阅读 E. macaco 昼夜活动、E. fulvus 视觉生态和 E. rubriventer 种子传播的野外研究。E. cinereiceps 的 Manombo 记录补充了恢复中森林里的取食观察；E. flavifrons 的 Ankarafa 计数则展示局地调查范围如何影响种群估计。各项研究的年代、方法与分类措辞不同，数字不能合并成属级画像。

text.en: Read these Propithecus profiles by evidence type and region, not as a genus-wide ranking. Start with the dated northern surveys for Perrier’s and crowned sifakas, then compare Daraina diet sampling and Decken’s local territorial observations in the west. Continue to Marojejy sleeping-tree choice and Ranomafana space use, then compare the Tsinjoarivo feeding study with the wild-versus-captive gut microbiome work on Coquerel’s sifaka. The studies use different years, methods and sample sizes; their measurements cannot be treated as a standardized comparison. Several profiles are single-study notes, not complete species accounts, and this path is not an exhaustive genus review.
text.zh: 这组 Propithecus 页面按证据类型和地点阅读，不是属内排名。先看北部佩里耶西法卡与冠狐猴的有年代调查，再比较 Daraina 的食谱采样和西部德肯西法卡的局地领地观察。随后阅读 Marojejy 的睡眠树选择与 Ranomafana 的空间利用，并以 Tsinjoarivo 取食研究对照科克雷尔西法卡的野外—圈养肠道微生物组比较。各研究年代、方法和样本量不同，不能当作标准化比较；若干页面只是单项研究导读，并非完整物种综述，本路径也不穷尽全属。

sources.title: Banks, Ellis & Wright (2007) — Global population size of a critically endangered lemur, Perrier’s sifaka

scope.en: Line-transect surveys conducted in 2003–2004 and remote-sensing comparison of 1994 and 2002 Landsat imagery; abundance estimates are historical and model-dependent.
scope.zh: 支持 2003—2004 年样线调查及 1994、2002 年 Landsat 影像比较；数量估算具有年代与模型边界。

sources.title: Josoa et al. (2023) — Comportement de territorialité de Propithecus deckenii dans les aires protégées Complexe Tsimembo Manambolomaty et Mandrozo

scope.en: Focal observations of eight groups in two protected areas during 2017–2018; findings describe those monitored groups and the article’s methods.
scope.zh: 支持 2017—2018 年在两个保护区对八群的焦点观察；结论限于这些群体与论文方法。

sources.title: Quéméré et al. (2013) — A DNA metabarcoding study of a primate dietary diversity and plasticity across its entire fragmented range

scope.en: Dry-season fecal sampling from 96 individuals across the mapped range of golden-crowned sifakas, analyzed with trnL metabarcoding; taxon counts and habitat associations are study results.
scope.zh: 支持金冠西法卡分布区内 96 个体的旱季粪便 trnL 条形码分析；食物类群数与生境关联均为该研究结果。

sources.title: Irwin (2008) — Feeding ecology of Propithecus diadema in forest fragments and continuous forest

scope.en: A 12-month comparison of two groups in continuous forest and two groups in fragments at Tsinjoarivo, eastern Madagascar.
scope.zh: 支持马达加斯加东部 Tsinjoarivo 连续林两群与林斑两群的 12 个月比较。

sources.title: Mills et al. (2021) — Silky sifakas use sleep sites for thermoregulation, food access and predator avoidance

scope.en: A 10-month sleeping-tree study of one wild group in Marojejy National Park; observations test site-selection hypotheses at that group and site.
scope.zh: 支持 Marojejy 国家公园一个野生群体 10 个月的睡眠树研究；观察用于检验该群体和地点的栖点假设。

sources.title: Gerber et al. (2012) — Spatial ecology of the endangered Milne-Edwards’ sifaka: do logging and season affect home range and daily ranging patterns?

scope.en: Daily, seasonal and annual space-use comparison of groups at logged and unlogged Ranomafana rainforest sites from December 2002 to November 2003.
scope.zh: 支持 2002 年 12 月至 2003 年 11 月 Ranomafana 受伐与未伐雨林地点的群体日、季节和年度空间利用比较。

sources.title: Greene et al. (2021) — Gut microbiota of frugo-folivorous sifakas across environments

scope.en: Amplicon and metagenomic analysis of fecal samples from two wild and one captive population, each with multiple groups; microbiome comparisons do not substitute for a field diet study.
scope.zh: 支持两个野生与一个圈养种群（各含多个群体）的粪便扩增子和宏基因组分析；微生物组比较不等同于野外食谱研究。

sources.title: Salmona et al. (2014) — Conservation status and abundance of the crowned sifaka (Propithecus coronatus)

scope.en: Presence–absence surveys of 70 forest fragments and 12 corridors around 19 northwestern Madagascar sites in 2009–2010, plus line-transect density surveys at six localities; full-range abundance extrapolation is explicitly difficult.
scope.zh: 支持 2009—2010 年马达加斯加西北部 19 个地点周围 70 片森林和 12 条廊道的有无调查，以及六处样线密度调查；论文明确指出全分布区数量外推困难。

limitations.en: This reading path selects local studies and does not describe all species or shared genus-wide traits. It is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本阅读路径选取地点性研究，不概述全属所有成员或共同特征；未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Banks and colleagues revisited distribution and abundance because earlier baselines were more than a decade old. Line transects in 2003–2004 covered 359.68 km at Analabe and Ankavana in the Analamera region; the study estimated a mean density of 3.11 individuals per km² and about 915 animals overall. Those are the authors’ historical, survey-based estimates, not a current census.
text.zh: Banks 等人重新调查分布与数量，是因为早期基线已有十多年。2003—2004 年样线调查在 Analamera 地区的 Analabe 和 Ankavana 覆盖 359.68 公里；研究估算平均密度为每平方公里 3.11 只、总量约 915 只。这些是作者基于当时调查给出的历史估算，不是当前普查。

scope.zh: 支持 2003—2004 年样线调查及 1994、2002 年 Landsat 影像比较；数量估算具有年代与模型边界。

limitations.en: The counts and estimates refer to the 2003–2004 survey and 2007 analysis at two areas; they are not current population figures or a full ecology account. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 数量与估算对应两个区域的 2003—2004 年调查和 2007 年分析，不代表当前种群，也不是完整生态综述。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A 2017–2018 focal-sampling study monitored eight groups across Tsimembo-Manambolomaty and Mandrozo, with groups in intact and disturbed habitat at both protected areas. The paper reports that scent-marking frequency differed by habitat and sex, while estimated home range, core area and daily path length varied among groups. These are local results from a small set of monitored groups, not a species-wide test of habitat tolerance.
text.zh: 一项 2017—2018 年焦点取样研究，在 Tsimembo-Manambolomaty 与 Mandrozo 两个保护区追踪八群动物，并在每处比较完整和受扰生境。论文报告气味标记频率随生境和性别而异，估计的家域、核心区和日移动距离则在群体间变化。这是少数受监测群体的地点性结果，不能视作全种对生境耐受性的检验。

text.en: Quéméré and colleagues analyzed dry-season feces from 96 individuals sampled across the fragmented range in Daraina using plant-DNA metabarcoding. They detected at least 130 plant species from 80 genera and 49 families. Habitat type and openness were associated with diet composition, and feces from forest-edge groups included cultivated or naturalized plants. The result is a range-wide sample for one season, not a complete year-round menu.
text.zh: Quéméré 等人用植物 DNA 条形码分析 Daraina 碎片化分布区内 96 个体的旱季粪便，检出至少 130 种植物，隶属 80 属、49 科。食谱组成与生境类型和开阔度有关，林缘群体的粪便中还检出栽培或归化植物。样本覆盖分布区但限于一个季节，不等于全年完整食谱。

sources.title: Quéméré et al. (2013) — A DNA metabarcoding study of a primate dietary diversity and plasticity across its entire fragmented range

scope.en: Dry-season fecal sampling from 96 individuals across the mapped range of golden-crowned sifakas, analyzed with trnL metabarcoding; taxon counts and habitat associations are study results.
scope.zh: 支持金冠西法卡分布区内 96 个体的旱季粪便 trnL 条形码分析；食物类群数与生境关联均为该研究结果。

limitations.en: Fecal DNA data were collected in the dry season; plant detections do not measure consumed biomass or establish year-round diet. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 粪便 DNA 样本来自旱季；植物检出不等于摄入生物量，也不能说明全年食谱。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: During a 12-month study at Tsinjoarivo, two groups in continuous forest showed greater dietary diversity and ate more fleshy fruit than two groups in fragments. In the dry season, continuous-forest groups relied more on mistletoe; fragment groups used mistletoe throughout the year, where several fruiting trees found in continuous forest were absent. The contrast links diet to these four groups and this landscape, rather than proving one universal response to fragmentation.
text.zh: Tsinjoarivo 一项为期 12 个月的研究比较连续林中的两群与林斑中的两群：连续林群体食谱更多样，也吃更多肉质果实；旱季时，它们较依赖槲寄生，而林斑群体全年都利用槲寄生，连续林中的若干结果树在林斑缺失。这个对比只解释四群在该景观中的食谱，不证明狐猴普遍如何应对破碎化。

sources.title: Irwin (2008) — Feeding ecology of Propithecus diadema in forest fragments and continuous forest

scope.en: A 12-month comparison of two groups in continuous forest and two groups in fragments at Tsinjoarivo, eastern Madagascar.
scope.zh: 支持马达加斯加东部 Tsinjoarivo 连续林两群与林斑两群的 12 个月比较。

limitations.en: This is a four-group, one-year study at Tsinjoarivo; the pattern should not be generalized to every population or season. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 这是 Tsinjoarivo 四个群体的一年研究，不应外推到所有种群或季节。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Mills and colleagues followed one wild group in Marojejy National Park for ten months and recorded 828 sleeping trees from about 35 genera. Nearly 95% were food trees, and Weinmannia accounted for 29% of sleeping trees despite low abundance in the study area. The group slept at an average height of 16 m and did not reuse a tree on consecutive nights. The authors discuss food access, temperature and predator avoidance as possible influences on site choice.
text.zh: Mills 等人在 Marojejy 国家公园追踪一个野生群体十个月，记录约 35 属、共 828 棵睡眠树。近 95% 也是食物树；研究区内数量不多的 Weinmannia 却占睡眠树的 29%。群体平均在 16 米高度睡眠，且不会连续两晚使用同一棵树。作者讨论食物获取、温度和避敌可能怎样影响栖点选择。

scope.en: A 10-month sleeping-tree study of one wild group in Marojejy National Park; observations test site-selection hypotheses at that group and site.
scope.zh: 支持 Marojejy 国家公园一个野生群体 10 个月的睡眠树研究；观察用于检验该群体和地点的栖点假设。

limitations.en: The observations concern one Marojejy group over ten months; suggested functions of sleeping sites are interpretations tested in that study. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 观察只涉及 Marojejy 一个群体的十个月；睡眠地点的功能是该研究所检验的解释。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: At Ranomafana, seven groups were followed in logged and unlogged rainforest from December 2002 to November 2003. Groups in logged forest traveled 7–13% less per day despite a larger median annual home range (46.12 ha versus 23.52 ha); core-use areas also shifted seasonally. The researchers found no density difference between the two sites and called for multiyear work because food availability varies among years.
text.zh: Ranomafana 的研究在 2002 年 12 月至 2003 年 11 月追踪受伐与未伐雨林中的七群动物。受伐林群体日行距离少 7%—13%，但年度家域中位数更大（46.12 公顷，对比 23.52 公顷）；核心利用区也随季节改变。研究者没有发现两地点密度差异，并指出食物年际变化需要多年研究。

scope.en: Daily, seasonal and annual space-use comparison of groups at logged and unlogged Ranomafana rainforest sites from December 2002 to November 2003.
scope.zh: 支持 2002 年 12 月至 2003 年 11 月 Ranomafana 受伐与未伐雨林地点的群体日、季节和年度空间利用比较。

limitations.en: The comparison covers seven groups at two Ranomafana sites over one year; it does not establish long-term population effects of logging. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 比较只覆盖 Ranomafana 两地点的七群和一年观察，不能判定伐木的长期种群影响。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A microbiome study compared fecal samples from two wild populations and one captive population, each represented by multiple groups. Microbial communities varied somewhat between wild populations, but differences between wild and captive sifakas were larger; captive samples also lacked some microbes observed in wild animals. This work connects feeding environment and gut microbial ecology, but it is not a direct field-diet or population study.
text.zh: 一项微生物组研究比较两个野生种群与一个圈养种群的粪便样本，各含多个群体。野生种群之间的微生物群落有所差异，但野生与圈养个体之间差异更大；圈养样本也缺少野生样本中观察到的部分微生物。这项研究连接取食环境和肠道微生物生态，但不是野外食谱或种群研究。

scope.en: Amplicon and metagenomic analysis of fecal samples from two wild and one captive population, each with multiple groups; microbiome comparisons do not substitute for a field diet study.
scope.zh: 支持两个野生与一个圈养种群（各含多个群体）的粪便扩增子和宏基因组分析；微生物组比较不等同于野外食谱研究。

limitations.en: The study compares gut microbiomes across two wild and one captive population; it does not by itself establish the cause of differences or describe the species’ natural history. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 研究比较两个野生和一个圈养种群的肠道微生物组；单凭此研究不能确定差异原因，也不构成完整自然史。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Surveys in 2009–2010 checked 70 forest fragments and 12 corridors around 19 sites in northwestern Madagascar, then used line transects in six localities. The presence–absence work recorded 331 social groups and 1,234 individuals; 220 km of transects produced 444 sightings for local density estimation. The authors warned that extrapolating from the surveyed area to the full range was difficult, so these figures remain tied to their survey design and date.
text.zh: 2009—2010 年的调查在马达加斯加西北部 19 个地点周围检查 70 片森林和 12 条廊道，并在六处开展样线调查。有无记录共见 331 群、1,234 只；220 公里样线获得 444 次观察，用于估算局地密度。作者指出从调查区外推到全分布区很困难，因此这些数字必须保留其调查设计和年代边界。

scope.en: Presence–absence surveys of 70 forest fragments and 12 corridors around 19 northwestern Madagascar sites in 2009–2010, plus line-transect density surveys at six localities; full-range abundance extrapolation is explicitly difficult.
scope.zh: 支持 2009—2010 年马达加斯加西北部 19 个地点周围 70 片森林和 12 条廊道的有无调查，以及六处样线密度调查；论文明确指出全分布区数量外推困难。

limitations.en: The observations and estimates describe surveys conducted in 2009–2010 at selected northwestern sites; they are not current totals or a complete range-wide estimate. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 观察与估算对应 2009—2010 年西北部选定地点的调查，不是当前总量或完整的全分布区估计。 本页未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A 2019 study in Gunung Niut Nature Reserve, West Kalimantan, used pooled local expert opinion (PLEO) alongside point-transect work for selected species. Fifty-eight community members and patrol staff contributed information across ten 5–20 km² sample units covering 167 km², about 18% of the reserve. The paper reports a local PLEO estimate of 1.70 individuals per km² for H. abbotti (CV 0.16; 95% interval 1.13–2.26). It is a knowledge-based estimate for one landscape, not a direct species-wide census or a current abundance figure.
text.zh: 一项 2019 年研究在西加里曼丹 Gunung Niut 自然保护区采用当地专家意见汇集（PLEO），并对部分物种开展样点样线工作。58 名社区成员与巡护人员提供信息，十个样区各为 5—20 平方公里，合计覆盖 167 平方公里，约占保护区的 18%。论文报告 H. abbotti 的局地 PLEO 估算为每平方公里 1.70 只（CV 0.16；95% 区间 1.13—2.26）。这是单一景观中的知识汇集估算，不是全物种直接普查，也不是当前数量。

scope.en: PLEO density estimates from Gunung Niut Nature Reserve, West Kalimantan, based on April–May 2019 interviews and ten sample units covering 167 km²; Abbott’s gray gibbon was estimated at 1.70 individuals/km² (CV 0.16; 95% interval 1.13–2.26). This is local pooled opinion, not a direct species-wide census.
scope.zh: 支持西加里曼丹 Gunung Niut 自然保护区 2019 年 4—5 月的 PLEO 汇集估算及十个合计覆盖 167 平方公里的样区；研究给出 Abbott 灰长臂猿每平方公里 1.70 只的估算（CV 0.16；95% 区间 1.13—2.26）。这是局地意见汇集结果，不是全物种直接普查。

text.en: Cheyne and colleagues surveyed the Sabangau catchment from July to December 2005 and combined auditory sampling with detailed behavioral observations of six habituated groups. They cautioned that sound records alone do not necessarily give an accurate picture of population size, density or distribution unless surveys span enough time to account for seasonal variation in calling. This page describes that survey design; it does not turn the 2005 result into a present-day estimate.
text.zh: Cheyne 等人在 2005 年 7—12 月调查 Sabangau 流域，并把听声采样与六个习惯化群体的详细行为观察结合起来。作者提醒，若调查时间不足以涵盖鸣叫的季节变化，单靠声学记录未必能准确反映种群数量、密度或分布。本页介绍该调查设计，不把 2005 年结果改写成当前估算。

text.en: At Danum Valley Conservation Area, Inoue, Sinun and Okanoya documented activity budgets, travel distance, sleeping time, activity height and travel order for wild East Bornean grey gibbons. The study offers a way to read daily behavior through measured variables rather than a general species template. Its observations belong to that conservation area and study period, not every population across Borneo.
text.zh: 在 Danum Valley 保护区，Inoue、Sinun 与 Okanoya 记录了野生东婆罗洲灰长臂猿的活动时间分配、移动距离、睡眠时间、活动高度和移动顺序。这项研究以可测量的变量呈现日常行为，不是套用一般化的物种模板。观察结果属于该保护区与研究时段，不能代表婆罗洲所有种群。

text.en: On Siberut, Tenaza compared songs, choruses and countersinging among 13 family groups whose membership and territories were known, together with other individuals. The paper describes differences associated with sex, age, season, time of day and social or spatial context. Tenaza proposed interterritorial communication and mate attraction as song functions and discussed chorusing as a possible way to reduce predation risk; these remain interpretations from the studied population.
text.zh: Tenaza 在 Siberut 比较了 13 个成员与领地已知的家庭群及其他个体的歌唱、合唱与对唱。论文描述歌声与性别、年龄、季节、一天中的时段以及社会和空间情境之间的差异。作者提出歌声可能用于群间交流和吸引配偶，也讨论合唱可能降低捕食风险；这些是基于该研究群体提出的解释。

scope.en: Supports song observations in 13 known family groups and additional individuals on Siberut; the proposed functions of song and chorusing are the author’s interpretations of that study population.

text.en: Mitani played male songs from different positions at similar distances from the study subjects. Responses varied with location: songs from the center of a range led mated males to guide silent group approaches, while songs from the periphery sometimes prompted group approaches or duets; playback from a neighbor’s range rarely produced duetting. The results support a role for song in intergroup spacing in that experiment, rather than a universal rule for every context.
text.zh: Mitani 在距离受试群体相近、但位置不同的地点播放雄性歌声。群体响应随播放位置而变：从领地中心播放时，已配对雄性带领群体静默靠近；从边缘播放时，有时引发群体靠近或对唱；从邻群领地播放则很少引发对唱。该实验结果支持歌声参与群间间隔的解释，但不是适用于所有情境的普遍规则。

text.en: Phoonjampa and Brockelman surveyed protected areas in southeastern Thailand during 2004–2005, using auditory censuses in the largest forest areas and interviews or presence checks in smaller ones. Their paper estimated about 3,800 km² of suitable canopy forest and roughly 3,000 breeding groups, or about 12,000 individuals, across four of the largest forest areas. These are historical, method-dependent estimates; they are not a current census or a count for the entire species range.
text.zh: Phoonjampa 与 Brockelman 在 2004—2005 年调查泰国东南部保护区：大型林区采用听声普查，小型区域采用访谈或出现检查。论文估计四个最大林区约有 3,800 平方公里适宜冠层森林、约 3,000 个繁殖群，即约 12,000 只。这些数量是历史且依赖调查方法的估算，不是当前普查，也不是全分布区总量。

sources.title: Phoonjampa & Brockelman (2008) — Survey of pileated gibbon Hylobates pileatus in Thailand: populations threatened by hunting and habitat degradation

scope.en: Supports the authors’ 2004–2005 protected-area surveys in southeastern Thailand: acoustic censuses in large forest areas and interviews or presence checks in smaller areas. Their approximate totals are historical method-dependent estimates, not current counts.
scope.zh: 支持作者 2004—2005 年在泰国东南部保护区的调查：大型林区采用听声普查，小型区域采用访谈或出现检查。论文总量是历史且依赖方法的估算，不是当前数量。

limitations.en: The estimates describe selected Thai protected areas surveyed in 2004–2005 and depend on acoustic sampling and extrapolation; they are not current or range-wide totals. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 数量估算对应 2004—2005 年调查的部分泰国保护区，并依赖听声采样与外推；它们不是当前或全分布区总量。本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: In the Dieng Mountains of Central Java, Widyastuti and colleagues collected field data in 2018 and 2021. They combined triangulation and acoustic spatial capture–recapture to estimate group density, then used a habitat-suitability model to extrapolate a local population estimate of 1,092 gibbons. That number is a model-based estimate for the Dieng landscape and study period, not a current count for Java or the species as a whole.
text.zh: Widyastuti 等人在中爪哇 Dieng 山区于 2018 与 2021 年开展调查。他们结合三角定位和声学空间捕获—再捕获估计群体密度，再用栖地适宜度模型外推当地种群数量，估计为 1,092 只。该数值是针对 Dieng 景观与研究时段的模型估算，不是爪哇或全物种的当前普查。

sources.title: Widyastuti et al. (2023) — Population of the Javan Gibbon (Hylobates moloch) in the Dieng Mountains, Indonesia: An updated estimation from a new approach

scope.en: Supports fieldwork in the Dieng Mountains in 2018 and 2021 using triangulation, acoustic spatial capture–recapture and habitat-suitability extrapolation; the paper’s 1,092-animal estimate is local and model-based.
scope.zh: 支持 2018 与 2021 年在 Dieng 山区开展的三角定位、声学空间捕获—再捕获及栖地适宜度外推；论文的 1,092 只估算为局地模型结果。

limitations.en: The 1,092 estimate is local to the Dieng Mountains and uses habitat-suitability extrapolation from 2018 and 2021 fieldwork; it is not a current island-wide total. This profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 1,092 只的估算限于 Dieng 山区，依据 2018 与 2021 年调查并采用栖地适宜度外推；它不是全岛当前总量。本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Read these Hylobates pages as a route through unlike field methods, not as a standardized genus comparison. Begin by contrasting the local, pooled-opinion estimate for Abbott’s gray gibbon at Gunung Niut with the 2005 auditory and behavioral survey of Bornean white-bearded gibbons at Sabangau. Then compare daily activity records for East Bornean gray gibbons at Danum Valley with two studies of vocal behavior: known Kloss’s gibbon groups on Siberut and location-specific male-song playbacks in H. muelleri. Finish with a model-based Javan gibbon estimate from the Dieng Mountains and the older protected-area survey of pileated gibbons in Thailand. These studies differ in date, scale, and method; their estimates are not directly comparable, and this path is not a complete review of Hylobates.
text.zh: 这组 Hylobates 页面串联的是不同调查方法，不是标准化的属内比较。先比较 Gunung Niut 对 Abbott 灰长臂猿的当地意见汇集估算与 Sabangau 在 2005 年对白须长臂猿开展的听声和行为调查；再把 Danum Valley 东部灰长臂猿的日常活动记录，与两项发声研究对照：Siberut 已知克洛斯长臂猿群体的歌唱观察，以及 H. muelleri 的地点差异播放实验。最后阅读 Dieng 山区爪哇长臂猿的模型估算和泰国冠长臂猿较早的保护区调查。研究年代、尺度和方法各异，数量估算不能直接互比；本路径也不是 Hylobates 的完整综述。

sources.title: Ahmad et al. (2021) — Leveraging local knowledge to estimate wildlife densities in Bornean tropical rainforests

scope.en: PLEO density estimates from Gunung Niut Nature Reserve, West Kalimantan, based on April–May 2019 interviews and ten sample units covering 167 km²; Abbott’s gray gibbon was estimated at 1.70 individuals/km² (CV 0.16; 95% interval 1.13–2.26). This is local pooled opinion, not a direct species-wide census.
scope.zh: 支持西加里曼丹 Gunung Niut 自然保护区 2019 年 4—5 月的 PLEO 汇集估算及十个合计覆盖 167 平方公里的样区；研究给出 Abbott 灰长臂猿每平方公里 1.70 只的估算（CV 0.16；95% 区间 1.13—2.26）。这是局地意见汇集结果，不是全物种直接普查。

sources.title: Cheyne et al. (2008) — Density and population estimate of gibbons (Hylobates albibarbis) in the Sabangau catchment, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia

scope.en: Supports the July–December 2005 Sabangau survey and detailed behavioral observations of six habituated groups; the authors caution that auditory sampling alone requires enough seasonal coverage to characterize calling variation.
scope.zh: 支持 2005 年 7—12 月 Sabangau 调查及对六个习惯化群体的行为观察；作者指出，单靠听声调查需要足够时间覆盖季节性鸣叫变化。

sources.title: Inoue, Sinun & Okanoya (2016) — Activity budget, travel distance, sleeping time, height of activity and travel order of wild East Bornean Grey gibbons in Danum Valley Conservation Area

scope.en: Supports the behavioral variables reported for wild Hylobates funereus at Danum Valley Conservation Area; it is a site-specific study, not a full range-wide account.
scope.zh: 支持 Danum Valley 保护区野生 Hylobates funereus 的活动时间分配、移动距离、睡眠时间、活动高度与移动顺序研究；这是地点限定的研究，不是全分布区综述。

limitations.en: This reading path links seven selected studies and does not summarize every Hylobates species or establish a common population baseline. It is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本路径串联七项选定研究，不概述 Hylobates 的所有物种，也不建立统一种群基线；尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: The COL26.8 accepted name is Tarsius dentatus. A widely cited 2005 habitat study used T. dianae; a later Sulawesi study treated dianae as a junior synonym of dentatus. The names are not interchangeable without that taxonomic context.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Tarsius dentatus。常引用的一项 2005 年栖地研究使用 T. dianae；后来的苏拉威西研究将 dianae 视为 dentatus 的晚出异名。引用旧名时需保留这一分类背景。

text.en: In the Lore Lindu region, researchers compared four plots spanning different human land uses, captured 71 tarsiers and radio-tracked 30. In that sample, more disturbed settings were associated with lower density and longer travel, while the smallest ranges occurred in slightly disturbed forest.
text.zh: 在 Lore Lindu 地区，研究者比较了人类利用程度不同的四个样区，捕获 71 只并对 30 只进行无线电追踪。在该样本中，受扰更重的样地对应较低密度和更长移动距离，而最小活动范围出现在轻度受扰林地。

text.en: These measurements describe four study plots and a study published under the name T. dianae. They should not be read as current abundance estimates or as a full account of the accepted species.
text.zh: 这些测量只描述四个研究样区，论文使用名称 T. dianae。它们不是当前数量估算，也不构成该接受种的完整介绍。

sources.title: Merker, Yustian & Mühlenberg (2005) — Responding to forest degradation: altered habitat use by Dian’s tarsier Tarsius dianae in Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.en: Four study plots across a human land-use gradient; the study captured 71 tarsiers and radio-tracked 30. Reported habitat, density, range-size and nightly-travel patterns are confined to those plots and the paper-era name T. dianae.
scope.zh: 支持四个不同人类土地利用样区的比较；研究捕获 71 只并对 30 只进行无线电追踪。栖地、密度、活动范围和夜间移动结果仅限这些样区，原文使用当时的名称 T. dianae。

sources.title: Merker et al. (2009) — Elucidating geological and biological processes underlying the diversification of Sulawesi tarsiers

scope.en: Supports the authors’ use of T. dentatus for the central-Sulawesi lineage often called T. dianae and the 2001–2006 transect study of 144 tarsiers between Kamarora and Peana; it is not a range-wide population survey.
scope.zh: 支持作者将常称为 T. dianae 的中苏拉威西谱系归入 T. dentatus，并记载 2001—2006 年 Kamarora 至 Peana 样线上的 144 只样本；这不是全分布区调查。

limitations.en: This page summarizes a historical, local habitat study and a taxonomic name reconciliation; it does not provide current abundance or a full species range. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本页概述历史性的局地栖地研究与名称对应关系，不提供当前数量或完整分布。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: The species was described from western Central Sulawesi using specimens collected near Gimpu in 2001, alongside comparisons of coat, anatomy, skull and body proportions. The authors highlighted its dark gray-buff coat, black tail tuft and distinctive duet song.
text.zh: 该种依据 2001 年在苏拉威西中部西部 Gimpu 附近采集的标本描述，并与其他类群比较毛色、解剖、头骨和身体比例。作者特别提到其深灰褐色被毛、黑色尾簇和特有二重唱。

text.en: The paper records animals or characteristic duet calls near Gimpu, Lempelero, Tomua and Marena, including both sides of the Lariang River. The authors’ proposed outer limits were tentative and still required confirmation.
text.zh: 论文记载 Gimpu、Lempelero、Tomua 和 Marena 附近的个体或特征性二重唱，包括 Lariang 河两岸。作者提出的外围分布界限仍属暂定，尚待确认。

text.en: The description combines eight collected specimens with observations and recordings from a limited western-Central-Sulawesi study area; it is not a modern range survey.
text.zh: 该描述综合八件采集标本，以及苏拉威西中部西部有限研究区内的观察和录音；它不是现代分布区调查。

sources.title: Merker & Groves (2006) — Tarsius lariang: A new primate species from Western Central Sulawesi

scope.en: Supports the 2001 Gimpu specimen series, comparisons of pelage, anatomy and proportions, duet-song description, and local records near Gimpu, Lempelero, Tomua and Marena. The authors’ proposed outer limits were explicitly tentative.
scope.zh: 支持 2001 年 Gimpu 标本系列、毛色与解剖和比例比较、二重唱描述，以及 Gimpu、Lempelero、Tomua、Marena 附近的局地记录；作者提出的外围界限明确仍待确认。

limitations.en: The cited description is based on a small specimen series and a bounded field area; current range limits and broader ecology are not established here. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 所引描述基于小型标本系列和有限野外区域；本页不据此确定当前分布界限或更广泛生态。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: A two-month exploratory study in 2008 found a group of at least four at Mt. Rore Katimbu, in the mossy cloud forest of Lore Lindu National Park. The site was around 2,100 m elevation; the paper contrasts this highland setting with lowland Sulawesi tarsier studies.
text.zh: 2008 年一项为期两个月的探索研究，在 Lore Lindu 国家公园苔藓云雾林中的 Rore Katimbu 山发现至少四只组成的一群。研究地点海拔约 2,100 米；论文将这一高地环境与苏拉威西低地眼镜猴研究作比较。

text.en: Researchers captured three adults from the group. During limited observations, the animals returned to the same sleeping tree and were heard vocalizing or scent-marking infrequently; the paper presents these as preliminary contrasts, not fixed species-wide rules.
text.zh: 研究者从该群体捕获三只成体。在有限观察中，个体返回同一睡眠树，发声或气味标记较少；论文将其作为初步对照，并非全种固定规律。

text.en: The study was explicitly exploratory, with observations of one group and three captured animals. Proposed links between high-altitude resources and behavior remain hypotheses requiring broader samples.
text.zh: 该研究明确属于探索性工作，观察对象为一群体，捕获三只。高海拔资源与行为之间的联系仍是需要更大样本检验的假说。

scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级与分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

sources.title: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 — Tarsius pumilus

scope.en: Supports the English display name “Pygmy Tarsier” as an MDD vernacular; it does not establish ecological claims or override the pinned COL26.8 taxon.
scope.zh: 支持英文展示名“Pygmy Tarsier”作为 MDD 普通名；不据此推导生态结论或改动固定 COL26.8 分类。

sources.title: Grow & Gursky-Doyen (2010) — Preliminary data on the behavior, ecology, and morphology of pygmy tarsiers (Tarsius pumilus)

scope.en: A two-month exploratory study in August–September 2008 at Mt. Rore Katimbu in Lore Lindu National Park located one group of at least four; three adults were captured. Grouping, body-proportion and behavior findings are preliminary and based on very small samples.
scope.zh: 支持 2008 年 8—9 月在 Lore Lindu 国家公园 Rore Katimbu 山开展的两个月探索性研究：找到至少四只组成的一群，捕获三只成体。群体结构、身体比例和行为结论均为小样本初步发现。

limitations.en: The available field account is an exploratory study of one group at one mountain site; it cannot define the species’ full range or typical behavior. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 现有野外资料是在一处山地地点对单一群体开展的探索性研究，不能界定全种分布或典型行为。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

records.scientificName: Tarsius spectrumgurskyae Shekelle, Groves, Maryanto & Mittermeier, 2017

text.en: The 2017 description named the Manado form Tarsius spectrumgurskyae and emphasized duet-call form and specimen provenance in identifying northern Sulawesi tarsiers. Its type locality is Manado; the paper situates the species name within a regional biogeographic argument.
text.zh: 2017 年的描述将 Manado 形态群命名为 Tarsius spectrumgurskyae，并强调以二重唱形式和标本来源辨识苏拉威西北部眼镜猴。模式产地为 Manado；该命名属于区域生物地理讨论的一部分。

text.en: A later study analyzed duet recordings collected at Tangkoko National Park in July and August 2018. The authors’ classifier identified female phrases to individuals more accurately than male phrases (80% versus 64%); female timing also varied more in the sampled duet contributions.
text.zh: 后续研究分析了 2018 年 7、8 月在 Tangkoko 国家公园采集的二重唱录音。作者的分类器辨认雌性片段个体的准确率高于雄性（80% 对 64%）；所采样二重唱中，雌性音节间隔变化也更大。

text.en: The acoustic results apply to the recorded pairs and study site, not all populations. Earlier behavior research published under T. spectrum should be mapped to this accepted name only when the studied population is identifiable.
text.zh: 声学结果适用于被录制的配对个体和研究地点，不代表所有种群。以 T. spectrum 发表的早期行为研究，只有在研究种群可以对应时才应映射到此接受名。

sources.title: Shekelle et al. (2017) — Two new tarsier species (Tarsiidae, Primates) and the biogeography of Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.en: Supports the naming of the Manado form as T. spectrumgurskyae, with duet-call and specimen provenance central to identification; the type locality is Manado. The paper places this taxonomic treatment in a northern-Sulawesi biogeographic argument, not a new population census.
scope.zh: 支持将 Manado 形态群命名为 T. spectrumgurskyae；辨识以二重唱和标本来源为重要依据，模式产地为 Manado。论文将该分类处理置于苏拉威西北部生物地理讨论中，并非新的种群普查。

sources.title: Clink et al. (2020) — Vocal individuality and rhythm in male and female duet contributions of a nonhuman primate

scope.en: Acoustic recordings from Tangkoko National Park in July–August 2018; female duet phrases were assigned to individuals at 80% accuracy and male phrases at 64% using the paper’s classifier. These are results for sampled recordings, not a species-wide communication rate.
scope.zh: 支持 2018 年 7—8 月 Tangkoko 国家公园的声学记录；论文分类器将雌性二重唱片段判给正确个体的准确率为 80%，雄性为 64%。这些是所采录音的结果，不代表全种交流率。

limitations.en: This page joins a taxonomic description with a later site-specific acoustic study; neither provides a range-wide natural-history account. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本页结合分类描述与后续地点限定的声学研究，二者均不构成全分布区自然史综述。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

records.scientificName: Tarsius supriatnai Shekelle, Groves, Maryanto & Mittermeier, 2017

text.en: The 2017 description named the Gorontalo form Tarsius supriatnai; the authors used duet-call form and provenance to distinguish northern Sulawesi taxa. Bumbulan in Gorontalo is the type locality cited in the species description.
text.zh: 2017 年的描述将 Gorontalo 形态群命名为 Tarsius supriatnai；作者以二重唱形式和来源地辨识苏拉威西北部类群。物种描述所列模式产地为 Gorontalo 的 Bumbulan。

text.en: A later Popayato-Paguat study compared nest trees in agricultural areas and secondary forest. Bamboo species were frequent nest trees in agricultural plots, while Schizostachyum lima and Calamus zollingeri were commonly used in the sampled secondary forest.
text.zh: 后续 Popayato-Paguat 研究比较了农业地和次生林中的巢树。农业样地常见巢树包括竹类；在所采样次生林中，常用巢树包括 Schizostachyum lima 与 Calamus zollingeri。

text.en: The authors revisited nest trees first recorded in 2018 and reported continued use of 42.9% in their site-fidelity survey. This percentage describes that local follow-up sample; it is not a species-wide fidelity rate.
text.zh: 作者复查了 2018 年首次记录的巢树，并在地点忠实度调查中报告仍有 42.9% 被使用。该比例仅描述当地追踪样本，不是全种忠实度。

scope.en: Supports the description of the Gorontalo form as T. supriatnai, the Bumbulan type locality, and the diagnostic use of duet-call form and provenance in the authors’ northern-Sulawesi classification.
scope.zh: 支持将 Gorontalo 形态群描述为 T. supriatnai、Bumbulan 模式产地，以及作者在苏拉威西北部分类中使用二重唱形式和来源地进行辨识。

sources.title: Zakaria et al. (2022) — Habitat preferences and site fidelity of Tarsius supriatnai in agricultural area and secondary forest of Popayato-Paguat Landscape

scope.en: Local nest-tree observations compared agricultural areas and secondary forest in Popayato-Paguat, Gorontalo. The paper reports different commonly used nest-tree plants by habitat and 42.9% continued use among nest trees surveyed for site fidelity; these results do not establish species-wide preferences.
scope.zh: 支持 Gorontalo 的 Popayato-Paguat 农业地与次生林巢树观察比较。论文报告不同生境中常见巢树植物不同，并记录后续忠实度调查仍使用 42.9% 的既有巢树；这些结果不构成全种偏好。

limitations.en: Habitat and site-fidelity findings come from one landscape and a limited nest-tree sample; they do not establish species-wide habitat preferences. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 栖地与地点忠实度结果来自一处景观和有限巢树样本，不能据此确立全种栖地偏好。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

records.scientificName: Tarsius tumpara Shekelle, Groves, Merker & Supriatna, 2008

text.en: The species was described from Siau Island using tail-tuft, pelage, skull and vocal characters. In comparison with T. sangirensis, the paper notes a shorter, sparser and lighter tail tuft, reduced tarsal fur, and differences in the morning duet.
text.zh: 该种依据 Siau 岛的尾簇、毛色、头骨和发声特征描述。与 T. sangirensis 相比，论文记载其尾簇较短、稀疏且颜色较浅，跗部毛较少，晨间二重唱也有差异。

text.en: The type locality is at the southern end of Siau. The 2008 paper had one holotype and one earlier museum skull; it explicitly reported that genetic data for the newly described species were unavailable.
text.zh: 模式产地位于 Siau 南端。2008 年论文涉及一件正模和一件较早的馆藏头骨，并明确说明当时没有该新描述物种的遗传数据。

text.en: Behavioral observations and conservation concerns in the description are historical and geographically limited. The paper does not provide a current island-wide population count.
text.zh: 描述中的行为观察和保护担忧具有历史与地点边界；论文没有提供当前全岛种群计数。

scope.en: Supports the Siau type locality and diagnosis based on tail tuft, pelage, skull and vocalizations. The paper reports no genetic data for the newly named species and describes only one holotype plus one earlier museum skull.
scope.zh: 支持 Siau 模式产地及以尾簇、毛色、头骨和鸣声为依据的诊断。论文没有提供该新描述物种的遗传数据，仅涉及一件正模和一件较早的馆藏头骨。

limitations.en: The taxonomic account is based on very few specimens and localized observations; it is not a current population or island-wide survey. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 分类描述依据极少标本和局地观察；它不是当前种群或全岛调查。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

records.scientificName: Tarsius wallacei Merker, Driller, Dahruddin, Wirdateti, Sinaga, Perwitasari-Farajallah & Shekelle, 2010

text.en: The species description combines genetic markers, pelage, tail-tuft traits and duet calls. In the field, the authors describe a yellow-brown coat, copper-colored throat and characteristic duet; genetic evidence distinguished the sampled taxon from neighboring forms.
text.zh: 物种描述综合遗传标记、毛色、尾簇特征和二重唱。野外辨识特征包括黄褐色被毛、铜色喉部和特征性二重唱；遗传证据将所采样类群与邻近形态区分。

text.en: The paper mapped separated northern and southern populations in Central Sulawesi, with Palu Bay and the city of Palu between them. The southern population was confirmed only at the type locality Uwemanje; boundaries in the paper reflect the authors’ surveys.
text.zh: 论文在苏拉威西中部标绘出分离的南北种群，两者之间为 Palu 湾和 Palu 城。南方种群仅在模式产地 Uwemanje 得到确认；论文界限对应作者当时的调查。

text.en: The two sampled populations differed in body size while sharing several diagnostic traits. The authors caution through their mapped limits that the southern extent and neighboring boundaries were not fully known.
text.zh: 两个采样种群体型存在差异，同时共享若干诊断特征。论文标绘范围也显示，南部延伸范围及邻近边界当时并未完全确定。

sources.title: Merker et al. (2010) — Tarsius wallacei: A new tarsier species from Central Sulawesi occupies a discontinuous range

scope.en: Supports the species diagnosis from genetic markers, pelage, tail tuft and duet calls, and the authors’ mapped northern and southern populations. Their southern population was confirmed only at the type locality; northern boundaries and the gap around Palu are study-era survey limits.
scope.zh: 支持以遗传标记、毛色、尾簇和二重唱为依据的物种诊断，以及作者标绘的南北两个种群。论文仅在模式产地确认南方种群；北界及 Palu 周围的间隔均受当时调查所限。

limitations.en: Distribution and population contrasts are bounded to the authors’ survey localities; the paper does not establish present-day range limits. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 分布与种群差异限于作者调查地点；论文没有确立当前分布边界。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

records.scientificName: Tarsius niemitzi Shekelle, Groves, Maryanto, Mittermeier, Salim & Springer, 2019

text.en: The 2019 description is anchored by a single adult-male holotype collected at Desa Benteng on Togean Island in 2009. The authors’ diagnosis draws on the island population’s provenance, duet call and 12S mitochondrial sequence evidence.
text.zh: 2019 年的描述以 2009 年在 Togean 岛 Desa Benteng 采集的一件成年雄性正模为依据。作者的诊断还使用岛屿种群来源地、二重唱和 12S 线粒体序列证据。

text.en: The paper describes a comparatively simple duet structure: a female call followed by two or three male calls, and reports the Togean form as a monophyletic group in its 12S analysis. The genetic result concerns the sampled sequences, not a complete population-genetic survey.
text.zh: 论文描述了相对简单的二重唱结构：雌性发声后接两到三次雄性发声；其 12S 分析将 Togean 形态群恢复为单系群。遗传结果限于所采序列，不是完整群体遗传调查。

text.en: The authors proposed occurrence across the Togean Islands except Una Una. Because the available hypodigm was a single specimen, the proposed distribution should be read as a literature-based taxonomic range statement, not a systematic census of every island.
text.zh: 作者提出其分布覆盖 Togean 群岛，Una Una 除外。由于可用标本系列仅有一件，该范围应视为基于文献的分类范围陈述，不是对各岛逐一开展的系统普查。

sources.title: Shekelle et al. (2019) — A new tarsier species from the Togean Islands of Central Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.en: Supports the holotype from Desa Benteng on Togean, the authors’ 12S mtDNA phylogeny and diagnosis, and their proposed Togean distribution except Una Una. The paper states that only the type specimen was available; mapped distribution is not a uniform island-by-island census.
scope.zh: 支持 Togean Desa Benteng 的正模、作者的 12S 线粒体 DNA 系统树和诊断，以及其提出的除 Una Una 外的 Togean 分布。论文说明当时仅有正模标本；分布图并非逐岛统一普查。

limitations.en: The description had one available type specimen; genetic and vocal evidence rely partly on previously published material, and the mapped island distribution is not a census. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 描述时仅有一件正模；遗传和发声证据部分依赖先前发表资料，标绘岛屿分布也不是普查。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: Use these pages as a route through unlike kinds of evidence, not as a complete genus review. Start with field ecology: the high-elevation, single-group study of T. pumilus and the land-use comparison for T. dentatus (published as T. dianae). Continue with the diagnostic calls and limited field records for T. lariang and the two sampled T. wallacei populations. Finish with island forms described mainly through specimens and vocal evidence: T. tumpara on Siau, T. niemitzi on Togean, and the northern Sulawesi names T. spectrumgurskyae and T. supriatnai. These studies differ in dates, sample sizes and methods; their results are not standardized or interchangeable.
text.zh: 这组页面串联的是不同证据类型，不是完整属级综述。先读野外生态：高海拔单群体的 T. pumilus 研究，以及使用旧名 T. dianae 的 T. dentatus 土地利用比较；再看 T. lariang 的诊断鸣声和有限野外记录，以及 T. wallacei 两个采样种群。最后阅读主要依据标本和声音证据描述的岛屿形态群：Siau 的 T. tumpara、Togean 的 T. niemitzi，以及苏拉威西北部命名的 T. spectrumgurskyae 和 T. supriatnai。研究年代、样本量和方法不同，结果不可标准化或互换。

sources.title: Merker, Yustian & Mühlenberg (2005) — Responding to forest degradation: altered habitat use by Dian’s tarsier Tarsius dianae in Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.en: Four study plots across a human land-use gradient; the study captured 71 tarsiers and radio-tracked 30. Reported habitat, density, range-size and nightly-travel patterns are confined to those plots and the paper-era name T. dianae.
scope.zh: 支持四个不同人类土地利用样区的比较；研究捕获 71 只并对 30 只进行无线电追踪。栖地、密度、活动范围和夜间移动结果仅限这些样区，原文使用当时的名称 T. dianae。

sources.title: Merker et al. (2009) — Elucidating geological and biological processes underlying the diversification of Sulawesi tarsiers

scope.en: Supports the authors’ use of T. dentatus for the central-Sulawesi lineage often called T. dianae and the 2001–2006 transect study of 144 tarsiers between Kamarora and Peana; it is not a range-wide population survey.
scope.zh: 支持作者将常称为 T. dianae 的中苏拉威西谱系归入 T. dentatus，并记载 2001—2006 年 Kamarora 至 Peana 样线上的 144 只样本；这不是全分布区调查。

sources.title: Merker & Groves (2006) — Tarsius lariang: A new primate species from Western Central Sulawesi

scope.en: Supports the 2001 Gimpu specimen series, comparisons of pelage, anatomy and proportions, duet-song description, and local records near Gimpu, Lempelero, Tomua and Marena. The authors’ proposed outer limits were explicitly tentative.
scope.zh: 支持 2001 年 Gimpu 标本系列、毛色与解剖和比例比较、二重唱描述，以及 Gimpu、Lempelero、Tomua、Marena 附近的局地记录；作者提出的外围界限明确仍待确认。

scope.en: Supports the description of the Gorontalo form as T. supriatnai, the Bumbulan type locality, and the diagnostic use of duet-call form and provenance in the authors’ northern-Sulawesi classification.
scope.zh: 支持将 Gorontalo 形态群描述为 T. supriatnai、Bumbulan 模式产地，以及作者在苏拉威西北部分类中使用二重唱形式和来源地进行辨识。

sources.title: Zakaria et al. (2022) — Habitat preferences and site fidelity of Tarsius supriatnai in agricultural area and secondary forest of Popayato-Paguat Landscape

scope.en: Local nest-tree observations compared agricultural areas and secondary forest in Popayato-Paguat, Gorontalo. The paper reports different commonly used nest-tree plants by habitat and 42.9% continued use among nest trees surveyed for site fidelity; these results do not establish species-wide preferences.
scope.zh: 支持 Gorontalo 的 Popayato-Paguat 农业地与次生林巢树观察比较。论文报告不同生境中常见巢树植物不同，并记录后续忠实度调查仍使用 42.9% 的既有巢树；这些结果不构成全种偏好。

sources.title: Shekelle et al. (2008) — Tarsius tumpara: A new tarsier species from Siau Island, North Sulawesi

scope.en: Supports the Siau type locality and diagnosis based on tail tuft, pelage, skull and vocalizations. The paper reports no genetic data for the newly named species and describes only one holotype plus one earlier museum skull.
scope.zh: 支持 Siau 模式产地及以尾簇、毛色、头骨和鸣声为依据的诊断。论文没有提供该新描述物种的遗传数据，仅涉及一件正模和一件较早的馆藏头骨。

sources.title: Merker et al. (2010) — Tarsius wallacei: A new tarsier species from Central Sulawesi occupies a discontinuous range

scope.en: Supports the species diagnosis from genetic markers, pelage, tail tuft and duet calls, and the authors’ mapped northern and southern populations. Their southern population was confirmed only at the type locality; northern boundaries and the gap around Palu are study-era survey limits.
scope.zh: 支持以遗传标记、毛色、尾簇和二重唱为依据的物种诊断，以及作者标绘的南北两个种群。论文仅在模式产地确认南方种群；北界及 Palu 周围的间隔均受当时调查所限。

sources.title: Shekelle et al. (2019) — A new tarsier species from the Togean Islands of Central Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.en: Supports the holotype from Desa Benteng on Togean, the authors’ 12S mtDNA phylogeny and diagnosis, and their proposed Togean distribution except Una Una. The paper states that only the type specimen was available; mapped distribution is not a uniform island-by-island census.
scope.zh: 支持 Togean Desa Benteng 的正模、作者的 12S 线粒体 DNA 系统树和诊断，以及其提出的除 Una Una 外的 Togean 分布。论文说明当时仅有正模标本；分布图并非逐岛统一普查。

limitations.en: This reading path selects eight species and local studies; it is not an exhaustive account of Tarsius or a genus-wide ecological comparison. This page is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 本阅读路径选择八个物种和局地研究，不是 Tarsius 全属综述，也不是属级生态比较。 本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.zh: 在银叶猴群的线粒体研究中，作者从 115 只个体取得 573 bp 的细胞色素 b 序列，其中 68 只具有已知来源地。研究中的 *T. auratus* 样本属于五个主要单系谱系之一。作者估计这五个谱系在约 0.95–1.25 百万年前发生近似辐射式分化，并提出把五个谱系作为独立种。这个时间估计适用于谱系间分化模型，并不是本种起源或现今种群分化的直接测量。
text.en: In a mitochondrial study of the silvered-langur group, the authors sequenced a 573-bp cytochrome-b fragment from 115 animals, 68 of known origin. The sampled *T. auratus* formed one of five main monophyletic clades. The authors estimated a near-radiation among those clades about 0.95–1.25 million years ago and proposed treating them as separate species. That estimate concerns the modeled separation among clades, not the origin of this species or present-day population structure.

text.zh: 2004 年的研究指出，*T. barbei* 此前主要依据馆藏标本与野外记录而知；作者发现一只动物园个体，并将其作为 1967 年以来该种持续存在的首个确认记录。论文描述了此前未充分记录的头骨、体毛和体色特征，提供了区分该种的首批分子证据，并汇编已知地点绘制分布图。动物园标本和历史地点汇编都不能代替现今野外种群调查。
text.en: A 2004 study noted that *T. barbei* had been known mainly from museum specimens and field observations. The authors located a zoo animal and presented it as the first confirmed evidence of the species' continued existence since 1967. They described previously undocumented cranial, pelage and coloration features, provided the first molecular evidence used to distinguish the species, and mapped compiled known localities. A zoo specimen and historical locality map do not substitute for a current wild-population survey.

text.zh: 研究者在中国西南部无量山原生常绿林，于 2012 年 6 月至 2016 年 1 月观察一个群体。该群体通常在树上活动，地面活动约占时间的 2.9%，主要与食土行为有关；休息时偏用较高层位，移动时多在 20 米以下。论文另以六种叶猴作森林覆盖与地面活动比较。无量山单群观察不能代表本种所有栖地或行为。
text.en: Researchers followed one group in primary evergreen forest on Mt. Wuliang in southwest China from June 2012 to January 2016. The group was typically arboreal, spending about 2.9% of observed time on the ground, mainly during geophagy. It preferred higher strata while resting and usually moved below 20 m. The paper also compared forest cover and terrestriality across six langur species. One Mt. Wuliang group does not represent all habitats or behavior of this species.

text.zh: Roos、Nadler 与 Walter 的 2008 年分析把 *T. germaini* 的样本归入五个单系谱系之一。研究使用 115 只银叶猴的 573 bp 线粒体细胞色素 b 片段，其中 68 只采集地点可考；作者提出五个谱系分别代表独立种。摘要同时指出谱系之间的亲缘次序没有清楚解析，因此这项结果支持样本在该标记上的分组，不应改写成已确定的物种树或全域种群边界。
text.en: Roos, Nadler and Walter's 2008 analysis placed sampled *T. germaini* in one of five monophyletic lineages. The study used a 573-bp mitochondrial cytochrome-b fragment from 115 langurs, 68 with known collection origins, and proposed that the five lineages represented separate species. The authors also reported that relationships among the lineages were not well resolved. The result describes grouping at this marker, not a settled species tree or range-wide population boundary.

text.zh: 在 2008 年的银叶猴群研究里，*T. margarita* 样本形成五个主要单系线粒体谱系中的一支。作者对 115 只个体测得 573 bp 细胞色素 b 片段，68 只有已知来源地；分析提出五个谱系分别作为种处理，但谱系间的分化次序并未解析。这里呈现的是研究中的遗传分组与分类提案，不能据一段线粒体序列重建该种的完整历史或分布。
text.en: In the 2008 study of the silvered-langur group, sampled *T. margarita* formed one of five main monophyletic mitochondrial clades. The authors sequenced a 573-bp cytochrome-b fragment from 115 animals, 68 of known origin. They proposed treating the five clades as separate species but did not resolve their branching order. This page reports the study's genetic grouping and taxonomic proposal; one mitochondrial fragment cannot reconstruct the species' full history or range.

text.zh: Roos、Nadler 与 Walter 在 115 只银叶猴的 573 bp 线粒体细胞色素 b 数据中，识别出包括 *T. mauritius* 在内的五个主要单系谱系。作者将各谱系作为独立种的分类解释，并估计它们在约 0.95–1.25 百万年前近似辐射式分化；研究没有解析谱系间的确切次序。作者关于该类群起源于爪哇、随后扩展的叙事是群体层级假说，不能单独作为本种的迁徙史。
text.en: In 573-bp mitochondrial cytochrome-b data from 115 silvered langurs, Roos, Nadler and Walter identified five main monophyletic lineages, including *T. mauritius*. They proposed treating each lineage as a separate species and estimated a near-radiation among them about 0.95–1.25 million years ago, while leaving their exact relationships unresolved. Their broader scenario of an origin on Java followed by expansion concerns the group and is not, by itself, a migration history for this species.

text.zh: Roos 等人从地理定位的粪便样本和馆藏标本取得 41 个线粒体基因组，其中包括两个正模。他们在当时归入 *T. phayrei* 的材料中识别出西部、中央和东部三个地理谱系；中央谱系边界尚不清楚，一处寺院样本还同时出现中央与东部谱系。该研究依据线粒体、形态和生态差异提出重新划分名称与种级范围；页面仍按固定 COL26.8 接受名保留本条身份，不把论文提案写成唯一分类。
text.en: Roos and colleagues analyzed 41 mitochondrial genomes from georeferenced fecal samples and museum specimens, including two holotypes. In material then assigned to *T. phayrei*, they identified West, Central and East geographic clades. The Central boundary remained uncertain, and samples at one monastery included both Central and East haplotypes. The paper proposed revised names and species limits using mitochondrial, morphological and ecological differences. This page retains the fixed COL26.8 identity and does not present that proposal as the only classification.

text.zh: Gogoi 等人于 2019 年 2 月至 2020 年 1 月调查印度阿萨姆上布拉马普特拉河谷的 40 片雨林残片，只在其中 11 片确认到帽叶猴。占域模型显示，食物树种多样性与物种出现的关系最强。结果反映一个河谷地区、一个调查期内林斑的占域情况，不是整个物种分布区的数量普查，也不能单独证明树种多样性造成了有无差异。
text.en: From February 2019 to January 2020, Gogoi and colleagues surveyed 40 rainforest fragments in Assam's Upper Brahmaputra Valley and confirmed capped langurs in 11. Their occupancy models found the strongest association with food-tree diversity. The result describes fragment occupancy in one valley during one survey period; it is not a range-wide abundance census and does not by itself show that tree diversity caused the presence or absence pattern.

text.zh: 在 2008 年的研究中，*T. cristatus* 样本分成两个主要线粒体谱系：一支包括苏门答腊、婆罗洲与纳土纳群岛样本，另一支只包括马来半岛样本。作者把半岛群体命名为 *T. cristatus selangorensis*，采用亚种等级；本页的身份则遵循 COL26.8 接受名 *T. selangorensis*。研究基于 573 bp 的线粒体片段，故这里明确记录分类等级差异，不把它说成已由全基因组证据解决。
text.en: In the 2008 study, *T. cristatus* samples fell into two main mitochondrial clades: one included specimens from Sumatra, Borneo and the Natuna archipelago, while the other contained only Malay Peninsula specimens. The authors named the peninsula form *T. cristatus selangorensis* at subspecies rank; this page follows the COL26.8 accepted name *T. selangorensis*. Because the analysis used a 573-bp mitochondrial fragment, the rank difference is recorded rather than presented as resolved by genome-wide evidence.

The Chinese common name is an editorial translation; the page has not received external expert review.

records.scientificName: Trachypithecus popa Roos, Helgen et al., 2020

text.zh: 2020 年的正式描述把该种与缅甸中部干旱区的历史标本和新采样材料联系起来。正模是一只 1913 年 9 月采自波帕山的成年雄性皮张和头骨，研究取得其线粒体基因组，并与 *T. phayrei*、论文所称的 *T. melamera* 比较形态。作者提出的分布位于伊洛瓦底江与萨尔温江之间，同时指出东北边界未定。标本与有限采样支持了描述，但文中的数量估计并非当前普查。
text.en: The 2020 formal description linked this species to historical specimens and newly sampled material from central Myanmar's dry zone. Its holotype is an adult male skin and skull collected on Mount Popa in September 1913; the study sequenced its mitochondrial genome and compared its morphology with *T. phayrei* and the paper's *T. melamera*. The authors placed the proposed range between the Ayeyarwaddy and Thanlwin rivers but left the northeastern boundary unresolved. The specimens support the description; population figures in the paper are not a current census.

limitations.en: The type specimen, museum comparisons and survey material support the paper's taxonomic description; range limits and historical estimates remain bounded, not a complete current range or census. The Chinese common name is an editorial translation; the page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: COL26.8 将纳土纳叶猴列为接受种。Lammertink、Nijman 与 Setiorini 于 2003 年在 Bunguran 岛做了为期两个月的调查；当时记录将该种限制在岛上林地，且更常见于低地原生林斑块。
text.en: COL26.8 lists the Natuna Islands Langur as an accepted species. Lammertink, Nijman and Setiorini surveyed Bunguran for two months in 2003; their records confined the langur to forest and found it more often in primary lowland forest patches.

text.zh: 该次调查的群体平均约 3.5 只，样区密度估计为每平方公里 2.3 群。作者曾据此外推岛上总量，但这是 2003 年的调查估算，不能当作当前数量。林斑偏好来自当时的样线数据，也不代表今日每个岛屿地点。
text.en: Groups averaged about 3.5 individuals in that survey, with an estimated density of 2.3 groups per km² in sampled areas. The authors extrapolated an island total, but this was a 2003 survey estimate, not a current count. The forest-patch preference is likewise limited to the transect data then collected.

limitations.en: Evidence is concentrated in a short 2003 survey on Bunguran; it does not update current abundance, trends or island-wide distribution. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: Fuentes 在北巴盖岛的原生林调查了 10 个群体。观察中的叶猴主要在林冠上层取食、移动和休息；日移动距离从约 100 米到超过 1 公里，报告家域不超过 40 公顷。以上都是该地点的研究结果。
text.en: Fuentes studied ten groups in primary forest on North Pagai Island. The langurs used the upper canopy chiefly for feeding, movement and rest; daily travel ranged from about 100 m to more than 1 km, and reported home ranges were no larger than 40 ha. These are site-specific study results.

text.zh: 研究群体以藤本植物和龙脑香科树木为主要食物来源，取食以叶为主，同时也吃果实和其他植物部分。研究记录显示清晨和午后各有取食高峰。单一岛屿上的 10 群观察适合作为具体行为案例，不应直接改写成整个明打威群岛的固定食谱。
text.en: The studied groups fed mainly on climbers and dipterocarp trees, taking mostly leaves but also fruit and other plant parts. The observations recorded feeding peaks in early morning and mid-afternoon. Ten groups on one island provide a concrete behavior case, not a fixed diet for all Mentawai populations.

limitations.en: Behavior and ranging evidence comes from one North Pagai study; it does not represent every island population. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 当前 COL26.8 将西伯鲁叶猴单列为接受种；较早的生态论文则把西伯鲁岛样本写作 P. potenziani。Hadi 等人在北西伯鲁 Peleonan 林比较了两群当时如此标注的叶猴与三群 simakobu。由于采样早于现行分种处理，本页把它作为西伯鲁岛历史研究记录，而非现代 P. siberu 的全种估算。
text.en: COL26.8 currently lists the Siberut Langur as a separate accepted species, whereas an earlier ecological paper labelled Siberut animals P. potenziani. Hadi et al. compared two langur groups so labelled in Peleonan Forest, North Siberut, with three groups of simakobu. Because sampling predates the present split, this page treats it as a historical Siberut field record, not a species-wide estimate for modern P. siberu.

text.zh: 在该混合原生林样区，论文报告两种叶猴家域重叠；当时记作 P. potenziani 的群体较常使用 20 米以上林冠、取食偏向果实。研究只有两群这一旧分类标签下的叶猴，地点和身份映射都限制了外推。
text.en: In the mixed primary forest study area, the paper reported overlapping ranges between the two langurs. Groups then labelled P. potenziani used canopy above 20 m more often and selected fruit more than simakobu. Only two langur groups were studied under that older label, limiting both site and taxonomic extrapolation.

limitations.en: The main ecological record uses the pre-split name P. potenziani; the page relates it to current P. siberu only through study locality and does not treat it as a modern species-wide conclusion. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 北婆罗洲一项长期分类与生态研究比较了何氏叶猴及相关类群的鸣声、头骨、毛色和分子资料。Ramlee 的论文报告 P. hosei 与 P. sabana 的雄性响亮叫声存在明显差异，并主张把 P. sabana 区分到种级；COL26.8 也将其作为接受种列出。
text.en: A long-running North Borneo taxonomic and ecological study compared calls, crania, pelage and molecular data in Hose's langur and related forms. Ramlee reported marked differences between the male loud calls of P. hosei and P. sabana and argued for species-level distinction; COL26.8 also lists P. sabana as accepted.

text.zh: 这项博士研究历时 18 个月，但其野外生态资料主要针对 P. hosei；对 P. sabana 的本页导读集中在比较鸣声与分类讨论。它不能替代沙巴种群普查，也不提供完整种级食谱或数量。
text.en: The doctoral study spanned 18 months, but its field ecology chiefly concerned P. hosei. This page's account of P. sabana is limited to comparative calls and taxonomy; it is not a Sabah population survey or a complete species diet or abundance account.

limitations.en: Direct field evidence for P. sabana is limited in this source set; the doctoral study chiefly focused on P. hosei. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: Bintan 的一项 2024 年研究沿用亚种名 P. siamensis rhionis。作者在 2022 年北部旅游区的红树林、低地次生林及混合林地调查四天、共 12 小时，并整理了 2021—2022 年观察。看到的个体分布集中在调查较多的西北部；这并非全岛普查。
text.en: A 2024 Bintan study used the subspecies name P. siamensis rhionis. The authors surveyed mangroves, lowland secondary forest and mixed forest for four days and 12 hours in the island's northern tourism area in 2022, adding observations from 2021–2022. Records clustered in the better-surveyed northwest; this was not an island-wide census.

text.zh: 作者从现场观察与居民报告中整理出 8 种食物植物，并估计群体通常有 4—8 只；红树林观察包括取食木果楝和红树植物。另一项 2020 年研究只获得一份标作 P. siamensis cf. cana 的苏门答腊粪样，其线粒体结果不能直接套到 Bintan 的 rhionis。
text.en: The authors compiled eight food plants from field observations and resident reports and estimated groups of about 4–8 individuals; mangrove records included feeding on Xylocarpus and Rhizophora. A separate 2020 study used only one Sumatran faecal sample labelled P. siamensis cf. cana; its mitochondrial result should not be transferred to Bintan rhionis.

limitations.en: The sources concern different locations and taxonomic units: brief observations of Bintan rhionis and a single Sumatran cf. cana genetic sample cannot be combined into one species-wide range. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 一项 2024 年学士论文在南打巴努里 Martabe 金矿区邻近林地，比较苏门答腊黑叶猴与银叶猴的局地栖地使用。作者报告两者家域重叠超过一半，主要使用 6—20 米冠层；研究没有观察到清晰的种间竞争证据。
text.en: A 2024 bachelor's thesis compared local habitat use by the Black Sumatran Langur and silvered langur in forest near the Martabe mine area of South Tapanuli. The authors reported more than 50% home-range overlap and predominant use of the 6–20 m canopy; they found no clear evidence of interspecific competition.

text.zh: 这是工业区邻近林地的一项局地研究，不能说明全苏门答腊的家域、竞争关系或数量趋势；本页也不据此推断两种叶猴长期共存的机制。
text.en: This is a local study in forest near an industrial area. It does not establish home ranges, competition or abundance trends across Sumatra, and this page does not infer the mechanism of long-term coexistence.

limitations.en: The main ecological evidence is a local study in a 2024 bachelor's thesis, not a species-wide survey. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 一项长达 12.5 年的野外研究记录托马斯叶猴的生活史：成功育幼后平均再生间隔约 26.8 个月，纳入未存活幼体后总体均值约 22 个月；幼体第一年的死亡率最高。它们是研究期估计，不是现今所有种群的固定参数。
text.en: A 12.5-year wild study recorded Thomas's Langur life history: the mean interval after a surviving infant was about 26.8 months, falling to about 22 months when births after non-surviving infants were included; mortality was highest in the first year. These are study-period estimates, not fixed parameters for every current population.

text.zh: 另一项分析聚焦稳定的中期群体阶段，发现群体较大时日行程和家域也较大，但取食、休息与梳理时间没有相应改变。作者讨论雄性更替和杀婴风险可能影响群体规模；这个解释依赖特定社会阶段，不能简化成所有群体的普遍规则。
text.en: A second analysis focused on stable middle-tenure groups. Larger groups had longer day journeys and larger home ranges, without corresponding changes in feeding, resting or grooming time. The authors discussed male takeovers and infanticide risk as possible influences on group size; that interpretation is tied to a particular social phase, not a universal rule.

scope.en: Supports relationships among group size, ranging and behavior during the stable group phase in wild Thomas's langurs; not every social phase.

scope.en: Supports interbirth intervals, age and infant-mortality records from a 12.5-year wild study; these are study-period data, not a current population trend.

limitations.en: Life-history and group relationships come from specific study periods and group phases; they do not represent every site or current trends. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: Iqbal 等人整理的记录将黑白叶猴分布置于苏门答腊 Indragiri 河与 Batanghari 河之间，并增补了该范围内的地点资料。研究汇总了 2016 年 1 月至 2022 年 4 月的已发表及未发表观察，因此展示的是资料收集范围，不是连续的区域普查。
text.en: Records compiled by Iqbal et al. place the Black-and-white Langur between the Indragiri and Batanghari rivers in Sumatra and add sites within that area. The paper assembled published and unpublished observations from January 2016 to April 2022; this is a record-collection window, not continuous regional monitoring.

text.zh: 研究确认了在橡胶林环境中取食橡胶树叶，也记录了芒果叶及其他植物。作者据此认为它能在部分退化林地生存，但证据来自特定观察地点，不能说明所有人工林都适合作为栖地。
text.en: The study confirmed feeding on rubber-tree leaves in rubber-plantation settings and recorded mango leaves and other plants. The authors inferred that the langur can persist in some degraded forest, but observations at particular sites do not show that all plantations are suitable habitat.

text.zh: Lhota 等人 2011 年在东加里曼丹 Wehea 森林两处相距 4.2 公里的矿物泉点，通过隐蔽观察和相机记录到米勒叶猴。当时论文以旧组合 P. hosei canicrus 讨论它，并指出这批观察把已知地点向西扩展到 Wehea。
text.en: In 2011, Lhota et al. recorded Miller's Langur at two mineral springs 4.2 km apart in Wehea Forest, East Kalimantan, using concealed observation and camera traps. The paper used the older combination P. hosei canicrus and reported that these observations extended known records westward to Wehea.

text.zh: 矿物泉点提供了直接观察个体的机会，论文记录群体组成并用相机补充到访证据；这类集中于两个地点的观察不能换算成森林总体密度，也没有解决物种其余范围的边界。
text.en: The mineral springs provided opportunities for direct observations; the paper noted group composition and used cameras to supplement evidence of visits. Observations concentrated at two sites cannot be converted into forest-wide density and did not resolve the species' wider range boundaries.

limitations.zh: 主要野外证据来自 2011 年 Wehea 两处矿物泉点；原论文采用的是分种前名称。本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: The main field evidence comes from two Wehea mineral springs in 2011; the original paper used a pre-split name. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: Ang 等人 2020 年的研究沿用旧组合 P. femoralis robinsoni。作者指出当时公开的分子材料仅有一条来自马来西亚 Redang Panjang 的线粒体序列；在其比较中，三种线粒体划分方法均把该谱系与 P. f. femoralis 及 P. f. percura 分开。
text.en: Ang et al.'s 2020 study used the older combination P. femoralis robinsoni. The authors noted that the only publicly available molecular record then was one mitochondrial sequence from Redang Panjang, Malaysia; all three delimitation methods in their comparison separated this lineage from P. f. femoralis and P. f. percura.

text.zh: 这是分类研究对既有单条序列的比较，不是对罗宾逊带叶猴多个种群的新采样。线粒体结果可提示谱系差异，但不能单独说明整个物种的遗传变异、混合或边界。
text.en: This is a taxonomic comparison using one existing sequence, not new sampling across multiple Robinson's Banded Langur populations. Mitochondrial results can indicate lineage differences but do not alone describe species-wide genetic variation, admixture or boundaries.

scope.zh: 支持研究者对东苏门答腊旧组合 P. f. percura 的线粒体基因组分析及对既有 P. f. robinsoni 序列的比较；材料覆盖有限且仅为线粒体证据。
scope.en: Supports mitogenome analyses of the eastern Sumatran form then called P. f. percura and comparison with existing P. f. robinsoni sequence data; sampling is limited and mitochondrial only.

limitations.zh: 分类说明基于一条公开线粒体序列及研究者的比较分析；缺少多种群新采样。本页尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: The taxonomic account rests on one public mitochondrial sequence and comparative analysis; new multi-population sampling is lacking. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 东苏门答腊带叶猴曾作为带叶猴 P. femoralis 的亚种 P. f. percura 出现在研究文献中。Ang 等人 2020 年首次从东苏门答腊粪便样本构建该分类单元的线粒体基因组；8 份样本中有 1 份覆盖不足，未进入后续分析。
text.en: The East Sumatran Banded Langur appeared in earlier studies as the subspecies P. f. percura. In 2020, Ang et al. reconstructed the first mitogenomes for this taxon from eastern Sumatran faecal samples; one of eight samples had insufficient coverage and was excluded from further analysis.

text.zh: 在作者采用的多种划分方法中，P. f. percura 与 P. f. femoralis 被分作不同线粒体操作单元；论文报告的全线粒体最小遗传距离为 5.3%。这是母系标记上的分类证据，作者也指出仍需覆盖更多种群的资料来厘清边界。
text.en: Across several delimitation methods used by the authors, P. f. percura and P. f. femoralis formed separate mitochondrial operational units; the paper reported a minimum whole-mitogenome distance of 5.3%. This is evidence from a maternally inherited marker, and the authors noted the need for broader population sampling to clarify boundaries.

text.zh: Sainte Luce 沿海森林的月度样线监测在 2011—2018 年覆盖四个林片；其中 S17 只用于确认物种出现，长期趋势分析来自另外三个林片。研究累计步行 285 公里并记录 1,968 次狐猴观察；托马斯侏狐猴在三个林片中的总体观察数没有显著变化，最退化的 S7 林片则出现增加。
text.en: Monthly transect work at the Sainte Luce littoral forest covered four fragments from 2011 to 2018; S17 was used only to confirm presence, while trend analysis used the other three. Across 285 km of transects and 1,968 lemur observations, Thomas's dwarf lemurs showed no significant overall change across the monitored fragments, while detections increased in the most degraded fragment, S7.

limitations.en: Trends apply only to the monitored Sainte Luce fragments and study period; local stability cannot be generalized to the whole species or a current population estimate. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 2026 年 Tsinjoarivo 研究在高海拔森林片段 Andasivodihazo 跟踪 24 只佩戴项圈的侏狐猴，其中 13 只为克罗斯利侏狐猴、11 只为西布里侏狐猴。2011—2014 年冬眠前后观测显示，克罗斯利侏狐猴在该地点的家域较小、夜间移动距离较短，也更常出现在林缘和较退化地段；研究者还记录到其取食植物种类较多。
text.en: A 2026 study tracked 24 collared dwarf lemurs in the Andasivodihazo forest fragment at Tsinjoarivo: 13 Crossley's and 11 Sibree's dwarf lemurs. Observations before and after hibernation in 2011–2014 found smaller home ranges, shorter nightly movements, and more use of forest edges and degraded habitat by Crossley's dwarf lemurs at this site; researchers also recorded a more diverse diet.

scope.en: Supports a comparison of activity, space use and foraging in two species at one Tsinjoarivo forest fragment; samples were 13 C. crossleyi and 11 C. sibreei, not a species-wide comparison.

limitations.en: Results come from one high-altitude Tsinjoarivo fragment, 24 individuals, and 2011–2014 observations; they are not species-wide ecological rules or a current population trend. This page has not received external expert review.

text.zh: 马达加斯加野外研究记录到肥尾侏狐猴在树洞内冬眠约七个月。树洞隔热差时，动物体温会随环境温度大幅波动；隔热较好的树洞中，体温则相对稳定，并出现周期性苏醒。这说明冬眠微环境会改变体温模式，不能仅凭“冬眠”一词推定所有个体的热生理过程相同。
text.en: A field study in Madagascar documented fat-tailed dwarf lemurs hibernating in tree holes for about seven months. In poorly insulated holes, body temperature fluctuated with ambient temperature; in better-insulated holes it remained more stable, with periodic arousals. The study shows that hibernaculum conditions shape thermal patterns, so the word “hibernation” alone does not imply one uniform process.

text.zh: 多位点研究曾把若干外观或历史上命名的侏狐猴并入较少的遗传谱系；其中该研究把 C. adipicaudatus 归入肥尾侏狐猴，但认为 C. sibreei 与 C. minusculus 的状态仍缺少足够资料。2014 年修订则依据更广的样本提出不同的种级与候选种划分，反映属内分类至今存在证据解释分歧。
text.en: A multilocus study placed several historically named or morphologically distinct dwarf lemurs within fewer genetic lineages; it treated C. adipicaudatus as part of the fat-tailed dwarf lemur but considered evidence insufficient for C. sibreei and C. minusculus. A 2014 revision used broader sampling to propose different species and candidate-species boundaries, illustrating continuing disagreement over how evidence should be interpreted in the genus.

text.zh: 安布尔山一带的侏狐猴种群曾在 2005 年调查中采样，研究团队又于 2015 年 2 月取得补充标本。作者结合遗传和形态资料，将这批来自马达加斯加北部的材料描述为独立谱系并命名为安布尔山侏狐猴。该证据说明已研究样本的分类判断，不等于对北部所有森林都完成普查。
text.en: Dwarf lemurs around Montagne d'Ambre were sampled during a 2005 expedition, and the team obtained additional specimens in February 2015. Combining genetic and morphological evidence, the authors described the northern Madagascar material as an independent lineage, Montagne d'Ambre dwarf lemur. This supports the identification of studied samples, not a survey of every northern forest.

text.zh: 拉瓦索阿山脉的侏狐猴最初因比较遗传资料不足而被暂定为克罗斯利侏狐猴。Thiele 等人将马达加斯加南部九处地点的 51 只侏狐猴加入比较，分析线粒体与三段核基因资料；研究据此划分多个遗传亚群，并正式描述拉瓦索阿侏狐猴。论文的遗传判断针对已采样个体，不构成该属完整的野外分布图。
text.en: Dwarf lemurs from the Lavasoa Mountains were initially assigned provisionally to Crossley's dwarf lemur because comparative genetic data were limited. Thiele et al. added 51 dwarf lemurs from nine southern Madagascar sites and analysed mitochondrial and three nuclear loci; the study delineated genetic subgroups and formally described Lavasoa dwarf lemur. Its genetic conclusions concern sampled individuals, not a complete field map of the genus.

text.en: The name Lesser Iron-gray Dwarf Lemur was based on a museum holotype from Ambositra; the Natural History Museum catalogue records the specimen as a juvenile. A multilocus taxonomic study explicitly found the available evidence insufficient to assess the species' status. This page preserves the catalogue identity without adding behaviour, ecology, or a complete range unsupported by field observations.

records.scientificName: Cheirogaleus shethi Frasier, Lei, McLain, Taylor, Bailey et al., 2016

text.zh: Frasier 等人从马达加斯加北部干燥林和过渡林的材料中描述安卡拉纳侏狐猴，并用遗传差异及形态比较将其置于 C. medius 类群。原描述覆盖安卡拉纳、安德拉菲阿梅纳—安达瓦科埃拉和安娜拉梅拉等地点；其结论对应采集材料和当时调查范围。
text.en: Frasier et al. described Ankarana dwarf lemur from material in northern Madagascar's dry and transitional forests, using genetic divergence and morphological comparisons to place it in the C. medius group. The original account covered localities including Ankarana, Andrafiamena-Andavakoera, and Analamerana; its conclusions reflect the collected material and survey coverage at the time.

text.zh: 2017 年 SAVA 地区快速生物多样性调查在 10 处地点记录到该种，其中 9 处此前没有记录；Analamanara 的两处地点位于此前已知南界以南约 20 公里。该研究扩展了已知记录，不是连续分布的完整调查。
text.en: Rapid biodiversity assessments in the SAVA region in 2017 recorded the species at 10 sites, nine not previously known; two Analamanara sites were about 20 km south of its then-known southern limit. The study added occurrence records, not a complete survey of continuous distribution.

text.zh: 在东南马达加斯加 Mandena 的 25 公顷低地森林样区，Lahann 于 2002 年和 2003—2004 年两个雨季进行捕捉、无线电追踪和个体观察。研究识别出两个推定家庭群；个体体重和尾围在 11 月至次年 2 月增加，符合冬眠前储脂期。作者同时说明当地冬眠的准确开始时间和时长仍未确定。
text.en: At a 25-ha lowland forest site in Mandena, southeastern Madagascar, Lahann used capture, radio-tracking, and focal observations during rainy seasons in 2002 and 2003–2004. The study identified two presumed family groups; body mass and tail circumference increased from November to February, consistent with pre-hibernation fattening. The author also noted that the local timing and duration of hibernation remained unresolved.

text.zh: 2026 年 Tsinjoarivo 研究在 Andasivodihazo 森林片段跟踪 11 只西布里侏狐猴，并与同地 13 只克罗斯利侏狐猴比较。冬眠前后观测中，西布里侏狐猴夜间移动距离较长，较多使用片段西侧；家域平均值虽较大，但完整样本下差异未达到统计显著。研究者提醒小样本结果应谨慎解释。
text.en: A 2026 study tracked 11 Sibree's dwarf lemurs in the Andasivodihazo fragment at Tsinjoarivo and compared them with 13 Crossley's dwarf lemurs at the same site. During pre- and post-hibernation observations, Sibree's dwarf lemurs travelled farther at night and used the fragment's western area more often. Their mean home range was larger, but the full-sample difference was not statistically significant; the authors caution that the sample was small.

text.zh: Sibree 侏狐猴的分类历史与遗传证据并不完全一致。2009 年多位点研究把其线粒体数据放在 C. medius 谱系内，但形态分析未能明确解决归属；2010 年 Tsinjoarivo 研究则用 mtDNA 和核基因支持当地 C. sibreei-like 材料构成独立遗传类群。
text.en: The taxonomic history and genetic evidence for Sibree's dwarf lemur are not fully congruent. A 2009 multilocus study placed its mitochondrial data within the C. medius lineage but could not clearly resolve its position morphologically; a 2010 Tsinjoarivo study used mitochondrial and nuclear markers to support a distinct genetic clade for local C. sibreei-like material.

records.scientificName: Cheirogaleus grovesi McLain, Lei, Frasier, Taylor, Bailey, Roberts, Nash, Randriamanana, Mittermeier & Louis Jr., 2017

text.zh: 格罗夫斯侏狐猴的原始描述使用了 Ranomafana 与 Andringitra 国家公园采集的材料。作者结合遗传和形态分析，将该东南马达加斯加谱系从 C. crossleyi 类群中区分并正式描述为新种。两处国家公园是论文采样地；本页不把它们当作已经完整圈定的全种分布边界。
text.en: The original description of Groves's dwarf lemur used material collected in Ranomafana and Andringitra National Parks. Combining genetic and morphometric analyses, the authors distinguished the southeastern Madagascar lineage within the C. crossleyi group and formally described it as a new species. These parks are the paper's sampling localities, not a fully delimited range boundary.
