text.zh:
侏狐猴属是马达加斯加特有的夜行狐猴；尾部储脂和季节性冬眠是研究重点，但不同种的冬眠地点、时程与当地生态并不相同。属内物种边界有长期争议：2009 年多位点分析支持较少的主要遗传谱系，2014 年扩大 91 个体地理样本后提出新的种级与候选种划分，随后又陆续正式描述拉瓦索阿、安布尔山、安卡拉纳和格罗夫斯侏狐猴。这里的种页身份遵循 COL26.8 固定名录，并不把其接受数当作所有研究者认可的生物学共识。

推荐阅读路径：先读 Groeneveld 等人与 Lei 等人的相反分类解释，再看 Thiele、Lei、Frasier 和 McLain 等人的地点限定描述；之后用 Dausmann 的肥尾侏狐猴冬眠研究、Lahann 的大侏狐猴局地研究，以及 Blanco 等人对克罗斯利与西布里侏狐猴的同地比较理解生态差异。Hending 等人 2023 年汇集 1964—2020 年记录，但只对九个名录种中的三个建立生态位模型，因为另外六种的出现点不足；未建模不能解释为未分布。
text.en:
Dwarf lemurs are nocturnal primates endemic to Madagascar. Fat storage in the tail and seasonal hibernation are recurring research themes, but hibernation sites, timing, and local ecology differ. Species boundaries in the genus have long been disputed: a 2009 multilocus analysis supported fewer principal genetic lineages, while a 2014 revision that added geographic samples from 91 individuals proposed additional species and candidate species; Lavasoa, Montagne d'Ambre, Ankarana, and Groves's dwarf lemurs were formally described later. Page identities here follow pinned COL26.8 and do not turn its accepted count into a biological consensus.

Suggested path: compare the different taxonomic interpretations of Groeneveld et al. and Lei et al.; then read the locality-bounded descriptions by Thiele, Lei, Frasier, and McLain. Next, use Dausmann's hibernation study of the fat-tailed dwarf lemur, Lahann's local study of the greater dwarf lemur, and Blanco et al.'s same-site comparison of Crossley's and Sibree's dwarf lemurs to explore ecological differences. Hending et al. (2023) compiled records from 1964–2020 but modelled only three of nine catalogue species because the other six had too few occurrence points; a species not modelled is not a species shown to be absent.

records.scientificName: Avahi peyrierasi Zaramody, Fausser, Roos, Zinner, Andriaholinirina, Rabarivola, Norscia, Tattersall & Rumpler, 2006

text.en: The 2006 eastern-woolly-lemur study compared cytogenetic and mitochondrial material collected at eastern and western sites. Its type series for A. peyrierasi comprised tissue and DNA from eleven animals; the named type locality was Mahasoarivo near Ranomafana. The authors diagnosed the taxon against eastern congeners using mitochondrial cytochrome-b differences. These are the original study’s samples and taxonomic argument, not a modern range survey.
text.zh: 2006 年东部毛狐猴研究比较了东、西部地点采集的细胞遗传与线粒体材料。研究为佩里耶拉斯毛狐猴列出的模式系列包括 11 只动物的组织与 DNA 材料，模式地点为 Ranomafana 附近的 Mahasoarivo。作者用线粒体细胞色素 b 差异与其他东部近缘类群作鉴别。这些是原研究的样本和分类论证，不是现代分布调查。

text.en: A later genus-level analysis identified two mitochondrial types assigned to A. peyrierasi, including samples around Ranomafana, and called for additional work to resolve their relationships. The labels “type 2” and “type 3” describe that paper’s sampled lineages; they are not extra accepted COL species.
text.zh: 后续属级分析在 Ranomafana 周边样本中识别出两个被归入本种的线粒体类型，并指出还需进一步研究以厘清其关系。“类型 2”和“类型 3”是该论文对所采样谱系的称呼，并非 COL 另列的接受种。

text.en: The 2007 revision described A. betsileo from Bemosary Classified Forest in the Fandriana District. Its type series comprised three adults sampled on 13 and 15 July 2002, represented by curated blood, measurements and field photographs. The authors reported distinctive pelage and mitochondrial sequence attributes, but described the regional limits as tentative and called for surveys north and south of the type locality.
text.zh: 2007 年属级修订以 Fandriana 区 Bemosary 分类森林的材料描述贝齐莱奥毛狐猴。模式系列包括 2002 年 7 月 13 日和 15 日采样的三只成年个体，并保存血液、测量资料和野外照片。作者报告了可区分的毛色与线粒体序列特征，但将区域边界称为暂定，并建议在模式地点南北继续调查。

text.en: The 2005 description designated a live male captured and released at Bemaraha on 3 October 1991 as the holotype, and gave a type locality near Ambalarano. It distinguished the form by facial and forehead pelage characters. The description documents the basis for the name; it is not a modern population assessment.
text.zh: 2005 年描述将 1991 年 10 月 3 日在 Bemaraha 捕捉后放归的一只雄性活体指定为正模，并将 Ambalarano 附近列为模式地点。作者依据面部和额部毛色特征区分该类群。该描述说明命名依据，不是现代种群评估。

text.en: A 2006 field report summarized telemetry and indirect observations of one local group in October 1991. During 85 hours 10 minutes of indirect observation, researchers recorded 105 loud “vou-hy” calls; the report also described whistles and growls. It listed detections at two localities within Tsingy de Bemaraha. These historical observations do not establish current occupancy.
text.zh: 2006 年野外报告整理了 1991 年 10 月对一群当地个体的遥测和间接观察。在 85 小时 10 分钟的间接观察中，研究者记录到 105 次响亮的“vou-hy”叫声；报告还描述了口哨声和低吼声。当时在 Tsingy de Bemaraha 内记录了两个地点。这些历史观察不能证明当前占域。

text.en: In a one-month eastern Madagascar rainforest study, most observations followed one radio-collared male. The male’s recorded home range was 1.4 ha and appeared to be used by him and one female. All observed feeding during those follows was on leaves, and only leaves were found in fecal samples. This small, single-male study should not be read as a species-wide diet or ranging estimate.
text.zh: 一项为期一个月的马达加斯加东部雨林研究主要跟踪一只戴无线电项圈的雄兽。该雄兽记录的家域为 1.4 公顷，似由它和一只雌兽共同使用；跟踪期间观察到的取食均为叶片，粪样中也只发现叶片。这项单雄兽小样本研究不能代表全种食性或家域。

text.en: A 2026 study surveyed 18 unprotected forests using 97 nocturnal transects totalling 291.8 km, vegetation plots and 208 interviews. The authors detected A. laniger at each study site; the sites were described as representing about one third of the species’ range. This is evidence from the surveyed landscape, not a full-island census.
text.zh: 2026 年研究在 18 片未受保护的森林开展调查，使用 97 条夜间样线、累计 291.8 公里调查距离、植被样方和 208 次访谈。作者在全部研究地点记录到本种；这些地点据称约覆盖作者所述分布的三分之一。这是调查景观的证据，不是全岛普查。

limitations.en: The behavioural observations come mainly from one male in a one-month study; the newer survey covers selected unprotected forests only. This page has not received external expert review.

records.scientificName: Avahi meridionalis Zaramody, Fausser, Roos, Zinner, Andriaholinirina, Rabarivola, Norscia, Tattersall & Rumpler, 2006

text.en: The 2006 cytogenetic and mitochondrial revision distinguished a southern eastern-forest lineage and described A. meridionalis from material associated with Sainte Luce and Andohahela. The authors said that its boundaries with A. peyrierasi and the Manombo population required further study. In 2007, a genus-level revision treated A. meridionalis as a full species while noting that broader comparative sampling was still needed.
text.zh: 2006 年细胞遗传与线粒体修订区分了东部森林的南方谱系，并依据与 Sainte Luce 和 Andohahela 相关的材料描述南部毛狐猴。作者指出，本种与佩里耶拉斯毛狐猴及 Manombo 种群之间的边界还需进一步研究。2007 年属级修订将其列为独立种，同时指出仍需更广泛的比较采样。

records.scientificName: Avahi mooreorum Lei, Engberg, Andriantompohavana, McGuire, Mittermeier, Zaonarivelo, Brenneman & Louis Jr., 2008

text.en: The 2008 Masoala study used roughly 3,000 base pairs of mitochondrial sequence, alongside morphological and phenotypic characters, to diagnose Moore’s woolly lemur from material at Masoala National Park. Its authors said the taxon was then known only from the park and called for additional surveys to establish its northern limits. The type-series diagnosis is evidence about sampled animals, not a complete range description.
text.zh: 2008 年马苏阿拉研究结合约 3,000 个碱基对的线粒体序列、形态和表型特征，以马苏阿拉国家公园的材料诊断摩尔毛狐猴。作者当时称该类群仅见于公园，并建议继续调查其北界。模式系列的诊断针对所采动物，不是完整分布说明。

text.en: A later distance-sampling study walked 11 transects repeatedly, covering 33 km across four Masoala forest types. It estimated A. mooreorum density at 121.21 individuals/km² and reported a significant forest-type effect on abundance. The estimate belongs to that peninsula study and its sampling design.
text.zh: 后续距离抽样研究在马苏阿拉四类森林中重复步行 11 条样线，累计 33 公里。研究估计本种密度为每平方公里 121.21 只，并报告丰度与森林类型存在显著关系。该估计只适用于半岛研究及其抽样设计。

text.en: A 2000 geographic-variation study compared wild animals and museum skins and argued that western Avahi contained several geographically distinct pelage forms; it described A. unicolor as one of those forms. A later 2006 comparison included five A. occidentalis samples from Ampijoroa and Ankarafantsika. These records reflect the material available to those studies, not a present-day distribution survey.
text.zh: 2000 年地理变异研究比较了野外动物和博物馆皮张，认为西部毛狐猴中存在若干地理上不同的毛色型，并将其中一种描述为单色毛狐猴。2006 年后续比较纳入来自 Ampijoroa 和 Ankarafantsika 的五份本种样本。这些记录反映的是研究可用材料，不是现今分布调查。

text.en: The 2006 eastern-Avahi paper described the Manombo population as A. meridionalis ramanantsoavani, using a type series of eleven tissue and DNA samples from the reserve. The 2007 genus revision raised that form to species rank. This page follows the pinned COL26.8 species name; it preserves the earlier subspecies treatment as part of the taxonomic history.

text.en: The 2000 western-Avahi study examined geographic and pelage variation in wild subjects and museum skins and described A. unicolor from the Ampasindava region. A later genus-level comparison included western Avahi in mitochondrial and morphological analyses; the inferred sister relationship of A. cleesei varied between sequence fragments. The data support a study history, not a complete current range or a final resolution of all western species boundaries.

text.en:
Woolly lemurs are nocturnal Malagasy primates whose named diversity has changed as researchers combined mitochondrial sequences, cytogenetics, pelage, morphology, and calls. One eastern study compared 55 animals from 14 eastern and 3 western sites; a later revision analyzed approximately 3,000 bp of mitochondrial sequence with morphological and phenotypic evidence. A separate Masoala study described A. mooreorum. These are taxonomic samples from particular periods and places, not a current genus-wide range map.

Suggested reading path: read the 2006 eastern revision before the 2007 genus treatment to see how A. peyrierasi, A. meridionalis, and the Manombo form were interpreted, then compare the source-bounded pages for A. betsileo and A. mooreorum. For western forms, read the geographic and pelage study alongside later sequence comparisons; the latter report disagreement between fragments about the placement of A. cleesei. Finish with Harcourt’s single-male A. laniger follow and the short Bemaraha call study, keeping both tied to their local samples.
text.zh:
毛狐猴是马达加斯加的夜行灵长类；随着研究者结合线粒体序列、细胞遗传、毛色、形态和鸣声，属内已命名多样性不断变化。一项东部研究比较了来自东部 14 处和西部 3 处的 55 只动物；后续修订结合约 3,000 个碱基对的线粒体序列、形态与表型证据。另有马苏阿拉研究描述了摩尔毛狐猴。这些是特定时期和地点的分类样本，不是当前属级分布图。

推荐阅读路径：先读 2006 年东部修订，再读 2007 年属级研究，对照作者如何解释佩里耶拉斯毛狐猴、南部毛狐猴和 Manombo 类群；之后比较贝齐莱奥毛狐猴与摩尔毛狐猴的地点限定页面。西部类型可并读地理与毛色研究及后来的序列比较；后者报告不同序列片段对贝马拉哈毛狐猴位置的推断有分歧。最后阅读 Harcourt 对一只雄性东部毛狐猴的跟踪，以及 Bemaraha 的短期鸣声研究，始终保留地点和样本边界。

limitations.en: This guide covers only the nine species pages added here; it is not a complete genus-level taxonomy or range review. The cited studies use different classifications, samples and localities and should not be combined into a current overall estimate. Chinese names are editorial translations; this guide has not received external expert review.

text.zh: Marsh 的 2014 年修订记录了 20 张皮张和头骨的检查材料，模式地点为秘鲁 Loreto 的 Río Nanay、Santa Luisa（海拔 160 米）。Tirira 于 2023 年汇总七条厄瓜多尔记录，其中五条来自博物馆标本、两条来自近十年的野外照片；记录位于 Pastaza，海拔 180—405 米，向西超出此前秘鲁记录范围 200 多公里。该文仍建议实地确认南部和西部边界。
text.en: Marsh's 2014 revision examined 20 skins and skulls and gives the type locality as Santa Luisa on Peru's Río Nanay, Loreto, at 160 m. Tirira's 2023 account assembled seven Ecuadorian records: five museum specimens and two field photographs from the preceding decade. They place records in Pastaza at 180–405 m, more than 200 km west of the previously known Peruvian records. The paper still calls for field work on the southern and western limits.

text.zh: Marsh 于 2014 年沿用 Spix 图版所代表的名称，将僧面猴属若干材料处理为烧褐僧面猴；原模式个体已遗失，修订未能从原始出版物确定其采集国家或地点。Serrano-Villavicencio 与 Terra Garbino 于 2024 年重读法文原始描述，指出其中把模式地点写作 Solimões 河畔、Tabatinga 附近的 Tonantins 森林；他们据此质疑把 Ucayali 和上 Juruá 流域的种群归入该名，并提出暂按 P. monachus 处理这些种群。该文还认为 P. inusta 应与 P. hirsuta 同物异名。COL26.8 和当前 MDD 仍列接受种名，本页保留这个分类分歧。
text.en: Marsh's 2014 revision applied Spix's illustrated name to a set of saki populations; the original mounted specimen is lost, and the publication did not identify its country or locality. Serrano-Villavicencio and Terra Garbino reread Spix's French description in 2024 and placed the type locality at Tonantins forest near Tabatinga on the Solimões. They therefore questioned applying the name to Ucayali and upper Juruá populations, suggested treating those populations as P. monachus pending evidence, and argued that P. inusta is a synonym of P. hirsuta. COL26.8 and the current MDD still list the species name as accepted; this page preserves the disagreement.

text.zh: Marsh 于 2014 年将伊莎贝拉僧面猴作为新种描述，依据包括模式标本在内的博物馆材料与毛色比较。正模为一只成年雄兽，采自秘鲁 Loreto 的 Río Samiria、Santa Elena，海拔 130 米；副模也来自 Río Samiria 一带的 Pacaya-Samiria 保护区地点。这里的地点和样本说明该名称的原始依据，不代表现今完整分布。
text.en: Marsh described Isabel's saki as a new species in 2014, using museum material including the type specimen and pelage comparisons. The holotype is an adult male from Santa Elena on Peru's Río Samiria, Loreto, at 130 m; paratypes also came from sites in the Río Samiria region of Pacaya-Samiria. These localities and specimens document the name's original basis, not the full present-day range.

text.zh: Villalba、Páez 与 Palacios 汇整 2007—2015 年的机会性野外观察、馆藏与数据库记录，在哥伦比亚西部亚马孙地区得到 77 条记录。调查将已知记录向东扩至 Guaquirá 溪，并以一条约海拔 1,070 米的野外观察将该研究总结的高度上限提高到 1,100 米。作者指出 Caguán—Yarí 间河区及与 P. hirsuta 的接触地带仍待调查；这些数字是该研究整理的历史记录，不是持续监测。
text.en: Villalba, Páez and Palacios combined opportunistic field observations from 2007–2015 with museum and database records, assembling 77 records from western Amazonian Colombia. The study extended records eastward along Guaquirá Creek and raised the reported elevational limit to 1,100 m based on a field observation near 1,070 m. The authors identified the Caguán–Yarí interfluve and the contact area with P. hirsuta as survey gaps; these are compiled records, not continuous monitoring.

text.zh: Aquino 等人在 2012 年 11—12 月沿秘鲁 Río Curaray 两岸的四个地点开展 610 公里样线调查。作者依 Marsh 的 2014 年分类识别种类；研究记录到 16 次纳波僧面猴目击，仅在河流北岸发现，其中六次有完整群体计数，观察群体为 2—7 只，均值 4.5 只。这个单一流域的短期样线结果不能外推为全种分布或种群规模。
text.en: Aquino and colleagues walked 610 km of transects at four sites on both banks of Peru's Río Curaray in November–December 2012. They followed Marsh's 2014 taxonomy and recorded 16 P. napensis sightings, only north of the river. Six encounters had complete counts; observed groups ranged from 2 to 7 animals, with a mean of 4.5. This short transect survey in one basin is not a species-wide range or population estimate.

scope.en: Supports a 2012, four-site, 610 km transect survey in one basin and its local species records; not a species-wide inference.

text.zh: Marsh 于 2014 年依据外观差异将莱兰兹白面僧面猴作为新种处理。Orsini 等在 2017 年报告马托格罗索州同一半落叶林片的三次观察：2013 年一只成年雄兽，2014 年两只雌兽，这些是向南的新记录。Serrano-Villavicencio 等于 2019 年比较了分布区九个博物馆收藏的 54 张皮张，认为该组只有与地理分隔种群对应的两组可诊断毛色，并将 P. rylandsi 作为 P. irrorata 的异名。COL26.8 仍列接受种；当前 MDD 将该名列作异名，本页并列呈现两种处理。
text.en: Marsh treated Rylands' bald-faced saki as a new species in 2014 based on pelage differences. Orsini and colleagues reported three observations in the same semideciduous forest fragment in Mato Grosso: one adult male in 2013 and two females in 2014, adding a southern record. Serrano-Villavicencio and colleagues compared 54 skins from nine museum collections across the group in 2019; they recognized two diagnosable pelage groups corresponding to geographically isolated populations and treated P. rylandsi as a synonym of P. irrorata. COL26.8 still lists it as accepted, while the current MDD lists it as a synonym; this page presents both treatments.

text.zh: Marsh 于 2014 年将凡佐利尼白面僧面猴从 P. irrorata 的亚种提升为种。Serrano-Villavicencio 等在 2019 年重新比较该种组的毛色：样本共 54 张皮张，来自分布区内九个博物馆收藏；作者识别出两个在形态上可诊断、地理上隔离的群体，分别对应 P. irrorata 与 P. vanzolinii，但将另三种命名形式并回 P. irrorata。该比较是博物馆样本的分类研究，不是野外隔离或基因流实验。
text.en: Marsh elevated Vanzolini's bald-faced saki from a subspecies of P. irrorata in 2014. Serrano-Villavicencio and colleagues re-examined pelage in 2019 using 54 skins from nine museums across the group's range. They recognized two morphologically diagnosable, geographically isolated groups corresponding to P. irrorata and P. vanzolinii, while placing three other named forms within P. irrorata. This is a museum-based taxonomic comparison, not a field test of isolation or gene flow.

text.zh: Marsh 于 2014 年依据毛色将这一名称描述为新种；正模为英国自然历史博物馆收藏的成年个体，标签地点为 Amazonas 的 Paraná do Jacaré、Canabouça。Serrano-Villavicencio 等在 2019 年把模式标本与该种组其他馆藏一起比较，认为只有 P. irrorata 和 P. vanzolinii 两种毛色组可诊断，并将 P. pissinattii 处理为 P. irrorata 的异名。COL26.8 仍列 P. pissinattii 为接受种，而当前 MDD 把它列在 P. irrorata 名下；本页不裁决该分歧。
text.en: Marsh described this name as a new species in 2014 based on pelage; the holotype is an adult specimen at the Natural History Museum, labelled from Paraná do Jacaré, Canabouça, Amazonas. Serrano-Villavicencio and colleagues compared the type with other museum material in the group in 2019. They recognized diagnosable pelage groups only for P. irrorata and P. vanzolinii and treated P. pissinattii as a synonym of P. irrorata. COL26.8 still lists P. pissinattii as accepted, while the current MDD places it under P. irrorata; this page does not resolve the disagreement.

text.en: Hart, Ting and Maisels's 2020 assessment treats Foa's red colobus as a Democratic Republic of the Congo montane lineage and reports only two isolated locations in the evidence available to that assessment. The 2021 red-colobus action plan places its boundaries near other Central African forms and calls for monitoring and genetic work. These are dated syntheses of uneven survey evidence, not a new range survey or a present-day population count.
text.zh: Hart、Ting 与 Maisels 的 2020 年评估将佛阿红疣猴作为刚果民主共和国的山地谱系处理，并指出评估所能取得的资料只支持两个彼此隔离的地点。2021 年红疣猴行动计划把其边界放在邻近的中非类型之间，并提出监测和遗传研究需求。这些是对年代不一、覆盖不均的调查资料所作总结，不是新的分布调查或当前种群数量。

text.en: A 2019 rapid assessment documented red colobus at six locations in the Kisangani region: living animals were observed at four locations during two reconnaissance walks, and three hunter-killed animals came from two other locations. Five locations showed a sharply marked coat pattern the authors matched to the type description of P. langi; two animals from the right bank of the Lindi River differed and were assigned to the variable form P. ellioti. The report leaves western range limits and the identity of some interfluve populations unresolved.
text.zh: 一项 2019 年快速评估在基桑加尼地区六处记录到红疣猴：两次漫查中有四处见到活体，另两处记录到三只被猎杀个体。五处记录呈现的毛色分界鲜明，作者认为符合 P. langi 的模式描述；Lindi 河右岸的两只个体不同，被归入毛色多变的 P. ellioti。报告仍未解决西部边界及若干河间地种群的身份。

text.en: The 2020 Red List assessment records a long-running classification split: some authors treated lulindicus as a synonym of P. foai or as a form within broader red-colobus groupings, while others retained it separately. A 2016 workshop's precautionary approach kept it at species rank in that assessment. MDD v2.5 lists lulindicus under P. foai, whereas the pinned COL26.8 record accepts a separate species ID. This page preserves both catalog treatments; the material reviewed here is not enough for a full ecological account.
text.zh: 2020 年《红色名录》评估记录了长期分类分歧：一些作者把 lulindicus 并入 P. foai 或更广义的红疣猴类群，另一些作者则单独保留。该评估依照 2016 年研讨会的预防性处理维持其种级地位。MDD v2.5 将 lulindicus 列在 P. foai 名下，而固定的 COL26.8 记录保留独立种级 ID。本页并列保存两套目录处理；现有资料不足以写成完整生态介绍。

text.en: At Lac Télé Community Reserve, 83 cameras sampled nine seasonally flooded forest clearings from January 2020 to May 2023. The survey reported 169 photographs in 11 events for Oustalet's red colobus across 6,399 camera-days; the species-specific capture rate was 0.17 in the authors' relative-abundance index. These records show use of sampled clearings in one reserve, not density or reserve-wide abundance. A separate 2020 assessment describes the species as highly variable and notes unresolved boundaries with adjacent forms.
text.zh: 在 Lac Télé 社区保护区，83 台相机于 2020 年 1 月至 2023 年 5 月对九处季节性淹水森林空地取样。调查在总计 6,399 个相机日中记录到奥斯塔莱红疣猴 169 张照片、11 个事件；作者的相对丰度指数中，该种捕获率为 0.17。这些记录说明其使用了该保护区被抽样的空地，不代表密度或整个保护区的丰度。另一份 2020 年评估指出该类群变异很大，且与邻近类型的边界仍未解决。

text.en: Reconnaissance teams covered 571.51 km and passive acoustic sensors recorded 12,347 hours in Makombe and Ndokbou forests during 2018–2019. The study found no verified visual encounter with Preuss's red colobus; one putative call was detected near Mt. Sinai in Ndokbou. The authors recommend another targeted search there. This is a detection record for two surveyed forests and a defined period, not proof of absence across the species' range.
text.zh: 2018—2019 年，调查队在 Makombe 与 Ndokbou 森林完成 571.51 公里漫查，被动声学传感器累计记录 12,347 小时。研究未取得经确认的普鲁士红疣猴目击；在 Ndokbou 的 Mt. Sinai 附近记录到一次疑似叫声。作者建议在该处进一步定向搜索。这是两个受调查森林在特定时期的探测记录，不能证明该种在整个分布区缺席。

text.en: The 2020 assessment compiles sparse, dated encounters rather than a continuous modern survey: eight records came from Maiko National Park in 2005 after 680 km of effort across two sectors; three red-colobus vocalizations were heard near the Ituri River in 2007, but observers could not determine which bank they came from; and one animal was seen in Usala after more than 200 km of reconnaissance. The assessment also notes conflicting use of semlikiensis and ellioti for neighboring, variable populations.
text.zh: 2020 年评估汇总的是稀疏且有年代的记录，而非连续的现代调查：2005 年 Maiko 国家公园两片区域共完成 680 公里调查后记录八次；2007 年在 Ituri 河附近听到三次红疣猴叫声，但无法确定来自哪一侧河岸；Usala 在超过 200 公里漫查后仅有一次目击。评估还指出，邻近的多变种群被不同作者分别称为 semlikiensis 或 ellioti。

scope.zh: 一份汇集发表时已引用的野外报告与评估资料的保护综述；各物种摘要不是新调查。

limitations.en: The cited encounters are historical and sparse; the bank-level identity of the Ituri calls was unresolved, and nearby taxonomic boundaries remain fluid. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 所引记录年代较早且稀疏；Ituri 河叫声来自哪一岸尚不清楚，邻近分类边界也仍不稳定。本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: At Botsima in Salonga National Park, Maisels and colleagues followed one habituated group of more than 60 red colobus across a 250-ha study area. Over 12 months of feeding observations, the paper reported a diet of 60.7% leaves, 30.8% seeds, 7.1% ripe fruit and 1.4% flowers. The article used the name Colobus badius tholloni. Its figures describe that group and site, not a genus-wide or fixed species diet.
text.zh: 在 Salonga 国家公园的 Botsima，Maisels 等人对一个超过 60 只的已习惯化红疣猴群进行了研究，活动范围覆盖 250 公顷样地。论文记录了 12 个月取食观察，报告食物中叶片占 60.7%、种子占 30.8%、成熟果实占 7.1%、花占 1.4%。文章使用 Colobus badius tholloni 这一名称。比例只描述该群和地点，不代表全属或全种固定食谱。

scope.en: A 12-month diet study of one habituated red-colobus group at Botsima, Salonga; proportions are group- and site-specific and the paper uses the name Colobus badius tholloni.
scope.zh: 在 Salonga 的 Botsima 对一个已习惯化红疣猴群开展的 12 个月食谱研究；比例只适用于该群和地点，论文使用 Colobus badius tholloni 这一名称。

limitations.en: Feeding proportions come from one habituated group at one site and the paper's taxonomic name differs from COL26.8. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 食物比例来自一个地点的一个已习惯化群体，论文分类名与 COL26.8 不同。本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: McGraw's 2006 short communication tested four probabilistic methods against the dated sighting and museum-specimen record for the taxon then named Piliocolobus badius waldronae. Each method returned a probability above 0.05 for persistence at the time of the 2000 extinction claim; the author argued that the records were compatible with an extant but extremely rare form. This is an inference from historical records, not a confirmed later sighting. COL26.8 now carries waldronae as a species ID.
text.zh: McGraw 2006 年的短篇论文用四种概率方法分析当时称为 Piliocolobus badius waldronae 的有日期目击和馆藏标本记录。相对于 2000 年提出灭绝时的资料，四种方法给出的持续存在概率均高于 0.05；作者认为这些记录与仍存但极为稀少的类型相容。这是基于历史记录的推断，不是后来确认的目击。COL26.8 现以独立种级 ID 收录 waldronae。

sources.title: McGraw (2006) — Inferring extinction from biological records

scope.en: Four probabilistic methods applied to a chronological record of published sightings and museum specimens for the taxon then called Piliocolobus badius waldronae; inference does not confirm a living population.
scope.zh: 以四种概率方法分析当时称作 Piliocolobus badius waldronae 的已发表目击年代记录和馆藏标本；统计推断不能确认仍有存活种群。

limitations.en: The paper analyzes historical records under a subspecies name; its statistical result does not verify a living population, and the exact MDD crosswalk does not match this COL name. This source-linked draft is not externally expert-reviewed.
limitations.zh: 论文按亚种名分析历史记录，统计结果并未确认存活种群；此 COL 名称在当前 MDD 交叉表中无精确匹配。本页为有来源的初稿，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。

text.en: The type specimen was collected at Mabobi on the left bank of the Lualaba. Field notes report that patrol teams began recording red colobus identified as P. parmentieri in and near Lomami National Park in 2016–2017, extending the known local record southward. The 2021 action plan summarizes this as a range extension but also notes that the species was not found in 2007 surveys north of Ubundu and calls for more southern-range surveys. The record history remains patchy.
text.zh: 模式标本采自 Lualaba 河左岸的 Mabobi。野外记录称，巡护队在 2016—2017 年开始于 Lomami 国家公园内及附近记录到被鉴定为 P. parmentieri 的红疣猴，使已知局地记录向南延伸。2021 年行动计划将其总结为分布记录扩展，同时指出该种未在 Ubundu 北部 2007 年调查中发现，并建议进一步调查南部分布区。记录仍不连续。

text.en: Paddock, Bruford and McCabe used the distinctive “whoop-gobble” call to estimate abundance in the two known Udzungwa forest populations. Across 28 surveys, their model estimated 3,167 individuals (95% CI 2,181–4,596): 1,712 in Mwanihana and 1,455 in Uzungwa Scarp. Estimated group density was lower at Uzungwa Scarp. These are survey-era estimates with broad confidence intervals, not a current count.
text.zh: Paddock、Bruford 与 McCabe 利用特征性的“whoop-gobble”叫声，估计乌曾古瓦两片已知森林种群的数量。28 次调查的模型结果为 3,167 只（95% 置信区间 2,181—4,596）：Mwanihana 估计 1,712 只，Uzungwa Scarp 估计 1,455 只；后者的群体密度估计较低。这些是带有较宽置信区间的调查时期估计，不是当前数量。

sources.title: Paddock, Bruford & McCabe (2020) — Estimating the population size of the Sanje mangabey using acoustic distance sampling

scope.en: Point-transect acoustic distance sampling at 28 survey locations in Mwanihana and Uzungwa Scarp forests; population figures are estimates for that survey, not a current census.
scope.zh: 在 Mwanihana 与 Uzungwa Scarp 两片森林的 28 个调查点进行点样线声学距离抽样；数量是该次调查的估计，不是当前普查。

limitations.en: The abundance estimates come from two forest blocks and a 2020 study. They do not establish a later population trend or a continuous distribution between the blocks. The page has no external expert review; the Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 数量估计来自两片森林区和一项 2020 年研究，不能据此判断之后的种群趋势，也不能证明两片森林之间分布连续。本页未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: René Quris’s 1975 study documented ecology and social organization of mangabeys in northeastern Gabon using the name Cercocebus galeritus agilis. The paper itself described field knowledge of the forest-dwelling group as sparse at the time. It is useful as a dated, place-specific account of the lineage now listed separately as C. agilis in COL26.8, rather than as a modern range or population assessment.
text.zh: René Quris 于 1975 年发表的研究记录了加蓬东北部丛猴的生态与社会组织，当时使用名称 Cercocebus galeritus agilis。论文指出，当时对这类森林栖居丛猴的野外资料仍很少。它适合作为该谱系的历史性、地点限定记录；COL26.8 现将其单列为 C. agilis，但这篇研究不是现代分布或种群评估。

sources.title: Quris (1975) — Ecologie et organisation sociale de Cercocebus galeritus agilis dans le Nord-Est du Gabon

scope.en: An early field study of ecology and social organization in northeastern Gabon, published under the historical name C. galeritus agilis. Its conclusions are limited to that study and its taxonomic usage.
scope.zh: 一项关于加蓬东北部生态与社会组织的早期野外研究，发表时使用历史名称 C. galeritus agilis。其结论限于该研究及当时的分类用法。

limitations.en: The source predates the current species treatment and uses a subspecies name. The profile preserves that historical framing; it does not infer that the Gabon study represents every population now assigned to C. agilis. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 来源早于当前种级处理，并使用亚种名。本页保留其历史框架，不推定加蓬研究代表现今归入 C. agilis 的所有种群。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: In a Taï National Park group, researchers coded 226 interactions among 21 adult females from observations collected across three field seasons between 2022 and 2024. The study included affiliative, agonistic, feeding, grooming and sexual contexts. Interaction structure and signal-exchange timing differed by context; age was associated with gap duration only in affiliative exchanges, while rank and measured relationship strength showed no detectable effect. The authors caution that one group of adult females cannot establish species-wide patterns.
text.zh: 研究者对 Taï 国家公园一个群体中 21 只成年雌性的 226 次互动进行编码，观察资料来自 2022—2024 年的三个野外季。研究涵盖亲和、冲突、取食、理毛与性行为情境。互动结构和信号交换间隔随情境而异；年龄只在亲和互动中与间隔时长相关，等级和所测量的关系强度未显示可检测的影响。作者提醒，一个群体的成年雌性样本不能代表全种模式。

scope.en: Video and behavioral observations from one habituated Taï National Park group in 2022–2024; the analysis covered 226 interactions involving 21 adult females and five interaction contexts.
scope.zh: 基于 2022—2024 年 Taï 国家公园一个已习惯化群体的视频与行为观察；分析涵盖 21 只成年雌性参与的 226 次互动及五种互动情境。

limitations.en: This is a behavioral study of one habituated group and adult females, not a test of communication across the species or a direct comparison with human language. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 这项行为研究限于一个已习惯化群体中的成年雌性，并非对全种交流能力的检验，也不是与人类语言的直接比较。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: Inogwabini and Thompson compiled three intermittent, discontinuous surveys from 1994–2007 across forest blocks in and around Salonga National Park and west of Lake Maindombe. Their 2013 analysis mapped an estimated occupied area of about 70,000 km² and reported no detections across more than 37% of the presumed historical range. Because the surveys did not cover a continuous landscape or a single time window, those mapped limits should not be read as a present-day range boundary.
text.zh: Inogwabini 与 Thompson 汇总了 1994—2007 年间三次间断、非连续调查，地点位于 Salonga 国家公园内外及 Maindombe 湖以西的森林区。其 2013 年分析绘出的估计占域面积约为 70,000 平方公里，并报告在推定历史分布的 37% 以上区域未发现记录。由于调查并未覆盖连续景观，也不属于同一时间窗口，这些绘图边界不能视为现今分布界线。

sources.title: Inogwabini & Thompson (2013) — The Golden-bellied Mangabey: distribution and conservation status

scope.en: Three intermittent, discontinuous presence/absence surveys conducted from 1994 to 2007 in forest blocks around southern Salonga, between rivers inside Salonga, and west of Lake Maindombe; the mapped area is a study-era reconstruction.
scope.zh: 1994—2007 年间在三片森林区开展的间断、非连续有无调查，分别位于 Salonga 南部周边、Salonga 内河流之间，以及 Maindombe 湖以西；绘制的分布区域是研究时期的重建结果。

limitations.en: The source combines dated presence/absence surveys from three separated regions; the mapped extent is not a new, continuous or current range survey. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 来源汇总了三个分离区域的年代不同有无调查；绘制范围不是新的、连续的或当前分布调查。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: Oguge, Karere and Kirathe censused 73 forest patches along the lower Tana River from January to March 2001. They estimated 2,070 mangabeys in 59 groups; 56% of recorded groups were inside the Tana River Primate National Reserve. The paper also compared its estimate with an earlier 1994 census, but these dated surveys do not give a current population count.
text.zh: Oguge、Karere 与 Kirathe 于 2001 年 1—3 月对下 Tana 河沿岸 73 片森林进行普查。他们估计有 59 群、共 2,070 只丛猴；记录群体中 56% 位于 Tana 河灵长类国家保护区内。论文还将其估计与 1994 年较早的普查比较，但这些年代不同的调查不能代表当前种群数量。

text.en: A separate 13-year comparison followed one group in a 16.25-ha forest in 1988 and again in 2000–2001. Its diet composition shifted between periods, while only some changes tracked shifts in tree abundance or measured fruit availability. The study presents a local example of dietary flexibility in a dynamic riverine forest, not a fixed species-wide menu.
text.zh: 另一项 13 年比较研究在一片 16.25 公顷森林中，于 1988 年及 2000—2001 年观察同一群体。两个时期的食谱组成有所变化，但只有部分变化与树木数量或实测果实可得性的改变相对应。研究展示了河岸森林动态变化下的局地食谱灵活性，不是全种固定菜单。

scope.en: Censuses of 73 lower-Tana forest patches during January–March 2001; the reported estimate of 2,070 individuals in 59 groups and reserve overlap are historical survey results.
scope.zh: 2001 年 1—3 月对下 Tana 河 73 片森林进行普查；报告的 2,070 只、59 群估计及保护区重叠比例均为历史调查结果。

sources.title: Wieczkowski & Kinnaird (2008) — Shifting forest composition and primate diets: a 13-year comparison of the Tana River mangabey and its habitat

scope.en: Monthly feeding observations from one 16.25-ha Tana River forest in 1988 and 2000–2001, compared with counts of 25 food-tree species and fruit availability in nine species.
scope.zh: 在 Tana 河一片 16.25 公顷森林中，于 1988 年和 2000—2001 年逐月观察取食，并与 25 种食物树计数及其中九种的果实可得性比较。

limitations.en: The population estimate covers a dated census of fragmented lower-Tana forests; the diet comparison concerns one group and one 16.25-ha forest. Neither source establishes current abundance, a complete range, or a species-wide diet. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 种群估计来自对下 Tana 河破碎森林的历史普查；食谱比较限于一片 16.25 公顷森林中的一个群体。两项来源都不能确立当前丰度、完整分布或全种食谱。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: Nolan and colleagues used camera traps in Cape Three Points Forest Reserve, Ghana, from January to April 2018. Four independent camera events at four locations confirmed the species’ presence during the survey; the cameras were deployed across 21 locations and recorded 778 camera-trap days. This is a site-level confirmation, not an abundance estimate or evidence that the reserve is connected to another population.
text.zh: Nolan 等人于 2018 年 1—4 月在加纳 Cape Three Points 森林保护区使用相机陷阱。四个地点的四次独立拍摄确认了调查期间该种在此出现；相机覆盖 21 个地点，共记录 778 个相机日。这是地点级别的出现确认，不是丰度估计，也不能证明该保护区与其他种群相连。

sources.title: Nolan et al. (2019) — Camera Traps Confirm the Presence of the White-naped Mangabey in Cape Three Points Forest Reserve, Western Ghana

scope.en: A camera survey from 25 January to 19 April 2018 deployed 14 traps across 21 locations and accumulated 778 camera-trap days; four independent captures documented presence at four locations in this reserve.
scope.zh: 2018 年 1 月 25 日至 4 月 19 日开展的相机调查，在 21 个地点部署 14 台相机，共取得 778 个相机日；四次独立拍摄记录在该保护区四处地点出现。

limitations.en: The study confirms presence in one reserve during a four-month 2018 deployment; four independent captures do not estimate population size or establish current persistence. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 研究确认该种在 2018 年为期四个月的部署期间出现在一处保护区；四次独立拍摄不能估计种群数量，也不能证明当前仍持续存在。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: At Sentier Nature forest in Gabon’s South Loango National Park, Dolado, Cooke and Beltran followed a population during the peak-fruiting season of 2014. They compared party composition and habitat use with fruit availability from four tree species and reported seasonal fission–fusion patterns associated with fruit availability. The result describes that population and study season; it does not establish a year-round pattern across the species.
text.zh: Dolado、Cooke 与 Beltran 于 2014 年果实丰盛季，在加蓬 South Loango 国家公园的 Sentier Nature 森林跟踪一个种群。他们将群体组成和生境利用与四种树木的果实可得性比较，并报告了与果实可得性相关的季节性群体分合。该结果描述的是这一种群和研究季节，不能确立全种全年规律。

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 — Cercocebus torquatus (Kerr in Linnaeus, 1792)

scope.en: Pinned COL26.8 accepted name, authorship, rank and parent identity; not biological evidence.
scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

sources.title: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 — Cercocebus torquatus (Kerr in Linnaeus, 1792)

scope.en: English common-name reference and crosswalk; not field evidence. The fixed species roster remains COL26.8.
scope.zh: 英文普通名与交叉表参照；不是野外证据。固定物种名录仍以 COL26.8 为准。

sources.title: Dolado, Cooke & Beltran (2016) — How Many for Lunch Today? Seasonal Fission-Fusion Dynamics as a Feeding Strategy in Wild Red-Capped Mangabeys

scope.en: A field study of one population in Sentier Nature forest, South Loango National Park, Gabon, during the 2014 peak-fruiting season; party composition and fruit availability were assessed for four tree species.
scope.zh: 一项针对加蓬 South Loango 国家公园 Sentier Nature 森林一个种群的野外研究，调查期为 2014 年果实丰盛季；研究记录群体分合及四种树木的果实可得性。

limitations.en: The source covers one population and a single peak-fruiting season in 2014. It is not a full annual time series, a species-wide social description, or a current population assessment. No external expert review; Chinese common name is editorial.
limitations.zh: 来源只覆盖一个种群和 2014 年一个果实丰盛季，不是全年连续研究、全种社会组织综述或当前种群评估。未经外部领域专家评审；中文普通名为编辑译名。

text.en: This path links all seven Cercocebus species in the fixed COL26.8 primate roster and compares how evidence was collected. Begin with the multi-patch lower-Tana census and single-forest diet comparison for C. galeritus, then the two-forest acoustic estimate for C. sanjei. Read C. agilis beside C. torquatus to compare an early northeastern-Gabon account published under the older subspecies name with a fruit-linked party study from South Loango. Continue with the Taï group communication study of C. atys, then the discontinuous regional surveys for C. chrysogaster and the camera-confirmed site record for C. lunulatus. The dates, methods and taxonomic labels differ; these pages do not combine into a genus-wide range, abundance estimate, diet or status.
text.zh: 本阅读路径连接固定 COL26.8 灵长类名录中的七个 Cercocebus 种，并比较不同证据的采集方式。可先读 C. galeritus 的下 Tana 河多片森林普查和单片森林食谱比较，再读 C. sanjei 的两片森林声学数量估计。随后将 C. agilis 与 C. torquatus 对读：前者是采用旧亚种名发表的加蓬东北部早期研究，后者是 South Loango 与果实相关的群体研究。接着阅读 Taï 群体中 C. atys 的交流研究，最后比较 C. chrysogaster 的间断区域调查和 C. lunulatus 的相机地点记录。各页年代、方法和分类标签不同，不能合并成属级分布、数量估计、食谱或状态。

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 — Cercocebus É. Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire, 1812

scope.en: Pinned COL26.8 accepted name, authorship, rank and parent identity; not biological evidence.
scope.zh: 固定 COL26.8 中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不提供生物学证据。

sources.title: Paddock, Bruford & McCabe (2020) — Estimating the population size of the Sanje mangabey using acoustic distance sampling

scope.en: Point-transect acoustic distance sampling at 28 survey locations in Mwanihana and Uzungwa Scarp forests; population figures are estimates for that survey, not a current census.
scope.zh: 在 Mwanihana 与 Uzungwa Scarp 两片森林的 28 个调查点进行点样线声学距离抽样；数量是该次调查的估计，不是当前普查。

sources.title: Quris (1975) — Ecologie et organisation sociale de Cercocebus galeritus agilis dans le Nord-Est du Gabon

scope.en: An early field study of ecology and social organization in northeastern Gabon, published under the historical name C. galeritus agilis. Its conclusions are limited to that study and its taxonomic usage.
scope.zh: 一项关于加蓬东北部生态与社会组织的早期野外研究，发表时使用历史名称 C. galeritus agilis。其结论限于该研究及当时的分类用法。

sources.title: Tibesar et al. (2026) — Who waits when? Age and interactional context shape turn-taking timing in sooty mangabeys in the wild

scope.en: Video and behavioral observations from one habituated Taï National Park group in 2022–2024; the analysis covered 226 interactions involving 21 adult females and five interaction contexts.
scope.zh: 基于 2022—2024 年 Taï 国家公园一个已习惯化群体的视频与行为观察；分析涵盖 21 只成年雌性参与的 226 次互动及五种互动情境。

sources.title: Inogwabini & Thompson (2013) — The Golden-bellied Mangabey: distribution and conservation status

scope.en: Three intermittent, discontinuous presence/absence surveys conducted from 1994 to 2007 in forest blocks around southern Salonga, between rivers inside Salonga, and west of Lake Maindombe; the mapped area is a study-era reconstruction.
scope.zh: 1994—2007 年间在三片森林区开展的间断、非连续有无调查，分别位于 Salonga 南部周边、Salonga 内河流之间，以及 Maindombe 湖以西；绘制的分布区域是研究时期的重建结果。

sources.title: Oguge, Karere & Kirathe (2004) — Population sizes and distribution of primates in the lower Tana River forests, Kenya

scope.en: Censuses of 73 lower-Tana forest patches during January–March 2001; the reported estimate of 2,070 individuals in 59 groups and reserve overlap are historical survey results.
scope.zh: 2001 年 1—3 月对下 Tana 河 73 片森林进行普查；报告的 2,070 只、59 群估计及保护区重叠比例均为历史调查结果。

sources.title: Wieczkowski & Kinnaird (2008) — Shifting forest composition and primate diets: a 13-year comparison of the Tana River mangabey and its habitat

scope.en: Monthly feeding observations from one 16.25-ha Tana River forest in 1988 and 2000–2001, compared with counts of 25 food-tree species and fruit availability in nine species.
scope.zh: 在 Tana 河一片 16.25 公顷森林中，于 1988 年和 2000—2001 年逐月观察取食，并与 25 种食物树计数及其中九种的果实可得性比较。

sources.title: Nolan et al. (2019) — Camera Traps Confirm the Presence of the White-naped Mangabey in Cape Three Points Forest Reserve, Western Ghana

scope.en: A camera survey from 25 January to 19 April 2018 deployed 14 traps across 21 locations and accumulated 778 camera-trap days; four independent captures documented presence at four locations in this reserve.
scope.zh: 2018 年 1 月 25 日至 4 月 19 日开展的相机调查，在 21 个地点部署 14 台相机，共取得 778 个相机日；四次独立拍摄记录在该保护区四处地点出现。

sources.title: Dolado, Cooke & Beltran (2016) — How Many for Lunch Today? Seasonal Fission-Fusion Dynamics as a Feeding Strategy in Wild Red-Capped Mangabeys

scope.en: A field study of one population in Sentier Nature forest, South Loango National Park, Gabon, during the 2014 peak-fruiting season; party composition and fruit availability were assessed for four tree species.
scope.zh: 一项针对加蓬 South Loango 国家公园 Sentier Nature 森林一个种群的野外研究，调查期为 2014 年果实丰盛季；研究记录群体分合及四种树木的果实可得性。

limitations.en: This is a selective reading path, not a genus-wide scientific synthesis; it has not received external expert review. The included studies differ in date, site coverage, method and historical taxonomy.
limitations.zh: 这是一条选择性阅读路径，不是属级科学综述，且尚未经过外部领域专家评审。所列研究在年代、地点覆盖、方法和历史分类上各不相同。

records.scientificName: Mico humilis (M. van Roosmalen, T. van Roosmalen, Mittermeier & de Fonseca, 1998)

text.en: Garbino, Silva and Davis reported two additional records under the historical name Callibella humilis. One was observed and photographed in campinarana on the west bank of the Rio Madeirinha, extending the reported distribution about 270 km south to the west bank of the Rio Roosevelt. The second was a collected individual from the Rio Roosevelt mouth, less than 10 km from the type locality of Mico marcai. Two records do not provide an abundance estimate or a complete range survey.
text.zh: Garbino、Silva 与 Davis 以历史名称 Callibella humilis 报告两条新记录。一条来自 Madeirinha 河西岸白沙矮林的观察与照片记录，使当时报告分布向南延伸约 270 公里，到达 Roosevelt 河西岸；另一条是 Roosevelt 河口采集的个体，距 Mico marcai 模式地点不足 10 公里。两条记录不能提供数量估计或完整分布调查。

text.en: The same short paper presented the first sonogram analysis of the long call and compared note duration and frequency with Cebuella pygmaea and Mico argentatus. This is a call-structure comparison, not a broad communication survey.
text.zh: 同一短文首次分析了长叫声声谱图，并将音节时长和频率与 Cebuella pygmaea、Mico argentatus 比较。这是叫声结构比较，不是全面的交流调查。

title.en: Garbino, Silva & Davis (2013) — Range extension and long-call analysis of Callibella humilis
title.zh: Garbino、Silva 与 Davis（2013）：Callibella humilis 分布新记录与长叫声分析

scope.en: Supports two locality records, the approximate southward extension and the study's sonogram analysis; the paper uses Callibella humilis.
scope.zh: 支持两处地点记录、大致向南延伸及声谱图分析；论文使用 Callibella humilis。

title.zh: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 · Black-crowned Dwarf Marmoset

title.en: ASM Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 — taxonomy notes for Mico humilis
title.zh: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5：Mico humilis 分类注记

scope.en: Supports the MDD-listed Callibella subgenus and its note that generic placement under Mico has been treated differently among sources; pinned COL26.8 remains the page identity.
scope.zh: 支持 MDD 所列 Callibella 亚属以及其关于不同来源对 Mico 属级归属处理不一的注记；本页分类身份仍依固定 COL26.8。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This page follows COL26.8 as Mico humilis, while the field article used Callibella humilis. MDD records Callibella as a subgenus and notes differing generic treatments. The range statement comes from two records, not a current full-range assessment.
limitations.zh: 这是有来源的入门页，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。本页依 COL26.8 使用 Mico humilis，野外论文使用 Callibella humilis。MDD 将 Callibella 记为亚属，并记录了不同的属级处理。分布陈述来自两条记录，不是当前完整分布评估。

text.en: Rylands' preliminary account describes observations at Dardanelos on the Rio Aripuanã from May through November 1978. Published under the historical name Callithrix humeralifer intermedius, it reports groups of 4–13 animals and use of dense primary forest, secondary forest and campinarana. These observations describe one locality and period, not the species' full range or present-day group size.
text.zh: Rylands 的初步记录描述了 1978 年 5 月至 11 月在阿里普阿南河 Dardanelos 的观察。论文以历史名称 Callithrix humeralifer intermedius 发表，报告群体为 4—13 只，并使用茂密原生林、次生林和白沙矮林。这些观察限于一个地点和时段，不代表全种分布或当前群体大小。

title.en: Rylands (1979) — Preliminary observations on Callithrix humeralifer intermedius at Dardanelos
title.zh: Rylands（1979）：Dardanelos 的 Callithrix humeralifer intermedius 初步观察

scope.en: Supports preliminary observations at Dardanelos in 1978, reported group sizes and habitat types; the paper uses a historical subspecific combination.
scope.zh: 支持 1978 年 Dardanelos 初步观察、群体大小和生境类型；原文使用历史亚种组合名。

title.zh: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5 · Rio Aripuanã Marmoset

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The study is a preliminary 1978 account at Dardanelos and predates the current Mico combination; it cannot establish current abundance, full distribution or genus-wide habitat preference.
limitations.zh: 这是有来源的入门页，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。研究是 1978 年 Dardanelos 的初步记录，早于当前 Mico 组合名；它不能确定当前数量、完整分布或属级生境偏好。

text.en: Silva and colleagues surveyed the Marmelos–Aripuanã interfluve during 2012–2015 and reported Mico marcai at 13 localities. Their record-based extent-of-occurrence estimate was 31,073 km². This describes that study's mapped evidence, not a complete present-day range survey.
text.zh: Silva 等人在 2012—2015 年调查 Marmelos—Aripuanã 间河区，并报告在 13 处记录到 Mico marcai。基于记录的分布范围估计为 31,073 平方公里。这描述的是该研究绘制的证据，不是当前完整分布调查。

text.en: Distance sampling estimated density at 8.31 individuals/km²; extrapolation gave 258,218 animals (95% confidence interval 150,705–441,860). A business-as-usual scenario projected loss of about 10,000 km², or 33% of the modeled range, over three generations (about 18 years). The authors recommended Vulnerable at publication. These dated estimates and scenario are not a current census or status reassessment.
text.zh: 距离抽样估计密度为每平方公里 8.31 只；外推总数为 258,218 只（95% 置信区间 150,705—441,860）。常发展情景预测三个世代（约 18 年）内损失约 10,000 平方公里、即模型范围的 33%。作者在论文发表时建议列为易危。这些有日期的估计与情景不是当前普查或保护等级重评。

title.en: Silva et al. (2020) — The Roosevelt–Rondon expedition marmoset Mico marcai
title.zh: Silva 等（2020）：罗斯福—隆东考察队绒猴 Mico marcai

scope.en: Supports 2012–2015 surveys, 13 localities, distance-sampling density and population extrapolation, mapped extent and the authors' forest-loss scenario and recommendation.
scope.zh: 支持 2012—2015 年调查、13 处记录、距离抽样密度与种群外推、范围界定及作者的森林损失情景和保护建议。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Density, population size, extent and forest-loss projection are estimates tied to 2012–2015 fieldwork and the paper's assumptions. The recommendation is the authors' dated recommendation, not a present-day reassessment.
limitations.zh: 这是有来源的入门页，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。密度、种群数量、范围和森林损失预测均受 2012—2015 年调查及论文假设限制。文中建议是作者当时的建议，不代表当前重新评估。

text.en: Noronha and colleagues used a 2004 field trip to update the distribution account and reported eight new occurrence records: seven direct sightings and one interview with a local informant. The survey covered the headwaters of the Maués, Abacaxis and Sucundurí rivers. These records refine a historical locality picture; they are not a present-day census or proof of continuous occupancy.
text.zh: Noronha 等人利用 2004 年一次野外行程更新分布记录，报告 8 处新出现记录：7 处直接目击、1 处当地知情者访谈。调查涵盖 Maués、Abacaxis 和 Sucundurí 河的源头区域。这些记录补充历史地点资料，不是当前普查，也不能证明连续占域。

text.en: The authors obtained records in terra firme primary forest, secondary growth and igapó. Identification used diagnostic characters from the description and comparisons with museum specimens. The observations apply to sampled sites only and do not establish a current trend.
text.zh: 作者在旱地原生林、次生植被和 igapó 洪泛林获得记录；鉴定依据为物种描述中的诊断特征，并与博物馆标本比较。观察结论只适用于调查地点，不能确定当前趋势。

title.en: Noronha et al. (2008) — New occurrence records of Maués marmoset, Mico mauesi
title.zh: Noronha 等（2008）：毛埃斯绒猴 Mico mauesi 新出现记录

scope.en: Supports the 2004 field trip, eight records, sighting/interview breakdown, survey area and observed habitat types.
scope.zh: 支持 2004 年野外行程、8 处记录、目击/访谈构成、调查区和记录到的生境类型。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Evidence comes from one 2004 field trip reported in 2008, and one record came from an interview rather than a direct sighting. No current presence, abundance or continuous range is inferred.
limitations.zh: 这是有来源的入门页，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。证据来自 2004 年一次野外行程并于 2008 年发表，其中一条为访谈而非直接目击。本页不推断当前出现、数量或连续分布。

text.en: The 2025 Brazilian ICMBio assessment card describes the species as endemic to Amazonas and gives river-based limits from the original account: Abacaxis to the east, Canumã and Sucundurí to the west, and Paraná Urariá to the south. It notes that additional sampling is needed near the southern limit around Igarapé do Arreganhado. The card reports a minimum-convex-polygon extent of occurrence of 1,571.2 km² and a separate habitat-distribution estimate of 19,569.7 km²; the measures are not interchangeable.
text.zh: 巴西 ICMBio 于 2025 年发布的评估卡将该种描述为亚马孙州特有种，并依据原始资料列出河流边界：东至 Abacaxis 河，西至 Canumã 与 Sucundurí 河，南至 Paraná Urariá 河。卡片指出 Igarapé do Arreganhado 附近南界需要补充取样。卡片报告最小凸多边形计算的分布范围为 1,571.2 平方公里，另有 19,569.7 平方公里的生境分布估计；两项指标不可互换。

text.en: The card reports use of primary and secondary terra firme forest and igapó, and cites 0.05% habitat-area loss for 2002–2018. It records a Brazilian Least Concern category dated 27 September 2019, published in the 2025 card, while population trend is unknown. Mining-related habitat impacts are identified; ecology, population-size and threat-impact studies remain research needs.
text.zh: 卡片记载该种使用原生及次生旱地林和 igapó，并引用 2002—2018 年生境面积损失 0.05% 的估计。卡片记录巴西国家评估为无危，评估日期为 2019 年 9 月 27 日，卡片于 2025 年发布；种群趋势未知。评估指出采矿相关生境影响，并将生态、种群数量和威胁影响研究列为需求。

title.en: Costa-Araújo et al. (2025) — Mico saterei, ICMBio SALVE assessment
title.zh: Costa-Araújo 等（2025）：ICMBio SALVE 的 Mico saterei 评估卡

scope.en: Supports the dated Brazilian assessment, river-bounded description, separate distribution measures, habitat notes and research needs; assessment date is 27 September 2019.
scope.zh: 支持有日期的巴西评估、河流边界描述、不同分布指标、生境说明和研究需求；评估日期是 2019 年 9 月 27 日。

title.en: Silva Júnior & Noronha (1998) — On a new species of bare-eared marmoset from central Amazonia
title.zh: Silva Júnior 与 Noronha（1998）：亚马孙中部裸耳绒猴新种描述

scope.en: Original description under Callithrix saterei; supports type material and locality cited by the assessment.
scope.zh: 以 Callithrix saterei 发表的原始描述；支持评估卡引用的模式标本和地点。

text.en: A 2018 multiyear survey reported 14 records from 44 survey days and extended the then-described southern distribution about 100 km to the Maracanã River. A later programme based on 2015–2018 fieldwork reported 12 additional records from Apuí, Maués, Novo Aripuanã and Urucurituba; it described an eastern extension onto Ilha Tupinambarana of about 160 km and a record-based distribution estimate of 46,800 km². These are study-era delineations, not abundance estimates or a complete current census.
text.zh: 一项 2018 年发表的多年调查报告在 44 个调查日内获得 14 条记录，并将当时所述南部分布向 Maracanã 河延伸约 100 公里。随后基于 2015—2018 年野外调查的研究，在 Apuí、Maués、Novo Aripuanã 和 Urucurituba 报告 12 条新增记录；作者称分布向东延伸至 Ilha Tupinambarana 约 160 公里，并给出基于记录的 46,800 平方公里分布估计。这些是研究时期的范围界定，不是数量估计或当前完整普查。

text.en: The 2018 study searched trails, roads and river margins in a 3,919 km² middle-Madeira study area across several seasons. The 2023 note drew on ten playback-focused expeditions across southern Amazonia and documented habitat use at recorded sites. The papers have different sampling windows and methods and should not be collapsed into one continuous survey.
text.zh: 2018 年研究在中 Madeira 河 3,919 平方公里研究区内，跨多个季节沿步道、道路和河岸调查。2023 年短文依据亚马孙南部 10 次以播放叫声为主的野外考察，记录了所到地点的生境利用。两篇论文的取样时段和方法不同，不应合并为一次连续调查。

records.scientificName: Mico schneideri Costa-Araújo, Silva-Jr., Boubli, Rossi, Hrbek & Farias, 2021

text.en: Costa-Araújo and colleagues tested Juruena–Teles Pires marmosets with pelage morphology, phylogenomics and locality records. Their 2015–2018 programme included ten field expeditions and museum specimens and tissues. They described Mico schneideri as a distinct, fully supported lineage; sampled records were confined to the Juruena–Teles Pires interfluve, with no documented overlap with other Mico in that study. The holotype was an adult female collected on 2 April 2016 in an urban forest fragment at Paranaíta, on the left bank of the Teles Pires River. This is the paper's sampled distribution and species-delimitation result, not a complete current range census.
text.zh: Costa-Araújo 等人结合被毛形态、系统基因组和地点记录检验 Juruena—Teles Pires 间河区绒猴。其 2015—2018 年研究包括 10 次野外考察，并检查博物馆标本和组织样本。论文将 Mico schneideri 描述为独立且在系统基因组树中获完全支持的谱系；该研究记录仅来自 Juruena—Teles Pires 间河区，未记录与其他 Mico 分布重叠。模式标本是一只成年雌性，于 2016 年 4 月 2 日采自 Paranaíta 市 Teles Pires 河左岸的城市森林碎片。这是论文的取样分布和种界结论，不是当前完整分布普查。

text.en: Follow this Aotus reading path by study scale. Start with the 2018–2019 Colombian comparison of three A. lemurinus groups and one A. griseimembra group; then the three-site 2008 Chagres survey of A. zonalis and the 2024 nest-site records for A. brumbacki. Compare those with northeastern Peru field material for A. miconax and the older transect estimates for A. nancymai. The A. jorgehernandezi page records the 2007 chromosome-based description and a 2025 synonym proposal that differs from the pinned COL26.8 treatment. Four other roster pages—A. azarae, A. nigriceps, A. trivirgatus and A. vociferans—include a Brazilian interfluve map overlay, which represents range-map overlap rather than point-level field confirmation. Together, the eleven fixed COL26.8 species IDs have reader pages; this selected path is not a genus-wide ecological synthesis or a phylogeny.
text.zh: 本夜猴属阅读路径按研究尺度展开。先读 2018—2019 年哥伦比亚三群 A. lemurinus 与一群 A. griseimembra 的比较；再看 2008 年 Chagres 三地点 A. zonalis 调查，以及 2024 年 A. brumbacki 巢位记录。随后对照秘鲁东北部 A. miconax 野外资料和 A. nancymai 较早的样线估算。A. jorgehernandezi 页面记录 2007 年基于染色体的描述，以及与固定 COL26.8 处理不同的 2025 年异名主张。其余四个名录页——A. azarae、A. nigriceps、A. trivirgatus、A. vociferans——包含巴西亚马孙间河区范围图叠置；它表示范围图相交，不是逐点野外确认。固定 COL26.8 中的 11 个接受种 ID 现都有读者页；此精选路径不是全属生态综述或系统发育树。

text.en: At San Juan del Carare in central Colombia, researchers followed one habituated group of five A. griseimembra in seasonally flooded lowland rainforest during parts of 2018–2019. The group occupied one study forest at 90–150 m elevation; this is a local research account, not a range survey.
text.zh: 在哥伦比亚中部 San Juan del Carare，研究者于 2018—2019 年间断跟踪了一群已习惯研究者出现的灰腿夜猴，共五只，地点为季节性洪泛低地雨林。样地海拔 90—150 米；这是局地研究记录，不是分布调查。

text.en: In that group, fruits were the principal food and the monkeys spent about 48% of the night resting, similar to the three A. lemurinus groups in the same study. Its estimated home range was 2.7 ha by the 90% kernel method and 3.6 ha by the 100% minimum-convex-polygon method. These estimates describe one group and depend on the method used.
text.zh: 该群以果实为主要食物，夜间约 48% 的时间用于休息；同一研究中的三群 A. lemurinus 也呈现相近的活动时间分配。按 90% 核密度法估算的活动范围为 2.7 公顷，按 100% 最小凸多边形法为 3.6 公顷。这些数值只描述一群猴，且随估算方法而异。

text.en: A 2024 field note describes 24 sleeping sites in fragmented and relict landscapes of Colombia’s eastern Llanos. In Villavicencio, Acacías and Cumaral, nests were in forest fragments, along their edges or in living fences, usually 2–8 m above ground; in San Martín, sites were in or beside forest fragments and morichales at 8–18 m. The records show several locally used settings, not a species-wide rule.
text.zh: 一篇 2024 年野外短文记录了哥伦比亚东部 Llanos 碎片化及残存景观中的 24 处睡眠地点。在 Villavicencio、Acacías 和 Cumaral，巢位于林片内、林缘或活篱笆上方，通常离地 2—8 米；San Martín 的记录则位于林片和毛里棕榈林内或边缘，高 8—18 米。这些记录显示局地使用的多种环境，不代表全种规律。

text.en: The study combined landscape censuses at San Martín with interview-assisted searches for sleeping sites in three other landscapes. Its 24 characterized sites inform nest-site use; they do not estimate population size or establish current distribution.
text.zh: 该研究结合 San Martín 的景观普查，以及在另外三个景观中借助访谈寻找睡眠地点。所描述的 24 处地点有助认识巢位利用，但不能估算种群数量或确定当前分布。

name.zh: 埃尔南德斯-卡马乔夜猴

text.en: Defler and Bueno named this taxon in 2007 from a distinctive chromosome form reported for a female night monkey found in captivity in Quindío, Colombia. The authors could not locate the holotype specimen, and its exact wild origin was uncertain; Parque de los Nevados was only a reported possibility. In 2025, Montilla and colleagues argued from a comparison of Colombian Aotus that the name should be treated as a junior synonym of A. brumbacki. COL26.8 and the local MDD v2.5 crosswalk retain separate records, so this page preserves the catalogued ID and labels the synonymy as a published taxonomic opinion.
text.zh: Defler 与 Bueno 于 2007 年依据一只在哥伦比亚 Quindío 省圈养的雌性夜猴所呈现的特殊染色体型命名该分类单元。作者未能在馆藏中找到模式标本，其野外来源不确定；Parque de los Nevados 只是被报告的可能地点。Montilla 等人在 2025 年比较哥伦比亚 Aotus 后，主张将该名视为 A. brumbacki 的次异名。COL26.8 和本地 MDD v2.5 交叉表仍保留独立记录，因此本页沿用固定目录 ID，并把异名处理标明为已发表的分类意见。

text.en: A 2018–2019 study followed three groups in two Colombian Andean forests: El Colegio at 2,350–2,550 m and Pijao at 1,750–1,800 m. The sites differed in forest size and landscape setting, so group-level behavior and space use should be read in that context.
text.zh: 一项 2018—2019 年研究在哥伦比亚两个安第斯森林地点跟踪了三群狐猴夜猴：El Colegio 海拔 2,350—2,550 米，Pijao 海拔 1,750—1,800 米。两处地点的森林面积和景观环境不同，因此应结合研究地点理解群体行为与空间利用。

text.en: Across the four study groups of A. lemurinus and A. griseimembra, fruits were the main food and about 48% of the night was spent resting. The highland A. lemurinus groups also frequently ate plants in Melastomataceae and Rubiaceae. These are observations from three groups over roughly a year, not a complete species-wide diet.
text.zh: 在研究中的三群狐猴夜猴和一群灰腿夜猴里，果实是主要食物，夜间约 48% 的时间用于休息。高地狐猴夜猴还常取食野牡丹科和茜草科植物。这些观察来自约一年的三群研究对象，不是全种食谱。

title.en: Montilla et al. (2021) — Activity patterns, diet and home range of night monkeys in central Colombia
title.zh: Montilla 等（2021）：哥伦比亚中部夜猴的活动、食性与活动范围

scope.en: A 2018–2019 study of three A. lemurinus groups and one A. griseimembra group at three Colombian sites; supports the site-specific observations and group estimates stated here.
scope.zh: 2018—2019 年在哥伦比亚三个地点研究三群 A. lemurinus 和一群 A. griseimembra；支持本页所述局地观察和群体估算。

limitations.en: The article follows three groups at two sites for about one year; local activity, diet and home-range results should not be generalized to all populations.
limitations.zh: 论文在两个地点跟踪三群猴约一年；局地活动、食性和活动范围结果不应推广至所有种群。

text.en: A northeastern Peru survey reported A. miconax records from 1,200–3,100 m. Across all Aotus in the wider survey, the researchers compiled evidence from 44 localities using direct visual observations, calls and secondary signs; the abstract does not break those totals down by species. The elevation span is therefore a summary of surveyed records, not a complete altitudinal limit.
text.zh: 一项秘鲁东北部调查报告的安第斯夜猴记录海拔为 1,200—3,100 米。在覆盖多个 Aotus 种的调查中，研究者汇集了 44 个地点的证据，包括直接目击、叫声和间接痕迹；摘要没有按物种拆分这些记录总数。因此，该海拔范围只是调查记录的汇总，不是完整的海拔界限。

text.en: The same paper combined field records with ecological-niche modelling to estimate probable historical distribution and discuss habitat change. Modelled historical suitability and the authors’ dated conservation recommendation are not current field confirmations or a new population census.
text.zh: 同一论文结合野外记录和生态位模型，估计可能的历史分布并讨论栖地变化。模型推测的历史适生区和作者当时提出的保护建议，不是当前野外确认或新的种群普查。

title.en: Shanee et al. (2015) — Distribution survey and ecological niche modelling of Aotus miconax in northeastern Peru
title.zh: Shanee 等（2015）：秘鲁东北部 Aotus miconax 分布调查与生态位模型

scope.en: Field surveys report A. miconax elevation records and combine them with a dated ecological-niche model; locality counts pool several Aotus species.
scope.zh: 野外调查报告 A. miconax 的海拔记录，并结合有年代的生态位模型；地点总数合并了多个 Aotus 种。

limitations.en: Locality counts and observation methods are pooled across Aotus species; the mapped historical range is model-based and does not establish present occupancy.
limitations.zh: 地点总数和观察方法合并多个 Aotus 种；历史分布图基于模型，不能证明当前占据情况。

text.en: Aquino and Encarnación’s 1988 transect study in northeastern Peru reported estimated densities of about 46.3 individuals/km² in lowland forests and 24.2 individuals/km² in highland forests for A. nancymai. Their paper described the taxon south of the Amazon–Marañón rivers, with a northern enclave between the Tigre and Pastaza rivers. These are historical, site- and method-dependent estimates, not a present-day census or complete range assessment.
text.zh: Aquino 与 Encarnación 于 1988 年在秘鲁东北部开展样线研究，报告 A. nancymai 在低地森林的估算密度约为每平方公里 46.3 只，在高地森林约为每平方公里 24.2 只。论文将该类群描述为分布在亚马孙—Marañón 河以南，并在 Tigre 与 Pastaza 河之间有一个北部孤立区。这些是受年代、地点和方法限制的历史估算，不是当前普查或完整分布评估。

title.en: Aquino & Encarnación (1988) — Population densities and geographic distribution of night monkeys in northeastern Peru
title.zh: Aquino 与 Encarnación（1988）：秘鲁东北部夜猴种群密度与地理分布

scope.en: Transect-based density estimates and a dated geographic account for A. nancymai and A. vociferans in northeastern Peru.
scope.zh: 以样线调查估算 A. nancymai 和 A. vociferans 的密度，并记录秘鲁东北部的有年代地理资料。

limitations.en: Density values come from historical transects in selected forest types and should not be read as current abundance or a range-wide estimate.
limitations.zh: 密度数值来自特定森林类型中的历史样线调查，不能当作当前丰度或全分布区估算。

text.en: Between May and July 2008, researchers used line transects at three localities in Panama’s Chagres National Park. They observed 33 individuals in 16 groups at two sites and none at the third. Estimated density was 19.7 individuals/km² at Campo Chagres and 14.3 individuals/km² at Cerro Azul. The authors treated this as a pilot study and called for longer-term work before using the estimates for conservation decisions.
text.zh: 2008 年 5—7 月，研究者在巴拿马 Chagres 国家公园的三个地点使用样线调查。他们在两个地点观察到 16 群共 33 只个体，第三处地点没有记录到该种。Campo Chagres 的估算密度为每平方公里 19.7 只，Cerro Azul 为 14.3 只。作者将其视为试点研究，并指出在据此制定保护决策前仍需长期调查。

title.en: Svensson et al. (2010) — Density estimates of Panamanian owl monkeys in three habitat types
title.zh: Svensson 等（2010）：三类栖地中的巴拿马夜猴密度估算

scope.en: A May–July 2008 line-transect pilot at three Chagres National Park sites; the authors recommended longer-term validation.
scope.zh: 2008 年 5—7 月在 Chagres 国家公园三个地点开展的样线试点调查；作者建议进行更长期的验证。

limitations.en: The survey lasted three months and covered three sites in one park; its local abundance estimates are not a current range-wide population estimate.
limitations.zh: 调查持续三个月、覆盖一个国家公园内三个地点；局地丰度估算不是当前全分布区种群估计。
